title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Contract
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you'll be a key part of our TA team, contributing to how we find and attract talent at Toast. You'll manage the full recruitment process, focusing on building strong candidate pools, making sure candidates have a great experience, and adapting to different hiring needs. 

Toast's Talent Acquisition team prioritizes collaboration, expertise, and strong connections with our business partners. We're dedicated to finding the best candidates to support the growth of our company. If you're a recruiter with a passion for finding top talent and a proven track record of success in complex high volume recruiting, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: this is a fully remote, 6 month fixed term contract position based in Australia (Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane).

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Deliver on recruiting goals and prioritise workload to meet deadlines and evolving business needs.
  • Attract, source, recruit, and engage top talent for Toast’s GTM functions, predominantly Sales.
  • Proactively build and maintain strong talent pipelines through strategic sourcing, leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, referrals, professional networks, and creative outreach strategies to identify and engage passive candidates.
  • Own end-to-end sourcing strategies for assigned roles, including market research, competitor mapping, targeted outreach, and nurturing relationships with prospective candidates to support current and future hiring needs.
  • Exercise sound judgment and decision-making throughout the recruitment process, balancing business needs with candidate experience.
  • Skillfully navigate complex and ambiguous hiring scenarios, partnering with hiring managers to clarify requirements, align expectations, and drive decision-making.
  • Build strong relationships with hiring managers through regular recruiting syncs, effective communication, and subject matter expertise.
  • Develop creative sourcing and recruitment solutions, adapting strategies to address talent shortages, competitive market conditions, and changing business priorities.
  • Leverage sourcing data, pipeline conversion rates, and key recruitment metrics to evaluate effectiveness, optimise strategies, and deliver efficient and impactful hiring outcomes.
  • Provide exceptional service to candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a positive and memorable experience throughout the recruitment process.
  • Share ideas, provide updates, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve recruitment practices.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 3+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience with a proven track record of recruiting across GTM functions, preferably Field Sales roles.
  • Demonstrated depth and breadth of experience in high-volume recruiting, successfully partnering with hiring managers to fill roles across various GTM functions.
  • Proficiency in leveraging recruitment data and metrics to impact hiring decisions.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively.
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

  • Experience using Greenhouse as an ATS 
  • Experience scheduling with GoodTime
  • Experience recruiting for sales talent at a SaaS company 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

#LI-REMOTE

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

title: Territory Account Executive - Brisbane
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. You will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your territory. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Toast across Brisbane.

This is a field sales opportunity. Candidates must live locally to Brisbane, Australia or be willing to relocate.

About this roll*: (Responsibilities)

  • Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting, initial call to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 1+ years experience in a sourcing or closing sales role, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry
  • Founder mentality to work on 0-1 deals, and ability (and enjoyment) to navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced and new environment
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation (we will reimburse for mileage)
  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible
  • General technical proficiency with software

title: Hybrid Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
Note: We are excited to kick off recruitment for our January and February cohorts! We are currently accepting and reviewing new applications for both start dates.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Hybrid Development Representative (HDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of Account Executives. This is not a static job - it is a dedicated, supportive launchpad and structured path for your professional sales career. We invest in HDRs with the clear expectation that high performers will advance through our specialized sales program, Toast Sales Academy, and become future full-cycle Account Executives.

The Journey of a High Performer: HDR → All Bound Sales Development role → Account Executive (AE)

The Timeline of a High Performer: 12-18 months, training to become an Account Executive 

What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Hybrid Development Representative (HDR), you serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.

  • Complete at least 100 high-quality outreach activities daily (warm/cold calls, emails, and social touch points).
  • Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Learn and execute on various inbound and outbound outreach methods to prepare for specialization into an All-Bound Sales Development Role with the ultimate goal of developing into an Account Executive.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • Career Ambition: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.
  • High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers.
  • Aptitude for Critical Thinking: Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 100+ daily outreach activities.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

  • Previous Sales or Sales Internship experience
  • Experience participating in Collegiate Sales Competitions
  • Direct experience working in the hospitality or retail industries

AI at ToastAt Toast we’re Hungry to Build and Learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards PhilosophyWe strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits..

This role qualifies for uncapped commissions. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A$75,000—$120,000 USDZone B$65,000—$104,000 USDZone C$59,000—$94,000 USD

title: Credit Risk Senior Analyst - CECL Reporting, Loss Forecasting
descriptionHtml:
Credit Risk Senior Analyst 

We are a rapidly growing company that’s revolutionizing the way the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

The Fintech Risk team at Toast is responsible for driving risk informed growth for the rapidly expanding Toast Fintech line of business. We are seeking a Lead Credit Risk Strategist as part of the team, with a focus on the portfolio risk management space. You will partner with cross-functional analysts and senior leadership to decode complex portfolio risk trends, refine our loss forecasting models, develop and oversee line management strategies for credit cards and other revolving products, and build the early-warning defenses that allow us to stay resilient under stress and profitable in any market cycle. If you have an analytic and data driven mindset, eye for detail and can-do attitude then you are right for this position.

Responsibilities :

  • CECL Reporting: Oversee the monthly CECL calculations and reporting process, collaborating closely with accounting and strategic finance teams to ensure the robustness of methodology and accuracy of loss reserve calculations.
  • Loss Forecasting: Refine existing loss forecasting models / methodologies which feed into monthly CECL calculations, to improve the overall accuracy and stability of forecasts. Develop loss projection and expected loss estimation methodologies for revolving products (e.g. credit card). 
  • Portfolio Risk Strategy: Define, implement, and continuously improve the portfolio risk management strategy (including collections), ensuring alignment with company appetite. 
  • Risk Reporting and Monitoring: Develop and maintain a comprehensive and timely reporting framework to provide risk visibility to management, ensuring that risk and return are optimized and in line with company goals. Define and monitor key KPIs
  • Emerging Risk Identification and Mitigation: Proactively identify emerging risks and propose data-driven mitigation solutions to minimize potential losses and optimize returns.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with Product Management, Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Accounting, and Strategic Finance teams, driving alignment and facilitating data-driven decision-making.
  • Policy Management: Maintain and update CECL methodology documents and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory and audit requirements.

Data enhancement and enrichment: Work with product and engineering to make sure that right data is in the pipelines for reporting and analytics

Requirements :

  • 5+ years of experience in consumer or small business lending in a quantitative risk strategy / analytics role, with hands-on experience in loss forecasting and expected loss estimation.
  • Quantitative degree (Mathematics/Statistics/Economics/Operations Research) preferred, Masters Degree or MBA a plus
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python/R, with experience in data visualization tools such as Hex/ Tableau/Looker/Sigma
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • An inquisitive nature, with a passion for exploring variances, understanding root causes, and driving data-driven decision-making
  • Proven ability to navigate a cross-functional, non-hierarchical environment, fostering collaboration and driving alignment across teams
  • Highly analytical bent of mind and ability to solve complex problems
  • Experience in working in credit cards, term loan products
  • Bachelors degree is mandatory

descriptionHtml:
Location: California, USA  #LI-HYBRID #BI-HYBRID

Who We Are

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast currently serves hundreds of multi-unit brands, including Caribou Coffee, Choice Hotels, Craveworthy Brands, WaBa Grill, Nothing Bundt Cakes, Papa Gino's & D'Angelo, Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill, and The Human Bean, among others. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our enterprise drive-thru team and help us build the best-in-class drive-thru solutions that enable significant future growth. You will get to work across the entire Toast platform, including our scalable backend, customer-facing web apps, and everything else in between. As a member of the Drive-Thru Enterprise team, you will help ensure our products are built to meet the evolving needs of these customers. You can read more on our Toast for Enterprise Page.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features across Toast’s enterprise management products
  • Hands-on design and implementation of Android applications in Kotlin
  • Lead complex projects that improve the functionality and reliability of our products
  • Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
  • Contribute to the overall quality of the Android and backend systems
  • Collaborate with UX, PM, QA, and Engineering to define, design, and build best-in-class solutions in a complex and fast-moving environment
  • Guide the growth & development of peer engineers with mentoring and coaching

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of prior experience developing and maintaining Android applications
  • Experience with distributed systems, enterprise messaging systems, and/or microservices
  • Proficient with modern API standards and technologies (e.g., REST, GraphQL)
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving engineering practices
  • Proven track record of technical leadership and contribution to complex projects
  • Has a growth mindset with an emphasis on improving yourself and your team
  • Balances getting things done with platform stability
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science

What we use to make our dish (Our Tech Stack)

  • A core of Java & Kotlin based backend services.
  • React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL, and Storybook.
  • Android app built in Java & Kotlin.
  • PostgreSQL and DynamoDB as core persistence.
  • Pulsar, Camel, and RabbitMQ for message-based integrations.
  • And many more technologies that help us build a top-class platform.

title: Product Manager, Toast IQ Evaluation
department: R & D : Product : Customer Experience Platform
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. At the center of this vision is Toast IQ: a single, unified assistant that orchestrates specialized agents across the Toast ecosystem. The Toast IQ Quality team makes sure Toast IQ delivers useful, reliable help to restaurant operators.

About the Role

As Product Manager, Toast IQ Evaluation, you’ll define what good help looks like for a restaurant operator and build the evidence that tells us whether Toast IQ delivers it. You’ll study real usage, work directly with operators, and turn what you learn into datasets, clear quality standards, and priorities for improvement. Your work will help teams across Toast understand where the assistant succeeds, where it falls short, and identify new opportunities for improvement. This is a hands-on product role. Much of your week will be spent reviewing sessions, labeling examples, investigating failures, and building better ways to do that work. Restaurant judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to turn evidence into action are central to the job. You’ll be the team’s first restaurant domain expert, working alongside engineers from one prioritized backlog and reporting through Product.

A Day in the life (Responsibilities):

  • Understand the operator’s experience. Review real Toast IQ sessions every week. Describe what went wrong in plain operator language. Work directly with operators, including in live sessions, to check that our evaluations reflect what matters to them.
  • Find and prioritize recurring failures. Group observations into failure modes, measure how often they occur, and assess their impact on operators. Use that evidence to identify the problems most worth solving.
  • Build trustworthy evaluation datasets. Create and maintain labeled examples covering common workflows, edge cases, and known failures.
  • Verify that improvements hold up. Validate fixes in real sessions and turn important production failures into regression cases that catch the same problems in future releases.
  • Help teams across Toast evaluate their work. Lead reviewer calibration sessions and help product teams create and maintain evaluation cases for their capabilities.
  • Turn findings into product decisions. Surface tools that aren’t delivering value, intents Toast IQ can’t handle, and workflows that need a product team’s attention. Make the operator’s problem and its impact clear enough to act on.
  • Build tools that make the work better. Use AI coding tools to create faster review interfaces, automate recurring analysis, monitor common failures, and prototype fixes. Look for opportunities to improve every step from session review through validation.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Restaurant knowledge: You’ve worked in a restaurant or closely with operators. You understand how decisions about menus, labor, sales, and inventory play out during a busy Friday night. This matters more than your years of product experience.
  • Care for detailed work: You’re comfortable reading hundreds of transcripts, labeling examples by hand, and keeping datasets accurate and current.
  • Comfort with structured data: You can investigate data using a database, queries, or an AI coding tool and check that the results are trustworthy.
  • Precise thinking and writing: You can turn an ambiguous observation into a clear failure definition or scoring rule that someone else can apply consistently.
  • Clear communication: You can explain what happened, why it matters to operators, and what should change in language that engineers, product teams, and leadership can use.
  • Curiosity about AI systems: You want to understand how large language model systems fail and are willing to learn new evaluation methods on the job. 
  • Familiarity with Toast's products: You’ll work closely with product teams across Toast, and knowing their products gives you a leg up in advising them.

Product management experience is highly valued, but it is not required. We care about the practice: identify a problem, understand it, explore solutions, build, measure, and iterate. If you’ve done that work under another title, we’d like to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:

Toast is entering its next phase of growth, and our People Technology team is building the foundation that will help us scale. We are creating a connected, integrated technology ecosystem that simplifies how work gets done and delivers seamless, intuitive self-service experiences for our Toasters (employees) and leaders.

About this Roll* (The Role)

  • Problem Framing & Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a trusted technical advisor to People Technology and business leaders. Lead discovery to clarify the real problem, desired outcomes, and constraints before solutioning. Set clear expectations on scope, trade-offs, and timelines.
  • Architecture & Strategy: Define integration architecture patterns, standards, and roadmap for the People tech ecosystem. Evaluate build vs. buy, point-to-point vs. middleware or event-driven approaches, and emerging tools such as Workday Extend, iPaaS, and AI.
  • Design & Build: Develop, test, and deploy scalable Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, PECI, and Web Services. Stay hands-on with the most complex and highest-risk builds.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Own integrations from discovery and architecture through testing, deployment, hypercare, and ongoing optimization, including high-stakes moments like Open Enrollment, payroll cycles, and major go-lives.
  • Prioritization & Influence: Balance competing requests across People functions using clear criteria tied to business impact and risk. Influence Enterprise Architecture, Security, and external vendors on design decisions, and hold partners to a high technical bar.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive root-cause analysis on production failures and lead systemic fixes that reduce technical debt, manual handoffs, and failure rates.
  • Health & Governance: Strengthen monitoring, alerting, logging, error handling, and release testing (including Workday biannual updates) so issues are caught before they affect the business. Protect sensitive employee data (PII, compensation, ER) through secure-by-design practices.

Create clear documentation (runbooks, integration specs, data flow diagrams), lead design reviews, and mentor others on integration best practices.

  • Technical Leadership: Create clear documentation (runbooks, integration specs, data flow diagrams) and mentor peers on integration standards and best practices.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • 8+ years of integration engineering experience, including 5+ years designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Core Technical Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, PECI, Workday Web Services, RaaS, calculated fields, and custom reporting.
  • Data Protocols & Formats: Strong working knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, XSLT, JSON, WSDL, XPath, SFTP, and HTTPS.
  • Security & Auth Standards: Experience applying OAuth 2.0, SAML, SSL/TLS, and PGP encryption to sensitive data flows.
  • Architecture Judgment: A track record of making and defending sound design trade-offs (speed vs. technical debt, synchronous vs. asynchronous, build vs. buy) in systems that scale.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to partner with non-technical business leaders, ask the right questions to uncover the real need, and explain complex technical trade-offs in plain language.

  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills, with experience troubleshooting production integrations and driving permanent fixes through Jira or ServiceNow.
  • Domain Context: Solid understanding of core HR functional areas (HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Time & Attendance) and effective-dated HR data.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

title: Engineering Lead, New Ventures
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid)

About Toast

Toast builds technology that helps food and beverage businesses run smoother, serve customers better, and grow with confidence. Our platform brings together the tools teams need to power daily operations—while turning complexity into clear, actionable insights. We're purpose-built for the pace of hospitality, and we're investing in new experiences that make great businesses easier to run at any scale.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

We're looking for an Engineering Lead to join our New Ventures team and help build one of Toast's newest products from 0 to 1. You will lead a tight-knit team of 5 highly experienced engineers as a true player/coach—where your primary focus is driving engineering velocity, hands-on problem solving, and outsized impact. You'll lead by example, helping the team discover new ways of working and building with the tools of the day to optimize for speed, customer impact, and the right shared norms.

You will partner closely with our Product Lead to drive weekly sprints. Beyond guiding the team, you will be deeply embedded in the product discovery process and work directly with our customers. We expect you to jump into the codebase to fix bugs, triage issues directly with users, and ensure we're delivering value at top speed without breaking what matters most.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, unblock, and collaborate with a team of 4 highly experienced senior engineers, fostering a culture of rapid iteration and technical excellence.
  • Act as a player/coach, actively writing code, jumping in to fix bugs, and triaging customer issues to ensure a tight feedback loop.
  • Partner directly with the Product Lead on weekly sprints to decide what we'll build each week, weighing technical tradeoffs together.
  • Help the team pioneer new ways of working by integrating the tools of the day into our daily development processes.
  • Establish shared norms, guardrails, and best practices that allow the team to move at top speed while maintaining high quality where it counts.
  • Navigate the broader Toast ecosystem to unblock your team, leading technical collaboration with other engineering and platform groups when cross-team dependencies are needed to bring new capabilities to life.
  • Stay exceptionally close to the customer, participating in feedback sessions and directly solving their pain points.
  • Partner with your senior engineers to shape the technical strategy and architecture for a 0-to-1 product, guiding the team toward pragmatic decisions that balance speed-to-market with long-term viability.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

title: Staff Software Engineer, Android
descriptionHtml:
Staff Software Engineer, Android

Location: Remote USA 

Who We Are

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast currently serves hundreds of multi-unit brands, including Caribou Coffee, Choice Hotels, Craveworthy Brands, WaBa Grill, Nothing Bundt Cakes, Papa Gino's & D'Angelo, Costa Vida Fresh Mexican Grill, and The Human Bean, among others. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our enterprise drive-thru team and help us build the best-in-class drive-thru solutions that enable significant future growth. You will get to work across the entire Toast platform, including our scalable backend, customer-facing web apps, and everything else in between. As a member of the Drive-Thru Enterprise team, you will help ensure our products are built to meet the evolving needs of these customers. You can read more on our Toast for Enterprise Page.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Define the long-term technical strategy and architecture for the Drive-Thru domain, balancing immediate delivery with long-term maintainability.
  • Standardize Android best practices across the organization, influencing how multiple teams build and deploy mobile features.
  • Architect the interface between mobile clients and complex backend services to ensure offline-resiliency in high-volume drive-thru environments.
  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features across Toast’s enterprise management products.
  • Identify high-impact opportunities within the Drive-Thru ecosystem and partner with Product and UX leadership to define the roadmap.
  • Bridge the gap between Android and backend systems to ensure a seamless, end-to-end enterprise experience.
  • Guide the growth & development of peer engineers with mentoring and coaching.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence by driving innovation and continuously improving engineering practices.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 8+ years of experience developing and maintaining Android applications
  • Experience with distributed systems, enterprise messaging systems, and/or microservices
  • Proficient with modern API standards and technologies (e.g., REST, GraphQL)
  • Proven track record of leading teams through major architectural transformations and delivering high-impact, scalable solutions in multi-product environments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving engineering practices
  • Proven ability to influence non-technical stakeholders and align technical debt reduction with business value
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science

What we use to make our dish (Our Tech Stack)

department: R & D : BTT : Finance, Orders & Subscriptions Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview:

The Lead Salesforce Developer within the BTT (Business Technology and Transformation) team will collaborate with other developers, architects, admins, QA and release and Engineering managers to deliver new innovative solutions on the Salesforce platform. Toast has ambitious plans for the future, and this role will assist in making them happen.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Spends majority of their time working on Salesforce related solution, design development tasks, requiring a high degree of technical expertise, like:
    • Salesforce platform - Security, Sharing, Visibility, Data Model, Flows etc
    • APEX- Triggers, Platform Event handlers, batch processes, Async processes, frameworks & patterns etc
    • Salesforce CPQ configuration and implementation.Deep understanding of the nuances within the Quote-to-Cash domain.
    • Web Services - Rest, SOAP, Authentication, Authorization, Patterns etc
    • VF pages, Aura and Lightning Web components
  • Mentoring, guiding and supporting team members on their assignments and be a bar raiser.
  • Follows design, architecture and development best practices
  • Performs code reviews and is actively involved in deployment processes
    • Experience with GitHub tooling and PR process
    • Follows appropriate review etiquette
    • Passion for ensuring we deliver the highest quality code
  • Actively involved in deployment processes
    • Identification of affected components
    • Merging of code with the rest of the code base
    • Identification and resolution of merge conflicts
    • Development of adequate tests that cover and validate code
  • Assists in developing project estimates and plans for self and others
    •  Accurate sizing of stories based on SCRUM process
    • On time delivery of work
    • Timely escalation of blockers
  •  Proficiency troubleshooting issues
    • Leverage Developer Console, Workbench and other troubleshooting tools
    • Analyze Salesforce Debug Logs for errors and performance issues
  • Proactively seeks out and keeps up-to-date on Salesforce technologies, related tools, and best practices
  • Proactive in highlighting issues, concerns and blocker to ensure timely delivery.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 10+ years Salesforce solution, design & development experience (Apex, Lightning, VF) in an Enterprise environment
  • Advanced experience with sharing, security, visibility, data models, Flows and other Salesforce platform features & components.
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.(Experience Cloud a plus)
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ configuration and implementation.
  • Experience in Salesforce CPQ Products, Features, Options, Configuration Attributes.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ Product Rules, Pricing Rules, Lookup Queries.
  • Experience with Salesforce Discounting, contracts, quote templates, and renewals.
  • Experience in the Quote to Cash Domain (preferably CPQ (Salesforce CPQ/Conga/Industry CPQ)  and/or Billing (Zuora/Salesforce Billing/Conga Billing)) 
  • Experience in leading the team of developers for the delivery of the projects/features
  • Advanced understanding of the Software Development Life cycle and Agile methodologies
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work independently and support other team members as needed.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I & II certifications
  • Salesforce CPQ certification a plus
  • Experience in stakeholder management and should be able to communicate effectively.
  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly.
  • Engineering / Equivalent educational background a must
  • Candidates required to work in hybrid mode with 3 days work from office in a week .

Bonus ingredients* (a pinch of salt): (Non-essential skills)

  • Experience using ServiceNow or similar tool
  • Experience using Jira or similar

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack), Digital Storefront
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid)

Bready* to make a change?

Toast is revolutionizing the way the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

Who We Are

The Digital Storefront team is responsible for advancing and supporting Toast’s consumer facing products such as Online Ordering, Ecommerce, Websites, SEO, Branded Mobile Apps, and Reputation Management. This group is highly product oriented, with a laser-focus on creating top tier consumer experiences for restaurants and their guests. Our product-line is used by millions of restaurant goers each day, so be prepared to innovate on products at a huge scale while ensuring stability and scalability.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

In this role, you'll get to work on a wide variety of projects, using your technical chops to influence not just the code, but also product and business strategies. This is a golden opportunity for a hands-on, entrepreneurial engineer who thrives in a modern tech stack environment and loves solving real-world problems through technology. You’ll run experiments, iterate quickly, and have a strong voice in shaping the future of guest-facing products here at Toast.  Here’s what you’ll be doing:

  • Design, scope, and implement cutting-edge solutions using a mix of technologies.
  • Enhance the platform to boost performance, usability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Product stakeholders to ensure we are building the right solutions to the right problems.
  • Identify high-impact opportunities with your team and turn them into reality.
  • Be an awesome teammate who’s all in on collaboration and collective success.
  • Work across teams to ensure that every part of our product ecosystem works seamlessly together to deliver the best possible experience for our customers.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of experience as a professional software engineer
  • Familiar with backend technologies like Java/Kotlin and NodeJS
  • Familiar with frontend frameworks like React or Angular, and CSS frameworks like Tailwind or Bootstrap
  • Experienced in building on AWS, with tools like Docker and Git
  • Comfortable turning high-fidelity UX designs from Figma into reality
  • Passionate about writing testable code, with experience in API design and unit/integration testing
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-based environment where you ship features together

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding its offerings into other food and beverage concepts such as convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. This role will require a founder’s mindset as we grow Toast’s presence in this new vertical with a new offering: the Toast Retail platform. 

As a Retail Account Executive, you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new accounts. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion, sales expertise, and entrepreneurial spirit to help us build the Toast brand in an assigned geographic territory.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Use a consultative approach to prospect, build relationships, and sign up new convenience stores, grocery stores and bottle shops
  • Generate lists of prospective convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close 
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery 
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities 
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • An entrepreneurial and feedback-driven mindset
  • Strong communication, organizational, and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
  • Self-motivated, creative, flexible, and willing to navigate ambiguity

Lives in or in proximity to market and willingness to travel 25% or more

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Retail operations experience

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards PhilosophyWe strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The estimated Total Targeted Cash compensation range for this role is listed below. Total Targeted Cash for this role includes base salary, commission, and bonus (if eligible). This role qualifies for uncapped commissions. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards components include benefits and equity (if eligible). You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

title: Principal Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. We’ve grown into a leading hospitality software company in the U.S., and are now entering our next phase of growth—one defined by scale, complexity, and a new class of enterprise customers.

Every restaurant is unique, and a restaurant’s menu expresses its individual brand and product offerings. Inside a Toast restaurant, the definition of the menu becomes the common language between guests, servers, and the kitchen. In our digital ordering products, a great menu serves as both a billboard and a roadmap to an excellent dining experience. It is the central hub for restaurant configuration– it determines what guests can order, how the dishes are presented and priced in different contexts, where they are routed for fulfillment and how they are coursed, how they are prepared, whether the ingredients are still available, and how they are classified for reporting. A menu is always evolving: kitchens create new dishes, managers experiment with pricing and presentation, and staff optimize the menu for restaurant operations. 

We create products to satisfy the vast breadth of our restaurants, from single-location coffee shops to complex enterprise brands with thousands of locations. We offer an extremely powerful and configurable menu platform, and our team exists to ensure that this flexibility can be managed effectively at any scale. This includes feature-rich menu data models, APIs for both first and third party integrations (eg: DoorDash and other ordering partners), and the user experiences for configuring menus that meet a vast variety of needs, from complex customer segments (eg: Pizza shops) to our evolving Retail platform. 

We are looking for a visionary engineer who is motivated by these challenges and eager to transform our menus architecture to meet the dynamic needs of our customers and our rapidly growing business. As a Principal Software Engineer on the Menus team, you will take ownership of this essential function, making strategic technical decisions that enhance our capabilities and ensure scalability. You will have the opportunity to make a huge impact in a critical space. Your leadership will drive excellence within the team and influence our broader engineering community, setting new standards and contributing to our collective success.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Lead the evolution of our Menus architecture and data models, delivering scalable solutions that have significant business impact.
  • Define and implement frameworks and processes that guarantee the quality, resilience, and scalability of our user experiences and API platform.
  • Develop and execute technical strategies to solve complex business challenges, leveraging data-driven decisions to prioritize impactful changes.
  • Establish guiding technical and delivery principles that influence engineering practices across the broader engineering organization.
  • Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, inclusivity, and engineering excellence.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships across lines of business, aligning technical solutions with strategic objectives.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • Minimum education: BE or B.Tech in a technology-related field
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong background in back-end development using Java, Kotlin, or other object-oriented language
  • Proficient with modern API standards and technologies (e.g. REST, GraphQL)
  • Proficient with relational databases and alternative data stores
  • Experience with distributed systems, enterprise messaging systems, and/or microservices
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-impact, scalable solutions in complex, multi-product environments.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding teams through architectural transformations.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving engineering practices.

title: Senior Manager, IT Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, IT Delivery - a technical, hands-on "player-coach" who will serve as the strategic execution engine for our Information Technology department. Reporting to the Senior Manager of IT Systems, you will bridge the gap between our high-performing engineering leaders and teams and evolving business needs. This role is designed for a proactive decision-maker who deeply understands system architecture and can navigate ambiguity to drive high-visibility, cross-functional initiatives across the IT ecosystem.

The Team & Impact: You will manage a single Project Manager and support five specialized units: MDM, SaaS, Network, ServiceNow DevOps, and Compliance (UAR Coordination). Your success is measured by your ability to; unblock technical bottlenecks, onboard, consolidate and integrate tooling, find efficiencies in processes and tech, proactively identify and address end user pain points, and act as a credible, highly communicative face for IT across the enterprise.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Hands-On Delivery: Lead the end-to-end execution of critical IT systems initiatives (e.g., SailPoint/Identity Governance integrations and deployments, new tool deployment, User Access Reviews, and major system integrations).
  • Ecosystem Integration & Decision Making: Drive holistic decisions across IT domains by understanding how core platforms (such as Identity, Service Management, and Collaboration tools) integrate and operate together.
  • Roadmap & Analytical Reporting: Partner closely with IT Leaders to Define success metrics for IT programs and build dashboards to track enterprise-wide impact, regularly publishing post-mortems and trend analyses to inform future technical and strategic decisions.
  • IT Enablement & User Adoption: Drive enterprise-wide user adoption for the tech stack. Create and scale training programs, publish technical release notes, and maintain a centralized documentation repository.
  • Strategic Liaison: Serve as the highly communicative primary point of contact between IT domains (Systems, Security, Infrastructure) and external business stakeholders, translating complex technical infrastructure into clear business value.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Experience: 7+ years of IT enterprise system ownership, ideally in environments of 7,000+ users.
  • Core Systems Knowledge: Demonstrated, hands-on familiarity with core IT industry tools, specifically ServiceNow, SailPoint (or similar IGA platforms), Okta, AWS, Google Workspace, and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence), MDM and Security Agent tooling. You must understand how these tools operate and integrate at a foundational level.
  • Ambiguity Navigation & Decision-Making: Proven ability to drive projects forward and make strategic decisions when there is a lack of defined structure or resources.
  • Matrix Leadership: Strong history of driving cross-functional teams that do not directly report to you and unblocking technical dependencies.
  • Exceptional Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; a polished presenter who can confidently and professionally distill complex technical concepts into accessible, clear updates for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Pragmatic Execution: A focus on rolling up your sleeves to drive execution, prioritizing real-world outcomes over rigid adherence to project management methodologies.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Background in IT Business Operations or IT Service Management (ITSM).
  • Experience utilizing data analytics tools (e.g., Snowflake, Power BI, or HEX) to build executive-facing performance and capacity dashboards
  • Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies

title: Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative - Mandarin
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Hybrid Development Representative (HDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of Account Executives. This is not a static job - it is a dedicated, supportive launchpad and structured path for your professional sales career. We invest in HDRs with the clear expectation that high performers will advance through our specialized sales program, Toast Sales Academy, and become future full-cycle Account Executives.

The Journey of a High Performer: HDR → All Bound Sales Development role → Account Executive (AE)

The Timeline of a High Performer: 12-18 months, training to become an Account Executive 

What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative (HDR), you serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.

  • Complete at least 100 high-quality outreach activities daily (warm/cold calls, emails, and social touch points).
  • Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Learn and execute on various inbound and outbound outreach methods to prepare for specialization into an All-Bound Sales Development Role with the ultimate goal of developing into an Account Executive.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • Bilingual Fluency: Must be fluent in Mandarin and English - able to read, write, and speak.
  • Career Ambition: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.
  • High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers.
  • Aptitude for Critical Thinking: Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 100+ daily outreach activities.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

  • Previous Sales or Sales Internship experience
  • Experience participating in Collegiate Sales Competitions
  • Direct experience working in the hospitality or retail industries

Note: Toast will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this role.

title: GTM Engineer - Sales Workflow Automation, Revenue Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
The GTM AI Transformation team is hiring a GTM Engineer to build the agents and automations that run inside Toast's sales motion. You'll write production code in Python against Salesforce, Snowflake, and LLM APIs, extend our sales AI platform (Myko) with custom integrations, and turn call transcripts and deal data into actions that reach reps and managers without anyone asking for them. This is a builder role. You'll own systems from prototype through production operation, and the measure of success is whether reps use what you ship and close faster because of it. You'll report to the Senior Manager of GTM AI Transformation and work day to day with sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Enablement, and Toast's Data and Engineering teams. The role is fully remote in the United States.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Agentic workflows that automate high-volume sales work end to end: follow-up drafting, deal stage updates, task creation, and Slack and CRM notifications, with approval gates and handoffs that keep reps in control.
  • Integrations between our prospecting agents and adjacent systems (quoting, pricing, case creation) so a rep can go from signal to action without leaving their workflow.
  • Pipelines that pull conversation intelligence transcripts into Snowflake and the CRM, and services on top of them that produce next best actions, deal risk flags, and coaching recommendations for frontline managers.
  • The production controls around all of it: evals that catch regressions before reps see them, observability tied to pipeline and revenue outcomes, permissions and sensitive-data handling, error recovery and rollback.
  • A third-party signal layer (intent, news, firmographic change) that flows into account prioritization, and the win/loss data capture that tells us what's working.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Proficiency in Python (TypeScript also works) and strong SQL. You write production-grade, tested code, and you can read, modify, and debug code you didn't write, including code generated by AI tools.
  • At least one LLM-powered workflow or agent you built that a business team used in production, built against an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) or an agent framework (LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, or similar), with tool calling, error handling, and some form of evaluation. You'll be asked to walk through it.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience: data model, Flow, APIs, permissions, and what happens when an integration writes bad data at scale.
  • Comfort working directly in a data warehouse (Snowflake preferred) for pipeline QA, transformation, and validation.
  • Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, auth, and integration troubleshooting across SaaS systems.
  • Typically 4 to 6+ years in GTM Engineering, Business Systems, Solutions or Forward Deployed Engineering, Data Engineering, or software engineering applied to sales or marketing. We weigh the depth of what you've shipped over the title you held.
  • You can explain a technical tradeoff to a sales VP and a data model to an engineer in the same week.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • MCP, RAG, or eval framework experience; you've thought about how to know whether an agent is getting better or worse.
  • Salesforce Apex or Platform Developer certification.
  • dbt or similar transformation tooling.
  • Experience with conversation intelligence (Gong, Chorus) or sales engagement platform APIs.
  • Enrichment and signal tooling (Clay, ZoomInfo, Demandbase) and what to do when the data disagrees.
  • Reporting in Tableau, Looker, or Sigma.
  • You've worked in a multi-product, multi-segment sales motion in SaaS or fintech.

title: Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative - Mandarin
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Hybrid Development Representative (HDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of Account Executives. This is not a static job - it is a dedicated, supportive launchpad and structured path for your professional sales career. We invest in HDRs with the clear expectation that high performers will advance through our specialized sales program, Toast Sales Academy, and become future full-cycle Account Executives.

The Journey of a High Performer: HDR → All Bound Sales Development role → Account Executive (AE)

The Timeline of a High Performer: 12-18 months, training to become an Account Executive 

What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative (HDR), you serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.

  • Complete at least 100 high-quality outreach activities daily (warm/cold calls, emails, and social touch points).
  • Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Learn and execute on various inbound and outbound outreach methods to prepare for specialization into an All-Bound Sales Development Role with the ultimate goal of developing into an Account Executive.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • Bilingual Fluency: Must be fluent in Mandarin and English - able to read, write, and speak.
  • Career Ambition: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.
  • High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers.
  • Aptitude for Critical Thinking: Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 100+ daily outreach activities.

title: Data Scientist II
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

Toast is revolutionizing the way the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

Bready* to make a change?

The Toast AI Engineering team is seeking a Data Scientist to embed data science capabilities into the Toast platform by partnering with engineers and product managers to develop statistical and machine learning models that power key product lines.

About this Roll* (Responsibilities):

  • Apply a diverse set of expertise including data mining, statistical analysis and machine learning to deliver impactful, objective, and actionable data insights that enable informed business and product decisions
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and product, to identify business opportunities and develop data-driven solutions that drive growth and engagement.

Do you have the right ingredients* (Requirements)?

  • 2+ years of data science experience in an industry environment.

title: Product Designer, Point of Sale
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred


Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, we don't just build software; we power the heartbeat of local communities. As a Product Designer on the Point of Sale team, you will shape the experiences that sit at the center of every restaurant's operation, the tools servers, bartenders, and front-of-house staff rely on hundreds of times a day to deliver excellent hospitality. Your mission is to make those moments fast, intuitive, and reliable, no matter how busy the floor gets.

Working within the POS team, you will partner with research, product, and engineering peers to turn complex operational workflows into seamless experiences across Toast's terminal and handheld surfaces. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced reality of restaurant service to understand the "why" behind every tap, swipe, and order modification, using your design expertise to create tools that help restaurant staff move with confidence, reduce errors, and focus on what matters most: the guest.

We are looking for a designer with a Founder's Mentality: someone who takes uncompromising ownership of their domain and has a relentless commitment to customer success. If you are ready to master your craft and help build the future of restaurant operations, we want you on the line with us.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own and drive the end-to-end design process for Point of Sale experiences, moving from early discovery and concept development through high-fidelity execution with strong autonomy.
  • Translate complex operational workflows — order taking, modifications, payments, splits, and voids — into experiences that are fast, error-resistant, and easy to learn on the fly.
  • Design for the realities of restaurant service: high-pressure environments, time-sensitive decisions, and users who can't stop and read instructions during a dinner rush.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Research to define how POS capabilities come to life across terminal and handheld surfaces, balancing technical constraints with user needs.
  • Create polished, high-fidelity artifacts that account for edge cases, hardware contexts, and the full range of restaurant types and service styles Toast supports.
  • Make work visible early and often, using prototypes and storytelling to build alignment and communicate tradeoffs across cross-functional partners.
  • Champion the server and front-of-house perspective in every design decision, ensuring that speed, clarity, and reliability are never compromised.
  • Contribute to design critiques and team collaboration, and integrate emerging AI-first tools and methods into your practice to accelerate exploration and execution.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • You have a demonstrated ability to use data and insights, including business metrics and user research, to substantiate design decisions and drive impact.
  • You hold a high bar for design excellence. Your portfolio shows a disciplined process that accounts for fine details, edge cases, and complex real-world constraints.
  • You are innately collaborative and actively manage stakeholders. Your collaborative style inspires others, and you build the dependability needed to enact influence with cross-functional partners.
  • You excel at untangling ambiguity, breaking down complex workflows into intuitive, end-to-end user journeys.
  • You understand what it means to design for speed and reliability — your instinct is to reduce friction, not add features.
  • You take an AI-first design approach to quickly create conceptual prototypes but also possess strong visual design skills to polish beautiful and intuitive end-to-end journeys across multiple surfaces.
  • 3+ years in product design, showing clear progression from executing tasks to owning broader product outcomes.

Please include a portfolio link with your application.

title: Staff Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead the design and development of scalable ML systems for use cases such as menu recommendation, demand forecasting, offer targeting, and guest personalization. You will serve as a technical thought partner across teams, set best practices, and influence the roadmap for ML-driven products that support key business outcomes. Your work will directly shape strategic decisions and enhance customer experience at scale.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own the full machine learning lifecycle—from problem framing and data exploration to modeling, deployment, and monitoring—for mission-critical initiatives.
  • Design and implement advanced ML and statistical models that improve product performance, operational efficiency, or customer insights.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to define project scope, success metrics, and integration strategy.
  • Guide architectural decisions, set modeling standards, and champion best practices for experimentation, validation, and productionization.
  • Mentor other data scientists and raise the technical bar through design reviews, feedback, and sharing domain expertise.
  • Proactively identify areas where data science can create business value and lead cross-functional efforts to drive those opportunities forward.
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 7+ years of experience in data science with a proven track record of delivering production ML systems that drive measurable impact.
  • Deep knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning (e.g., tree-based models, time series, deep learning), and model evaluation.
  • Experience working with real-world product data at scale and translating ambiguous problems into well-scoped ML solutions.
  • Experience with distributed data processing and training, real-time inference, and ML Ops frameworks
  • Prior experience mentoring other data scientists or acting as a tech lead.
  • Experience leading experimentation (e.g., A/B testing), causal inference, and real-time decision systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Strong grasp of software engineering principles including modular design, version control, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), including tools like SageMaker, Athena, Glue, DynamoDB, and Bedrock.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical solutions with company goals.
  • Experience building services on top of LLMs in a large scale production environment.

Bonus ingredients*:

  • An advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related STEM field is preferred.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling for monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and explainability.
  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs and applying reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to improve model performance and alignment.

title: Android Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Are you interested in using the latest technology to help our customers build amazing relationships with their guests? Does the idea of developing products that help people cherish their best moments in life sound exciting to you? As an engineer on the Guest Engagement team, your mission will be creating the next generation of engagement experiences that help bring new guests into the restaurants, and turn them into regulars. You will work closely with UX, PM and QA, and have access to state of the art AI tools, to deliver some real impact on real people.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build and maintain high performing, flexible, and scalable Android solutions running on Toast POS hardware in thousands of restaurants
  • Ship features end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring for success and iterating based on real-world use
  • Build great UX using best practices of modern Android development
  • Be an awesome teammate who's all in on collaboration and collective success
  • Create products and features that help restaurants deliver a best-in-class guest experience
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders, and actively participate in Agile ceremonies
  • Partner with team members and other engineers across the company to raise the bar for the Android experience at Toast

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience with Android development in Kotlin and/or Java, with hands-on experience shipping production Android apps
  • Hands on experience of modern Android tooling and frameworks is a minimum requirement
  • Excited about AI-assisted development and LLM-based agents (Claude Code or similar), and interested in pioneering new workflows with the team
  • Comfortable reading and integrating with backend services (REST/GraphQL) and curious to work across the stack when needed
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, agile delivery, and shipping usable software incrementally
  • Passionate about making users happy and seeing people use your product in the wild
  • Strong on software development fundamentals — code quality, unit tests, clean code — and open to evolving your workflow with AI tooling

Our Tech Stack

  • Android app built in Java & Kotlin running in the restaurant
  • A core of Java & Kotlin based backend services
  • Claude Code and similar AI agentic development tools as part of daily engineering
  • PostgreSQL and DynamoDB as core persistence
  • REST and GraphQL APIs, plus many more technologies that help us build a top-class platform
