title: Manager II, Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Now, more than ever, the Toast team is committed to our customers. We’re taking steps to help restaurants navigate these unprecedented times with technology, resources, and community. Our focus is on building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we’ll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant of the future. 

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is scaling rapidly, bringing an exciting opportunity to join our FinTech organization’s Payments team in Bengaluru. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team dedicated to building our next-generation payments ecosystem and innovative FinTech capabilities. Beyond providing a cutting-edge point-of-sale system for restaurants, Toast processes billions of dollars in payments and offers best-in-class financial solutions. As we build new products to meet customer needs, we focus on optimizing for extensibility, resilience, and scalability using continuous delivery methodologies. This is an impactful opportunity to build and lead a high-performing team delivering strategic FinTech solutions.

As a Engineering Manager on our team, you will:-

  • Drive overall technical architecture, design, build and launch features/improvements on our platform. 
  • Deliver  high-impact complex projects that may span multiple teams and amplify impact by aligning organizations toward coherent architectural strategies
  • Drive delivery of business outcomes across multiple teams, including planning and execution 
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management and UX to get actionable, valuable work defined for the team
  • Ensure end-to-end delivery of software, including team ownership of monitoring and production issue remediation
  • Coach individuals in professional and technical development to set up for their success
  • Hire and mentor Team Leads and Senior Technical Staff members to ensure their success at Toast

The Toast platform processes tens of millions of requests per day, and this number grows constantly as we add new restaurants and integration partners to our system. The services we develop on this team are essential for Toast’s operation and their resilience and reliability are crucial from a business and user perspective.

If you want to help create something tangible that is used every day, help small businesses achieve their vision, and take on the challenge of scaling a SaaS product from millions of users to hundreds of millions of users, Toast is the place for you.

Do you have the right ingredients? (Experience)

  • Fintech products solution design, implementation at launch at scale
  • 10+ years mentoring and growing successful teams
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering or other equivalent quantitative disciplines
  • 5+ years of managing, coaching and growing successful teams
  • Highly proficient knowledge in a high-level programming language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, etc. No problems if you have experience with other languages. Good engineers can adapt.
  • Excellent knowledge in other parts of the stack, Postgres, JavaScript (React), Flutter
  • Enjoys building well-engineered, usable, and accessible systems
  • Experience working in a team with Agile/Scrum methodology
  • Have knowledge of and experience in building backend services/APIs
  • Have a strong understanding of software engineering, distributed systems, and Event Platforms gained from hands-on experience building fault-tolerant and secure applications.
  • You have experience working with product teams to invent solutions that deliver good outcomes to our customers and the company
  • A bias towards action, with the ability to balance between getting things done and making things perfect
  • A strong sense of empathy for customers and teammates
  • A desire to build a diverse team that wins together and prioritizes customer success

Our Tech Stack

Our products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java and Kotlin on DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to DynamoDB to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with service elevations and robust load balancing. We store data in PostgreSQL databases or DynamoDB tables depending on use case, and utilize Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The web frontend is built using React and ES6. Our restaurant point of sale application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. Apache Pulsar and Camel are used extensively in our integration transaction workflow processing.

title: Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative - Mandarin
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Hybrid Development Representative (HDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of Account Executives. This is not a static job - it is a dedicated, supportive launchpad and structured path for your professional sales career. We invest in HDRs with the clear expectation that high performers will advance through our specialized sales program, Toast Sales Academy, and become future full-cycle Account Executives.

The Journey of a High Performer: HDR → All Bound Sales Development role → Account Executive (AE)

The Timeline of a High Performer: 12-18 months, training to become an Account Executive 

What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative (HDR), you serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.

  • Complete at least 100 high-quality outreach activities daily (warm/cold calls, emails, and social touch points).
  • Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Learn and execute on various inbound and outbound outreach methods to prepare for specialization into an All-Bound Sales Development Role with the ultimate goal of developing into an Account Executive.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • Bilingual Fluency: Must be fluent in Mandarin and English - able to read, write, and speak.
  • Career Ambition: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.
  • High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers.
  • Aptitude for Critical Thinking: Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 100+ daily outreach activities.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

  • Previous Sales or Sales Internship experience
  • Experience participating in Collegiate Sales Competitions
  • Direct experience working in the hospitality or retail industries

Note: Toast will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this role.

descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding its offerings into other food and beverage concepts such as convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. This role will require a founder’s mindset as we grow Toast’s presence in this new vertical with a new offering: the Toast Retail platform.

As a Retail Business Development Representative (BDR), you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way Retailers operate. You will serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Generate lists of prospective convenience stores, grocery stores, bottle shops, and other retailers to target. 
    Execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses to determine mutual fit.
    Complete 80 activities daily (cold calls). 
  • Conduct qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our Retail solution.
  • Schedule meetings with qualified prospects for Account Executives, ensuring a seamless handoff and a smooth sales process. 
  • Partner with Account Executives on strategy, talk tracks, and feedback. 
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities. 
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Career Progression: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.
  • High Customer Empathy and Resilience: Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and objections with professionalism while driving positive outcomes for prospective customers.
  • Aptitude for Critical Thinking: Naturally curious, resourceful, and thrives on quickly processing new information to solve complex problems and qualify prospective customers.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 80+ daily outreach activities.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

title: Bilingual Strategic Cuisines Account Executive (Spanish) - OKC/Tulsa
descriptionHtml:

title: Staff Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you’ll lead the design and development of scalable ML systems for use cases such as menu recommendation, demand forecasting, offer targeting, and guest personalization. You will serve as a technical thought partner across teams, set best practices, and influence the roadmap for ML-driven products that support key business outcomes. Your work will directly shape strategic decisions and enhance customer experience at scale.  

This role is for a current vacancy.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own the full machine learning lifecycle—from problem framing and data exploration to modeling, deployment, and monitoring—for mission-critical initiatives.
  • Design and implement advanced ML and statistical models that improve product performance, operational efficiency, or customer insights.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to define project scope, success metrics, and integration strategy.
  • Guide architectural decisions, set modeling standards, and champion best practices for experimentation, validation, and productionization.
  • Mentor other data scientists and raise the technical bar through design reviews, feedback, and sharing domain expertise.
  • Proactively identify areas where data science can create business value and lead cross-functional efforts to drive those opportunities forward.
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of experience in data science with a proven track record of delivering production ML systems that drive measurable impact.
  • Deep knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning (e.g., tree-based models, time series, deep learning), and model evaluation.
  • Experience working with real-world product data at scale and translating ambiguous problems into well-scoped ML solutions.
  • Experience with distributed data processing and training, real-time inference, and ML Ops frameworks
  • Prior experience mentoring other data scientists or acting as a tech lead.
  • Experience leading experimentation (e.g., A/B testing), causal inference, and real-time decision systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Strong grasp of software engineering principles including modular design, version control, testing, and CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), including tools like SageMaker, Athena, Glue, DynamoDB, and Bedrock.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical solutions with company goals.

Bonus ingredients*:

  • An advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related STEM field is preferred.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling for monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and explainability.
  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs and applying reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to improve model performance and alignment.

title: AI Operations Lead, Toast IQ
department: R & D : Product : Customer Experience Platform
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

About the Role: 

Toast IQ is our agentic platform for local business: a growing set of specialized AI agents and capabilities designed to take real work off an operator’s plate, from driving demand and managing labor to optimizing the back office. As we expand this portfolio across multiple lines of business, we need to ensure that what we build comes together as a coherent platform, reaches the market effectively, and produces meaningful customer and business impact.

The AI Operations Lead will help build and run the operating system that connects AI strategy to execution and market impact. You will help shape how our AI portfolio comes together, is launched, and adopted, building the operating engine that brings this experience to life, and turning customer, market, and technology signals into better product and commercial decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with the VP of Product for Toast IQ, partnering across product, design, engineering, marketing, sales, and support to bring the vision of Toast IQ to life. Success will require strong judgment, exceptional communication, and the ability to personally drive ambiguous work to completion.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Create visibility across Toast’s broader AI efforts and run portfolio ops. Connect work happening across the agent portfolio and other AI initiatives. Share learnings, identify opportunities to reuse capabilities, and surface key decisions. Maintain visibility into ownership, sequencing, dependencies, key decisions, risks, progress, and enablement.
  • Build Toast’s AI presence. Partner with product, design, engineering, and marketing to make Toast’s AI products, technical insights, customer outcomes, and talent more visible through launches, customer stories, product and engineering content, and social channels both internally and externally.
  • Turn high-impact ideas into action. Identify opportunities to accelerate Toast’s AI strategy, develop a strong point of view on what we should do, and have the ownership to run at the best ideas, bringing the right people together and driving the work from concept to tangible outcome
  • Help shape the AI portfolio strategy. Partner with product and business leaders to define target customers, priority use cases, positioning, packaging, sequencing, and launch plans across Toast’s AI portfolio.
  • Build an AI-powered engine that gets smarter over time. Use AI to continuously synthesize customer insights, product performance, market shifts, and changes in the underlying technology, turning signals from across the business into actions that improve our products, priorities, and how we bring them to customers.
  • Turn a fast-moving AI market into an advantage. Stay up on what’s happening in AI and help translate emerging patterns into implications for Toast’s strategy 

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Fluent with AI products, including how they work and what patterns are leading within B2B and consumer markets.
  • 5+ years of experience in product operations, business operations, go-to-market strategy, or product marketing, with experience working alongside product and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex or emerging products from development through launch, internal enablement, customer adoption, and ongoing market learning.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex information into a clear narrative for customers, go-to-market teams, and senior leaders. 
  • Track record of building repeatable, cross-functional operating models.
  • Strong product and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into clear customer value and compelling market narratives.
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution, from shaping a portfolio narrative or launch plan to improving a demo, creating enablement, resolving a readiness gap, or synthesizing customer feedback.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience defining the measures that indicate whether a launch is working.
  • High judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity. You recognize what matters, make defensible decisions, surface the right questions, and personally drive work to completion

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience bringing AI/ML, agentic, platform, or other rapidly evolving technical products to market.
  • Experience building a launch, commercialization, or adoption motion.
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where the role required significant range and adaptability.
  • Experience developing customer proof, product demonstrations, or technical thought leadership.
  • Vertical SaaS, SMB, or restaurant and hospitality technology experience.
  • Familiarity with AI product evaluation and the commercial considerations associated with AI products.
  • BA/BS or equivalent practical experience

title: Manager II, Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. We’ve grown into a leading hospitality software company in the U.S., and are now entering our next phase of growth—one defined by scale, complexity, and a new class of enterprise customers.

As our customers grow, so do the demands on our platform. Operators who once managed a handful of locations are rapidly expanding, while new enterprise brands are adopting Toast to power increasingly complex operations. Supporting this evolution requires more robust, enterprise-grade capabilities.

Within this space, we’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager to lead our Partner Connect team. In this role, you’ll guide a team delivering high-impact features that directly shape the experience of every Toast customer. You’ll be responsible not just for what the team builds, but how it builds—driving clarity, improving execution, and maintaining a high bar for quality. Your team will own the frameworks to manage integrations with Toast for all our partners and customers.You will work with the team to help build a feature rich, consistent, unified experience for anyone who wishes to connect to Toasts APIs, consume our data and integrate with restaurants. You will also play a role in evolving our architecture to support ever more complex new features and best-in-class monitoring as we scale to orders of magnitude of our current size!

You’re someone who enjoys developing engineers and building strong, collaborative teams. You connect day-to-day work to broader outcomes, helping your team understand the impact of what they’re building while identifying opportunities to deliver more effectively. You bring enough technical depth to provide clear direction and sound judgment, while still empowering engineers to take ownership.

Day to day, your work will span reviewing design documents and pull requests, facilitating cross-team discussions, partnering with product and architecture on roadmaps, and supporting your team’s growth through regular 1:1s and feedback.

Join us to shape a critical domain that touches every Toast customer.

About this roll*:

  • Help drive the operational plan and strategic roadmap
  • Lead the technical vision and execution for Toast’s partner and integration platforms, driving business impact across the customer lifecycle.
  • Coach individual contributors for professional and technical development 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to help your teams get stuff done
  • Mentor both new and experienced engineers in both technology and leadership
  • Guide teams to build systems that will scale to the next order of magnitude of growth
  • Track and ensure teams are delivering impact and outcomes in their work
  • Drive knowledge sharing programs across the engineering organization
  • Hire and develop new team members
  • Operate effectively in a fast moving environment where experimentation, iteration, and platform stability must coexist.

Do you have the right ingredients*?

  • Experience writing, delivering, and operating software in a SaaS environment
  • Experience mentoring and developing successful teams
  • A strong sense of empathy for customers and teammates
  • A desire to build a diverse team that wins together and prioritizes customer success
  • A process-driven approach to engineering leadership, with experience creating operating mechanisms, metrics, monitoring, and feedback loops that improve outcomes over time.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with product stakeholders to drive measurable outcomes.

title: Customer Growth Sales Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Join Toast's rapidly expanding Customer Growth (Upsell) Sales team! We empower existing SMB Toast POS customers to maximize their success by expanding their product offerings. As a Growth Account Executive, you’ll grow and manage a portfolio of SMB accounts, with a goal of driving revenue through expansion and product adoption. This is a full-cycle role where you’ll partner with cross-functional teams to deliver value across the Toast platform. Our sales culture is a dynamic blend of competitive drive and collaborative spirit, where winning as a team is paramount.

Note: this is a role where you will be primarily remote, working from home, but also spending time in the field in your assigned territory(s). 


What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Customer Growth Account Executive, you will drive revenue growth by:

  • Managing the full sales cycle for customer expansion, identifying and closing upsell opportunities within your assigned territory of existing Toast SMB POS customers, from outbound prospecting to contract negotiation and close.
  • Utilizing consultative selling and discovery, conducting deep discovery to uncover customer pain points and business goals, leveraging consultative sales techniques to position Toast's expanded product offerings.
  • Owning full customer relationship lifecycles through renewal and expansion while consistently achieving quota and unit booking targets.
  • Executing pipeline management, maintaining a highly organized sales pipeline and activity records within Salesforce CRM and other essential tools.
  • Demonstrating market and product expertise, developing a strong understanding of the competitive landscape to effectively position Toast solutions and articulate their unique value.
  • Engaging in cross-functional collaboration, partnering seamlessly with New Business, Services, and Implementation teams to drive customer satisfaction, growth, and retention outcomes.
  • Applying strategic sales methodology, using proven sales methodologies (ex. Sandler) to uncover urgency, drive value, and create compelling propositions.

 
What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

We're looking for a driven and adaptable sales professional with:

  • Proven sales acumen, including 2+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in a closing role (ex. Business Development Representative, Account Executive), with a consistent track record of meeting and exceeding monthly sales performance goals.
  • A track record of success in a high-velocity or high-volume, transactional B2B SaaS sales environment.
  • Expertise in full-cycle sales skills, including deep discovery, compelling storytelling, persuasive negotiation, and effective closing techniques.
  • A consultative approach focused on product adoption & value realization, acting as a strategic consultant to challenge prospects' perspectives and drive new ways of thinking about their business.
  • A growth and ownership mindset leveraging data & account planning, being highly self-motivated, competitive, resilient, and taking strong ownership of results.
  • Exceptional communication skills and cross-functional orchestration, including excellent written and verbal communication, coupled with strong time management and organizational abilities.
  • The ability to adapt and perform issue triage & troubleshooting, with a proven capacity to thrive and adjust in a dynamic, rapidly evolving sales environment.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Data Platform
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join our data platform (AAP) team in Dublin. The AAP team owns the foundational data infrastructure that powers Toast's analytics products and AI/ML capabilities: real-time streaming pipelines, a cloud-native data lakehouse, feature serving for ML-driven product experiences, and the infrastructure that enables product teams across Toast to build intelligent, data-driven experiences for our 170,000+ restaurant customers.

We are in the middle of a significant platform evolution: migrating to Apache Iceberg, standing up a new Feature Store, conducting Databricks evaluations, and scaling our streaming infrastructure to meet the demands of a rapidly growing business.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the technical lead for major parts of this evolution. You'll design and lead the delivery of platform capabilities that several teams depend on, doing deep hands-on work and making design calls that account for streaming, storage, serving, and the teams consuming them. You'll be the go-to expert in your area of the platform, working with product and engineering partners inside and outside our line of business. You'll make the engineers around you better through mentorship, design reviews, and the example you set. Success looks like other engineering teams moving faster because of the platform you help build.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Lead the delivery of significant data platform capabilities, from early design through production rollout, across the AAP team and the teams that depend on it
  • Work hands-on with Kotlin/Java, Spark, Iceberg, and our streaming infrastructure, diagnosing performance, reasoning through trade-offs, and writing the code that sets the pattern for others
  • Anticipate how requirements will change and design systems that can absorb that change, exploring the problem fully before settling on a solution
  • Evolve the platform's API surfaces so that engineers across Toast can self-service - adoption and ease-of-use are part of the job
  • Lead efforts that measurably improve platform quality, reliability, and observability for the teams and customers who depend on it
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on engineering practices across the organisation
  • Use AI tooling as a genuine force multiplier in your day-to-day work and help the team do the same

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in software engineering with a strong focus on data platforms or distributed systems, including technical leadership of projects involving more than one team
  • Proficiency in Java, Kotlin or other object-oriented language
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg (or similar)
  • Experience with streaming infrastructure (Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, or similar) and cloud-native data platforms on AWS
  • Experience building internal platforms and developer-facing abstractions - you think about your platform's users as carefully as product engineers think about end users
  • Databricks experience is a bonus but we care more that you understand what's running underneath it

**This is a hybrid role requiring in-office collaboration two days per week in our Dublin office.**

Our tech stack

Our data platform runs on AWS and spans Apache Iceberg for table format and lakehouse architecture, Apache Kafka and Pulsar for real-time streaming, Apache Spark for data processing, and DynamoDB and Postgres for operational data stores. We are migrating from legacy ETL patterns toward a modern, cloud-native data lakehouse and building out Feature Store capabilities to power ML-driven product experiences. Our backend services are primarily Kotlin and Java.

title: Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative - Mandarin
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Hybrid Development Representative (HDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of Account Executives. This is not a static job - it is a dedicated, supportive launchpad and structured path for your professional sales career. We invest in HDRs with the clear expectation that high performers will advance through our specialized sales program, Toast Sales Academy, and become future full-cycle Account Executives.

The Journey of a High Performer: HDR → All Bound Sales Development role → Account Executive (AE)

The Timeline of a High Performer: 12-18 months, training to become an Account Executive 

What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Bilingual Hybrid Development Representative (HDR), you serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.

  • Complete at least 100 high-quality outreach activities daily (warm/cold calls, emails, and social touch points).
  • Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Learn and execute on various inbound and outbound outreach methods to prepare for specialization into an All-Bound Sales Development Role with the ultimate goal of developing into an Account Executive.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • Bilingual Fluency: Must be fluent in Mandarin and English - able to read, write, and speak.

title: Principal Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Your mission is to lead the architectural design, technical execution, and implementation of AI agents and infrastructure for Toast's Team area within our FinTech line of business. The Team area is a mission-critical space on which our restaurants rely to manage their staff and optimize their labor. As a Principal Engineer, you will serve as a key technical leader in the group, driving modern architectural patterns—including spec-driven development and agentic workflows—to deliver high-impact software.

  • Define and execute the technical architecture for AI agents within the Team domain, ensuring systems are scalable, reliable, and secure.

  • Guide, mentor, and elevate engineers within the Team area, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

  • Strong enthusiasm for agentic development practices, LLM integration, and modern software paradigms.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, we are committed to empowering our customers by providing the technology, resources, and community they need to thrive. While our roots are in food service, we are rapidly expanding into adjacent markets and international territories. Our mission is to build a world-class publishing and configuration platform that supports the diverse needs of all Toast customers, regardless of their industry or location.

As a member of the Configuration Platform team, you will be at the heart of Toast’s most critical infrastructure. We are the high-concurrency engine powering live system updates across the entire Toast ecosystem. Whether it’s a menu change in Ireland or a pricing update for a 100 location enterprise, it all flows through our systems. We empower our customers with the ability to transform their operations in real-time with consistency and reliability

 Why this team?

  • Scale and Resiliency: We are the highest-trafficked service at Toast. Our platform is mission-critical to core operations like ordering and business management; if we aren't performing, the business stops.
  • Expanding the Vision: We are advancing a sophisticated change management vision. We give customers the confidence and precision tools they need to manage complex configurations and run their global businesses with ease.
  • Platform Enablement: Beyond serving end-users, we are an ever-evolving internal platform. We aim to empower other Toast engineering teams to build, deploy, and scale their own features quickly on top of our robust architecture.
  • Future-Proofing: As our customer base grows at a phenomenal rate, we are re-architecting our infrastructure to handle increasing technical complexity and global scale.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Serve as the technical lead for the Config Platform team, owning the technical vision, architecture, and quality of the systems we build and operate
  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable systems that are critical to our customers’ success, staying hands-on in the code and the details
  • Lead the modernization of our architecture for scale and drive the technical vision for enterprise-grade change management, so customers can confidently audit and manage changes across thousands of locations
  • Define and drive long-term technical architecture and strategy across the entire organization, aligning executive business goals with platform capabilities
  • Partner with Engineering Management, Product, and Design to shape the roadmap, turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped, sequenced plans, and drive execution through to delivery
  • Design solutions that anticipate and accommodate future needs while considering tradeoffs
  • Lead technical design reviews and set a high bar for code quality, testing, and operational excellence across the team
  • Effectively communicate technical direction and build alignment with the Toast engineering teams that build on top of our platform

  • Act as a force multiplier in improving engineering productivity, including pioneering how the team uses AI tools to build faster and with higher quality

Our Tech Stack

Our products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets, to backend Kotlin and Java services, to internal, guest-facing, and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Kotlin/Java and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from DynamoDB to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, canary deployments, and robust load balancing. We store data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilize Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The web front-end is built using React and ES6. Our main point of sale application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform, we rely on Pulsar event driven architecture along with some RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end.

title: Principal HR Business Partner (R&D)
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We're looking for a Principal People Success Partner (more commonly referred to as "HRBP") to serve as the strategic HR partner for Toast's R&D organization — a 2,000+ person community spanning Engineering, Product, and Design. You'll report directly to the Senior Director, PSP and operate as a true thought partner to senior leaders, helping shape how we build, develop, and sustain a world-class product and technology organization.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who excels at navigating organizational complexity, influencing without authority, and translating people strategy into practical outcomes. The right person is equally comfortable in a room with a SVP discussing org design as they are rolling up their sleeves on a calibration cycle or a difficult performance conversation.

Note to applicants: We are prioritizing candidates located near our hubs in Boston, New York City, Toronto, San Francisco, and Omaha. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Partner with R&D SVPs, VPs and senior directors to design and evolve org structures that scale; Serve as a trusted advisor during reorgs and structural changes, helping leaders navigate people impacts with care and clarity.
  • Lead org design initiatives end-to-end: from diagnosing root causes through to stakeholder alignment, change communication, and implementation.
  • Drive consistent, high-quality performance calibrations across Engineering, PM, and Design — building leader capability and ensuring fair, differentiated outcomes.
  • Champion a culture of clear expectations and candid feedback; help leaders understand what "raising the bar" looks like in practice.
  • Cultivate an AI "Builder" approach by adopting and testing AI solutions to address challenges at scale.
  • Use engagement data, pulse surveys, and qualitative signals to surface org health risks and partner with leaders on action planning.
  • Serve as the R&D voice in the design and rollout of company-wide people programs — ensuring compensation cycles, leveling frameworks, and engagement initiatives land effectively.
  • Bring an analytical lens to your work — using data to shape decisions, measure outcomes, and tell a coherent story to senior stakeholders.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of HR Business Partner experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in org design — you've led restructuring initiatives, not just supported them.
  • Experience as a trusted partner to VP- and SVP-level leaders; you're known for your ability to influence and coach.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable using AI tools and working with employee data, engagement metrics, and headcount models to shape recommendations. 
  • Excellent judgment: you know when to push, when to listen, and when to escalate.
  • High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly across a diverse, technically-oriented workforce.
  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or fintech company.
  • Experience supporting a globally distributed R&D org.

title: Senior Associate, Strategic Finance (International)
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Strategic Finance team is responsible for providing data-driven insights to inform strategic, financial, and operational decision-making across the company. We are seeking a Senior Associate to support the go-to-market efforts of our International organization, which brings Toast’s platform to restaurants outside the U.S. You’ll partner directly with International sales, marketing, and onboarding leaders, building the topline and expense forecasts for each market and the reporting that tracks them against plan. The work is hands-on and close to the numbers, and it’s also where the strategic questions get answered: how each market performs, what drives unit economics, and where the business can operate more efficiently. This is a high-impact role at the center of Toast’s international expansion, with regular exposure to senior and cross-functional leadership.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Serve as a finance business partner to International go-to-market leadership, supporting market investment and resourcing decisions
  • Run the budget and forecast cycle for International, partnering with budget owners to track spend against plan, refresh topline and expense projections through the quarter, and surface risks early
  • Manage headcount planning and tracking across the International organization, spanning Sales, Onboarding, and Marketing, including capacity models, hiring plans, and reconciliation of actuals
  • Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting and analysis for International financials and KPIs, ensuring key issues, risks, and business drivers are understood and highlighted
  • Use unit economics such as LTV/CAC to pinpoint what’s driving results and where there’s room to improve
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses, modeling, and deep dives into strategic issues to improve decision-making
  • Communicate clearly and transparently with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Onboarding, and Marketing to build trusted relationships

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, investment banking, or equivalent field
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills
  • Self-starter capable of independently navigating ambiguity 
  • Comfortable communicating complex financial information to non-finance audiences and presenting to all levels of management
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Working knowledge of SQL or experience with BI tools
  • Working knowledge of Adaptive, Netsuite and Zip
  • Public company Strategic Finance background
  • Partnership with a Go-to-market organization
  • Experience working in a high growth SaaS company

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer, Voice AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid)

Who We Are

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join the Voice AI Team.

On the Voice AI Team, our mission is to build and operate the voice platform that powers Toast and to ship novel applications on top of it that create real value across Toast's customer base. This is a greenfield space where the platform and its use cases are being defined together, and the work you do here will be foundational to how Toast uses voice AI for years to come.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll take ownership of significant projects end-to-end: designing systems, driving execution across the team, and making the technical decisions that shape how the platform grows. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and stakeholders across Toast to turn ambiguous problems into reliable, scalable systems.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable backend services, applications, and core platform components supporting Toast's Voice AI platform used across teams
  • Conceive and lead complex, cross-cutting projects from design through production, owning outcomes and driving alignment across stakeholders and across a broad range of stakeholders
  • Shape the technical direction on your team and beyond by making architectural decisions, defining patterns, and reducing complexity for the engineers and teams that depend on your work
  • Build and evolve integrations with AI platforms and internal Toast systems, making pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, reliability, and long-term scalability
  • Establish and implement patterns for observability, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks for AI-powered systems, using production data to understand and continuously improve system behavior
  • Set and hold the bar for engineering quality and best practices through standards, patterns, and written guidance that others naturally adopt, raising the bar for the team and the broader organization
  • Mentor engineers at all levels through code reviews, design feedback, and technical guidance

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 8+ years of experience with object-oriented languages such as Java or Kotlin
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • Experience developing AI-integrated products or features, with a practical understanding of how to ship and iterate on systems that incorporate LLMs or other AI capabilities
  • Experience building and reasoning about AI-powered systems, including nondeterminism, evaluation strategies, observability, and cost management
  • Experience shipping complex, mission-critical production services and owning them long-term
  • Track record of leading multi-person and multi-team projects end-to-end, from design through rollout
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and production reliability
  • Basic familiarity with frontend development
  • Strong cross-team communication and collaboration skills; able to influence direction without formal authority both within your team and across the broader organization
  • Actively uses AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) in day-to-day development and have caused others to become more proficient with AI coding tools
  • Experience with voice or conversational AI platforms is a plus, but not required

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written in Kotlin and Java using DropWizard, running on AWS (DynamoDB, RDS, Lambda). We store data in sharded Postgres databases and have our own platform for user management, canary deployments, and load balancing. Our web front-end is built with React and ES6.

title: Senior Director of Product, International
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building a platform that helps our customers adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. International expansion is a critical growth engine for Toast's future. 

Outside the US, we currently operate in Canada, UK, Ireland, and Australia and are actively growing our share in these markets. As we move into the next phase of growth, the complexity of our platform surface area and customer segments is increasing materially. We are looking for a commercially-minded (Senior) Director of Product Management to enable this growth.

As a (Senior) Director of Product, International, you will lead the team of product managers to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap around upmarket expansion to support larger (15+ locations) groups, accelerating integration partner availability to ensure customers can use Toast alongside their preferred tech stack, and  expansion of our FinTech / payments pricing capabilities. Scaling and managing these domains require someone who can work credibly with customers, GTM teams, engineers, executive stakeholders, and external partners in equal measure. 

This is a London based-role, partnering closely with teams across Canada, Australia, U.S., Ireland, and India, and a key part of our EMEA leadership team. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of how Toast serves customers in new markets.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Drive Strategy and Execution: Set the strategic direction across upmarket, partner, and payment expansion with a focus on how those areas interact and reinforce each other to meet the north star goals for the International line of business. Partner with engineering and product teams across Toast's platform teams to ship international features in their area. Navigate competing roadmaps, set clear success criteria, and hold delivery against contractual commitments.
  • Voice of Customer: Engage directly with customers, partners, and GTM teams to understand real needs — and use that grounding to pressure-test roadmap priorities and push back on assumptions that don't hold up in the field. Represent the voice of international customers as the PM voice for our global restaurant and hospitality brands in roadmap discussions, cross-functional reviews, and executive conversations. 
  • Lead Through Influence: Champion cross-functional delivery across Product, Engineering, Design, Legal/Compliance, Hardware, Commerce, Risk, Finance, and Operations. This role has direct exposure to C-suite leadership and regular involvement in executive-level roadmap and strategy discussions. 
  • Develop a World-Class Team and OS: Hire, coach, and develop a world-class team of Product Managers across multiple regions. Scale our operating model grounded in ownership, accountability, clarity, and exceptional execution. 
  • Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 15+ years of product management experience in SaaS or FinTech, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. You've owned a portfolio of products for a market, not just a feature area.
  • Commercial instincts. You understand how product decisions translate into revenue, retention, and customer value, and you make prioritization decisions accordingly.
  • Comfort with ambiguity at the charter level — you have shaped product direction from scratch, not just executed against someone else's vision.
  • A track record of working across a complex stakeholder map — engineering, GTM, finance, external partners — that do not report to you. You are comfortable driving alignment without losing sharpness in the process.
  • Strong people leadership. You build teams, give direct feedback, develop careers, and hold a high bar for product thinking without micromanaging execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — crisp strategy docs, strong product reviews, and the ability to represent platform work clearly to executives and customers alike.
  • Experience managing product commitments that are tied to enterprise contracts or MSAs.
  • Genuine curiosity about the restaurant industry. You don't need to have run a restaurant, but you should want to understand how an operator thinks and how that thinking should shape what you build.

department: R & D : BTT : Operations, Sales & Marketing Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Care Automation team builds the systems and automations that power how Toast supports its customers. Our work connects the platforms, workflows, and integrations that our Customer Care Agents rely on every day to resolve issues quickly and deliver a great customer experience.

We are looking for an AI/Agent Engineer to join this team and help define how intelligent automation changes the way care operations work at Toast. You will be at the center of building the AI layer across our care systems, bringing together large language models, agentic frameworks, and workflow automation to reduce manual effort and improve outcomes for both agents and customers.

In this role, you will design and build AI-powered automations that work across our Care tool suite, including Salesforce Service Cloud and Amazon Connect. You will partner closely with software engineers, Salesforce developers, and operations stakeholders to ship production-grade AI systems that make a measurable difference for our Customer Care teams and customers.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and operate AI-powered automations and agentic workflows that help Customer Care Agents resolve issues faster and more consistently
  • Build and maintain integrations between LLM-based systems and our care technology stack, including Salesforce, Amazon Connect, and iPaaS workflow automation platforms
  • Prototype and iterate on agentic solutions that can take autonomous actions across care systems, with appropriate human-in-the-loop checkpoints
  • Write automated tests and participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and system reliability
  • Monitor AI system performance, respond to incidents, and iterate based on operational data and agent feedback
  • Partner with software engineers, Salesforce developers, and operations stakeholders to translate care workflows into intelligent, automated solutions
  • Leverage AI-augmented development tools to increase development velocity and code quality

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful hands-on experience building AI/ML systems in production
  • Practical experience with large language models, agentic frameworks (such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar), and prompt engineering
  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python, Java, or Go
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and building integrations across enterprise systems
  • Ability to evaluate trade-offs between automation accuracy, latency, and cost in production AI systems
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Ingredients (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with contact center platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud or Amazon Connect
  • Experience with Workato or another iPaaS platform
  • Hands-on experience with RAG architectures and vector databases

title: Mid Market Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. The Mid-Market Sales Executive is responsible for sales and revenue growth in their assigned, targeted accounts. This individual is responsible for building a sales pipeline, managing a sales process for mid-market brands/group across the UK.

This is a hybrid role based in London, with regular time split between the office, home, the field, and in-person customer visits.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Lead efforts to grow Toast market share in the multi-unit restaurant industry through establishment and cultivation of ongoing relationships at the C-Suite level through research, cold-calling and networking to develop a qualified pipeline of prospects.
  • Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast value proposition of products and solutions through demonstrations and presentations communicating a compelling purchase rationale.
  • Cultivate relationships with business partner counterparts who sell and support complementary applications and services to point of sale systems serving the restaurant industry
  • Plan, direct and coordinate sales support activities, including management of the sales pipeline through Toast sales tools (Salesforce)
  • Involved in all phases of the sales lifecycle including: identifying and developing leads; meeting with clients; developing value propositions; financial deal structuring; contract negotiation and closing
  • Understand the competitive landscape (strengths, weaknesses, benefits) and determine how to position Toast to win
  • Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation Teams to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
  • Own your own leverage. Continuously identify the repetitive parts of the role — research, prep, notes, follow-up, list building and systematically get them off your plate, so the majority of your week is spent in live conversation with operators.
  • Work evidence, not alphabetical order. Prioritise accounts based on observable change in the operator's business: expansion, ownership change, hiring patterns, guest feedback trends, visible technology, and disqualify unworkable accounts quickly so your capacity concentrates where it can actually close.
  • Treat your book as an asset you maintain. Keep account and contact records accurate, current, and deduplicated, understanding that routing, scoring, and every AI-assisted workflow is only as good as the data underneath it.
  • Untangle who really decides. Resolve complex ownership structures, franchise groups, multiple legal entities, operators running several concepts under different names to identify and reach the actual economic decision maker rather than whoever answers the phone.
  • Arrive already informed, and earn trust in a low-trust market. Focus on the operator's specific situation rather than a product pitch, and recognise that many operators have been burned by a previous vendor; credibility, not feature comparisons, is often what wins the deal.
  • Close the loop on what's broken. Flag bad data, wrong contacts, and signals that didn't hold up, so the system your whole team relies on improves rather than quietly eroding.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • A combination of SaaS, Digital Marketing and Restaurant Industry Technology experience is required
  • 5+ years of relevant successful technology or professional services sales experience
  • Previous success in selling/leading sales efforts in environments with 6 to 12 month sales cycles
    • Proven sales skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiations, and closing with both new and existing clients
  • Experience in MEDDPICC Sales Qualification preferred
  • Travel 30% or more
  • Comfortable with process-driven sales, reporting, and tracking
  • Strong written and presentation-based communication skills are required
  • You've built something to make yourself faster. You can walk us through a repeatable process, template or workflow you personally created to eliminate busywork from your own week, and what it gave you back.
  • Demonstrated learning velocity. You can point to a capability you taught yourself in the last six months without being asked to, and explain how you now use it.
  • You can articulate a problem precisely. Comfort framing a messy commercial question clearly and specifically enough that a tool, a teammate or a supporting function can actually act on it.
  • You manage a territory like a portfolio. Comfort making deliberate coverage decisions across a large account base rather than defaulting to whichever deal is loudest this week.
  • Genuine curiosity about how restaurants actually operate — margins, labour, throughput, the difference between a 3-location operator and a 30-location one — because that is what earns a second conversation. Comfort working in build mode, where territory definition, process and tooling are actively being shaped and you are expected to have an opinion on them.

title: Manager II, Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

One of the top challenges facing Toast customers today is getting new guests.  Toast Advertising is a restaurant advertising tool that lets Toast customers launch and manage Google and Meta campaigns from within the Toast platform. It is built for US restaurants that want to reach new guests, drive traffic to owned channels like online ordering, catering and events, and Toast Tables, and track return on ad spend without using separate ad tools or spreadsheets. Within Toast’s suite, it connects marketing performance to ordering, reservations, catering, and in-store sales data.

We’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager to help lead our efforts to build a true demand generation engine for our customers.  In this role, you’ll guide a team delivering high-impact features that directly impact one of the fastest growing products in Toast’s history.  You’ll be responsible not just for what the team builds, but how it builds—driving clarity, improving execution, and maintaining a high bar for quality.

This is a true hands-on 'player/coach' role leading a lean, high-impact squad of 5–10 engineers. We expect you to balance team leadership, architecture, and code contributions directly—this role is intentionally designed for someone who wants to stay deeply engaged in the codebase, not an executive managing managers.

About this roll*:

Spend roughly 30–50% of your time writing code, conducting technical design reviews, and pairing with engineers on critical paths.

  • Collaborate with product management, design and other stakeholders to define the operational plan and roadmap for Toast Advertising
  • Align the team to current priorities and help them keep executing at a consistently high level.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to help your teams get stuff done
  • Mentor both new and experienced engineers in both technology and leadership
  • Track and ensure teams are delivering impact and outcomes in their work
  • Drive knowledge sharing programs across the team and broader engineering organization
  • Hire and develop new team members

Do you have the right ingredients*?

Recent, continuous hands-on software development experience (you still write production code or review PRs weekly in a modern stack like Java, Kotlin, React, or similar).

  • Experience mentoring and developing successful teams
  • Bias to action - knowing how to balance getting things done and making things perfect
  • Ownership mindset - taking end-to-end accountability for team outcomes, proactively identifying and solving problems, and driving continuous improvement beyond just assigned tasks
  • You genuinely enjoy getting your hands dirty in architecture, implementation, and code delivery.
  • A strong sense of empathy for customers and teammates
  • A desire to build a diverse team that wins together and prioritizes customer success

Special Sauce& (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience in an early stage technology startup
  • Experience building products with deep dependencies on 3rd party integrations

Our Tech Stack

  • A core of Java & Kotlin based backend services
  • React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook.
  • Claude Code and similar AI agentic development tools as part of daily engineering
  • PostgreSQL and DynamoDB as core persistence

descriptionHtml:

Toast is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build innovative solutions on the web to expand how guests interact with our consumer-facing digital dining product, Toast Local. You’ll join a team of frontend, backend, and native mobile engineers working together to create the best digital restaurant experience for guests.

Who We Are

The Consumer team at Toast is all about creating exceptional consumer experiences for restaurants and their guests. We’re product-obsessed, focused on innovation, and committed to building scalable, reliable solutions that are used by millions of restaurant-goers every day. If you’re ready to make an impact on a massive scale, this is the place for you.

  • Build cross-platform experiences alongside iOS, Android, and backend engineers
  • Work across the stack, from React and Next.js on the front end to the services behind it
  • Experiment directly with guests and restaurants to test new dining experiences
  • Ship code that drives the growth and strategy of Toast’s consumer business

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • Strong frontend experience building modern web applications with React and TypeScript; Next.js a plus
  • Backend experience building GraphQL or REST APIs; Kotlin/Java a plus
  • Ownership of your work from start to finish: shipping it, launching it, monitoring the rollout, and analyzing the results
  • A point of view on consumer products and a desire to shape what gets built, not just how

title: Principal Software Engineer, International Integrations
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): Canada (Remote - East Coast preferred)

Bready* to make a change?

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast is driven to build a platform that helps our customers adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. International expansion is a critical growth engine for Toast's future. Outside the US, we currently operate in Canada, UK, Ireland, and Australia and are actively growing our market share. Integration partnerships are a key part of our strategy to ensure that restaurants of all sizes can retain the parts of their tech stack outside of the Toast platform. This role is for a current vacancy. 

Who We Are

Supporting customers software partners is a key part of international expansion strategy, and the advent of AI powered coding tools provided the opportunity to significantly reduce the development effort required to integrate with a partner. We are looking for a principal engineer to lead the development of this new way of integrating partners, while also providing additional technical leadership across our International expansion efforts. This is an exciting opportunity to develop new AI powered development systems that will provide direct impact for our customers. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.
  • Lead fellow developers, product managers, designers, and user researchers to build a strong tech infrastructure that enables scalably integration of key customer software partners.
  • Architect, create and maintain an AI harness for the rapid integration and maintenance of partners with Toast’s systems
  • Define and drive technical strategy for problems that affect our International expansion efforts
  • Mentor developers across multiple teams through code-pairing and detailed code, architecture, and project reviews
  • Champion best practices for development, deployment and quality life cycles
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Java and Kotlin-based backend services.

  • Frontend: React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL, and Storybook.

  • Mobile/Hardware: Android app built in Java & Kotlin running in the restaurant.

  • Persistence/Databases: PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.

  • Messaging & Integration: Apache Pulsar, Apache Camel, and RabbitMQ for message-based integrations.

  • Plus many more technologies that help us build a top-class platform.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating highly scalable, mission-critical distributed systems and SaaS products (ideally AWS-hosted).
  • Proven track record of leading complex technical initiatives and delivering robust software architecture from design to production.

  • Balanced expertise: Ability to design high-level technical solutions on a whiteboard while remaining deeply connected to code-level execution and system performance.
  • Effective communication: Ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical peers and product leadership.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building development harnesses that leverage LLMs or autonomous agents
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration frameworks (e.g., Apache Camel) or event-driven messaging systems (e.g., Apache Pulsar).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Toast Delivery Services
descriptionHtml:
Location: Hybrid in Boston/NY preferred; open to remote working US East Coast (EST/EDT) hours.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with the ability and drive to make an impact, not only on their own but by also enabling those around them to succeed. Play a key role in building the product that puts restaurants in control of their own delivery.

As a member of the Toast Delivery Services team, you will build the software that turns a tap on a phone into a hot meal at someone's door. Our systems find a driver, price the delivery, and keep everyone honest about where the food is right now. This is software with a physical world attached: the clock is always running, the map is never perfect, and every decision your code makes shows up as a real person waiting on their dinner.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable systems critical to our customers' success.
  • Build the real-time backbone that keeps restaurants and guests confident about where an order is and when it will land.
  • Work with product managers and designers to get money movement right, from delivery pricing through refunds, where correctness is not negotiable.
  • Tackle scaling challenges and implement robust solutions.
  • Advocate for best coding practices, raising the bar for yourself, your team, and the company.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other team members.
