title: Mid Market Account Executive, Toast Retail
descriptionHtml:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

Role Overview

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.

You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
  • Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
  • Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
  • Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
  • Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
  • Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
  • Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
  • Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
  • Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
  • Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.
  • A track record sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally multi-location or upmarket.
  • Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.
  • Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.
  • A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.
  • Exceptional customer engagement and active listening. You do not just pitch, you solve problems for operators.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders.
  • Comfort educating customers on the fundamentals of US credit card processing, including surcharging and processing nuances.
  • Strong organizational skills and a disciplined, process driven approach to selling, reporting, and tracking.
  • Ability to travel 30% or more.

What will help you stand out

  • Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail.
  • Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice.
  • Experience selling into franchised organizations, navigating both franchisor and franchisee requirements, buying processes, and stakeholder management
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to complete complex RFPs, bonus if you’ve helped write a RFP for a prospect just starting their evaluation process
  • Experience helping stand up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket.
  • Experience in a fast paced, high growth technology environment.

title: Mid Market Account Executive, Toast Retail
descriptionHtml:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

Role Overview

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.

You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
  • Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
  • Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
  • Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
  • Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
  • Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
  • Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
  • Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
  • Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
  • Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.
  • A track record sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally multi-location or upmarket.
  • Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.
  • Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.
  • A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.
  • Exceptional customer engagement and active listening. You do not just pitch, you solve problems for operators.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders.
  • Comfort educating customers on the fundamentals of US credit card processing, including surcharging and processing nuances.
  • Strong organizational skills and a disciplined, process driven approach to selling, reporting, and tracking.
  • Ability to travel 30% or more.

What will help you stand out

  • Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail.
  • Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice.
  • Experience selling into franchised organizations, navigating both franchisor and franchisee requirements, buying processes, and stakeholder management

title: Product Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We are hiring an experienced Product Counsel to join our Legal team.

As Product Counsel, you will work with teams across the business including product, engineering, data science, marketing, compliance, and sales, to develop a deep understanding of Toast’s products, platform, and AI-driven strategies, and to offer pragmatic legal advice that helps the business identify and mitigate legal risk. This role leans technical. You will partner closely with the teams building the foundations of the Toast platform as well as the products built on top of them, including our Enterprise offerings. The best candidate for this role finds the technical detail interesting rather than an obstacle. Toast’s product portfolio evolves quickly, and so does this role. We are looking for someone agile who can shift priorities with the business.

Our Legal & Compliance teams are primarily concentrated in Boston, New York, Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Chicago. Candidates residing in these areas will be prioritized, as they will benefit from closer proximity to colleagues and greater access to company resources and events.

A Day in the Life (Responsibilities)

  • Advising a variety of stakeholders across the product, engineering, data, and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle — from the initial stages of product development through launch, including the review of marketing strategies and assets.
  • Providing practical advice to business stakeholders on a broad range of issues including regulatory compliance, consumer protection, intellectual property, artificial intelligence, marketing, and privacy.
  • Advising on the design and deployment of core platform infrastructure and the AI built on top of it, including platform and API design, integrations, and the questions raised when an AI system takes action on a customer’s behalf.
  • Counseling product, engineering, and data science teams across the machine learning model lifecycle.
  • Advising on identity, authentication, authorization, and account security, including consent, delegated access, and the legal requirements that shape access-control design.
  • Translating legal requirements into technical requirements, writing guidance engineers can build against, and reviewing design documents, data models, and architecture proposals.
  • Understanding and staying up to date on U.S. and international laws and regulations relating to the Toast platform, including the shifting global AI legal landscape.
  • Thinking creatively to navigate complex regulatory environments to ensure a smooth and compliant user experience.
  • Helping build scalable and effective processes such as playbooks, intake triage, decision trees, so routine questions resolve quickly and hard questions reach you early.
  • Partnering collaboratively across privacy, security, compliance, and fellow product counsel on issues that cross team lines.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • A J.D. from an ABA-accredited U.S. law school, and membership in good standing in at least one state bar.
  • 5+ years of legal experience in areas covering regulatory compliance, privacy, intellectual property, and consumer protection.
  • In-house legal department experience advising product, engineering, and marketing teams on issues related to the development of new products, product enhancements, and feature requests.
  • Technical fluency. You are comfortable reading architecture and design documentation, reasoning about data flows, schemas, APIs, and model behavior, and engaging engineers and data scientists as a peer. A computer science degree is not required; the ability to do the work is.
  • Experience with AI or machine learning issues — training data rights, model governance, or emerging AI regulation — and the judgment to advise on novel questions without settled precedent.
  • Experience with data-use and data-rights questions: what a company may do with the data it holds, and how aggregation, de-identification, and contractual commitments change the answer.
  • Experience working with fast-paced technology or software companies.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas in a succinct and impactful manner.
  • A solution-oriented, customer service, and growth mindset.
  • The ability to integrate into cross-functional teams with a cooperative and participatory approach.

title: Senior Privacy Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy. We’re seeking an experienced Senior Privacy Program Manager to join Toast’s Legal & Compliance team who will play a pivotal role in shaping and maintaining a world-class privacy program. We are heavily leaned into AI automation efforts, and this is an exciting opportunity to help grow the program leveraging automation and LLMs.

As part of the dynamic and collaborative Privacy team, you will lead efforts to operationalize privacy requirements across our global operations. This is an opportunity to work on challenging and meaningful projects that make a difference in how we safeguard data and uphold privacy principles within the products and services we offer (both B2B and B2C).

Our Legal & Compliance teams are primarily concentrated in Boston, New York, Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Chicago. Candidates residing in these areas will be prioritized, as they will benefit from closer proximity to colleagues and greater access to company resources and events.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Global Privacy Program Management: Develop and maintain Toast's global privacy program, ensuring compliance with laws and best practices across the US, Canada, Europe, the UK, and other countries where Toast operates.
  • DPA Enablement: Help triage our Procurement queue and provide a first pass assessment of privacy risk and vendor stance against our standard DPA using pre-defined risk thresholds and protocols in conjunction with LLMs.
  • Privacy Rights: Continue to mature our privacy rights process and program, including driving efforts to further automate how requests are processed alongside our vendor, Ethyca, and internal business teams and developing SOPs for use in responding to privacy rights requests.
  • Privacy Reviews: Maintain our existing Jira queue for privacy review requests and oversee and improve on automation to generate a first pass privacy assessment that attorneys can  then refine/finalize. Work with business/product teams to implement mitigations identified during such privacy reviews.
  • Operational Compliance & Risk Mitigation: Translate privacy requirements into actionable processes, develop and supplement privacy FAQs for different domains,  manage privacy risk registers, and conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Training & Awareness & Data Governance: Develop and deliver privacy training programs, and collaborate on data governance frameworks for data classification and lifecycle management.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure program effectiveness and provide regular reports to leadership. Maintain and update the Privacy team’s Confluence page to serve as an internal resource to other teams.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree or 8 years and a Master’s degree. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, etc.) are preferred but not mandatory.
  • 5+ years of relevant privacy experience. SaaS or tech industry experience preferred.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of global privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, etc.), and the ability to apply them practically in a business setting.
  • A willingness to roll up your sleeves and help the team achieve its objectives without being overly concerned about the precise scope of your role. We are an outcome oriented team that likes to lean in to get things across the line in a collaborative manner (while still having fun along the way!).
  • Ability to collaborate with technical teams on data flows, architectures, and system design
  • Strong project management skills, with the capacity to align privacy initiatives with business goals and manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts, and strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • A working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude, Gemini etc. and a willingness to use AI solutions for privacy program management.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Compute & Storage Platform
department: R & D : Cloud Service Infra : Platform Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer on the Compute & Storage Platform team in Toast, you will design, build, and operate the foundational distributed systems powering the Toast platform as the company expands into further international markets and broadens its product offerings to encompass retail shopping.

You will bridge the gap between core infrastructure and cutting-edge product development—building low-latency state and storage systems, scalable compute clusters, and high-throughput streaming pipelines. Your work will directly enable Toast product delivery across our Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).

For this role it is a requirement that you 5+ years of industry experience 

Key Responsibilities

  • Online Databases and Storage: Architect, deploy, and manage low-latency, highly available storage solutions (RDS Postgres and Aurora Postgres; DynamoDB; OpenSearch; S3) to power applications across the Toast product ecosystem.
  • High Availability & Realtime Performance: Ensure sub-second end-user latency, near-zero-downtime reliability, and high throughput across storage engines to support Toast's products across POS, phone, computer, drive-thru, and kiosk interfaces.
  • Infrastructure for AI-Driven PDLC: Automate infrastructure provisioning and compute pipelines.
  • Cost Optimization & Performance Engineering: Right-size compute/storage resources, implement auto-scaling policies, and manage AWS infrastructure costs without compromising platform reliability or latency SLAs.

Required Qualifications

1. Core Infrastructure & Automation

  • Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience building and managing scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).
  • Software Development: Fluency in Python, Go, or a similar language for infrastructure automation, tooling, or backend development.

2. Storage & Compute Operations

  • Databases: Deep experience operating and tuning enterprise databases at scale. This should include at least one variety of relational database (such as Postgres, Oracle, or MySQL) and at least one type of nonrelational database (such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Opensearch).
  • Containerization: Experience working with containerized environments and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes).

3. Systems Reliability & Observability

  • Solid understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including monitoring, alerting, health checks, and performance troubleshooting in high-traffic environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Observability & Telemetry with Datadog, Prometheus
  • AI/ML Infrastructure support
  • Cloud Cost Optimization

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s commercial products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend microservices, guest- and restaurant-facing web apps, payment systems, event buses, and more. 

The Infrastructure Engineering group manages Toast's infrastructure via the AWS API, using configuration management tools like Terraform, Ansible, and internally developed clients using Python and Go. We rely heavily on Datadog and Splunk for monitoring and observability and on FireHydrant for alerting and incident response.

Infrastructure Engineering provides the products and services to support, deploy, and monitor our product suite, which uses a microservice architecture written using JVM and Node.js apps. AWS products are also in heavy usage, ranging from S3 to RDS, DynamoDB, ECS, Lambda, and many others. We have our own platform for user management, service discovery/elevations, and load balancing. We use Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data synchronization between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ and Apache Pulsar clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the applications' RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

Why Join Us?

You will be at the ground floor of building the data-storage systems that powers our flagship products. You'll solve complex, high-scale infrastructure challenges at the intersection of distributed storage and compute.

** This is a hybrid role requiring in-office presence two days per week ***

title: Solutions Lead, International Upmarket
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast International is building its upmarket business across the UK & Ireland, Canada, and Australia, focused on restaurant groups with 16 to 500 locations. We're hiring a solutions lead to own the technical side of every International deal over 15 locations. Your demos and labs are where our deals are won or lost.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Run demos that win the room. Build every demo from discovery. Show a 40-site group their own menu, their own workflows and the systems they already run, in their market's version of the product. Tailor it to each person in the buying group, from the head of ops to the IT lead to finance. Leave each of them with a reason to champion Toast.
  • Run labs that end in a decision. Agree success criteria with the customer before the lab starts. Build and maintain the lab environment, track every issue, drive escalations and root cause analysis, and close the lab with a clear yes or no. No lab ends without an agreed next step.
  • Own the technical outcome through go-live. The deal isn't won until the customer is live and it matches what we sold. Stay involved through procurement and handoff.
  • Architect the solution. Design how Toast fits into a multi-location group's existing stack:

All of it within what's actually available, and what payments rules allow, in each market.

  • Lead security, IT and compliance reviews. Own vendor security questionnaires, PCI scoping conversations and the technical sections of RFPs.
  • Speak product's language. Write business requirement documentation that product and engineering can act on: the problem, the customer's own words, workarounds tried, what's at stake across the segment (not just one account), and options with tradeoffs. Turn one customer's ask into a case for the platform.
  • Present the roadmap with credibility. Walk executive and IT audiences through what exists, what's coming and what isn't, without overpromising. Keep their trust when the answer is "not yet."
  • Sell outcomes, not features. Partner with sales to build the business case. Translate technical fit into the outcomes the economic buyer cares about, such as labor, speed of service and revenue. When a buyer is weighing a feature gap, help them see it against the full value of the platform, and make sure their IT team feels heard along the way.
  • Engineer workarounds, and know when to hold the line. Design and document solutions to complex gaps, and judge when a workaround creates debt we'll pay for at go-live.
  • Build real relationships outside the sales thread. Become the trusted counterpart to the customer's IT lead, head of operations and systems owners, relationships that hold up on their own merit.
  • Hand off cleanly. Give onboarding and implementation a clear record of what was promised, what was configured and why, so delivery matches the sale.
  • Help build the function. Set the engagement model for when and how AEs bring you in, qualify technical fit early and disqualify fast, and build reusable assets: demo environments for each market, reference architectures, an RFP library and BRD standards.
  • Partner across Solutions. Work closely with the International SMB Solutions team on clear lanes, shared tools and cross-coverage.
  • Grow the team. Help define, hire and develop the International upmarket solutions team as the business scales.
  • Own your own leverage. Continuously find the repetitive parts of the role (RFP answers, security questionnaires, discovery notes, demo resets) and systematically get them off your plate.
  • Close the loop on what's broken. Feed product gaps, lost-deal reasons and market differences back to product and sales leadership, so the next deal is easier than the last.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • An elite demo and lab track record. You've run tailored demos for multi-stakeholder buying committees and taken complex labs or pilots to a signed decision. In the interview, you'll run a demo for us and walk us through a lab you ran end to end.
  • You build and maintain your own environments. Demo data, lab configurations and resets are your job, done fast and adapted for each market.
  • 7+ years in solutions architecture, solutions engineering or technical consulting, with at least 4 supporting mid-market or enterprise deals with 6 to 12+ month cycles and buying committees.
  • Experience in hospitality, retail or payments technology serving multi-location operators.
  • You've taken complex deals through lab or pilot to go-live. You can walk us through one end to end, including what went wrong and what you changed.
  • Integration fluency: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and data flows. You can read API docs and sketch an architecture on a whiteboard. Coding isn't required, but you can test your own assumptions.
  • Security and compliance fluency: PCI DSS scope, and privacy regimes such as UK GDPR, PIPEDA and the Australian Privacy Act. You're comfortable owning a security review.
  • Writing that product teams act on. Bring a sanitized requirements doc, solution design or BRD to the interview.
  • Executive presence with C-suite and IT leaders, including delivering "no" and keeping the relationship.
  • International experience across more than one market or regulatory regime. Willing to travel across the UK & Ireland, Canada and Australia (30%+).
  • Comfort working in build mode, where territory definition, process and tooling are actively being shaped and you're expected to have an opinion on them.

Special Skills (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise POS or hospitality platforms in these markets
  • ERP, HR or workforce management integration experience
  • MEDDPICC

What success looks like in year one

  • Every 16+ location deal gets a tailored demo, and every lab has agreed success criteria and ends in a decision.

title: Principal HR Business Partner (R&D)
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We're looking for a Principal People Success Partner (more commonly referred to as "HRBP") to serve as the strategic HR partner for Toast's R&D organization — a 2,000+ person community spanning Engineering, Product, and Design. You'll report directly to the Senior Director, PSP and operate as a true thought partner to senior leaders, helping shape how we build, develop, and sustain a world-class product and technology organization.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who excels at navigating organizational complexity, influencing without authority, and translating people strategy into practical outcomes. The right person is equally comfortable in a room with a SVP discussing org design as they are rolling up their sleeves on a calibration cycle or a difficult performance conversation.

Note to applicants: We are prioritizing candidates located near our hubs in Boston, New York City, Toronto, San Francisco, and Omaha. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Partner with R&D SVPs, VPs and senior directors to design and evolve org structures that scale; Serve as a trusted advisor during reorgs and structural changes, helping leaders navigate people impacts with care and clarity.
  • Lead org design initiatives end-to-end: from diagnosing root causes through to stakeholder alignment, change communication, and implementation.
  • Drive consistent, high-quality performance calibrations across Engineering, PM, and Design — building leader capability and ensuring fair, differentiated outcomes.
  • Champion a culture of clear expectations and candid feedback; help leaders understand what "raising the bar" looks like in practice.
  • Cultivate an AI "Builder" approach by adopting and testing AI solutions to address challenges at scale.
  • Use engagement data, pulse surveys, and qualitative signals to surface org health risks and partner with leaders on action planning.
  • Serve as the R&D voice in the design and rollout of company-wide people programs — ensuring compensation cycles, leveling frameworks, and engagement initiatives land effectively.
  • Bring an analytical lens to your work — using data to shape decisions, measure outcomes, and tell a coherent story to senior stakeholders.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of HR Business Partner experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in org design — you've led restructuring initiatives, not just supported them.
  • Experience as a trusted partner to VP- and SVP-level leaders; you're known for your ability to influence and coach.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable using AI tools and working with employee data, engagement metrics, and headcount models to shape recommendations. 
  • Excellent judgment: you know when to push, when to listen, and when to escalate.
  • High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly across a diverse, technically-oriented workforce.
  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or fintech company.
  • Experience supporting a globally distributed R&D org.

descriptionHtml:

A day in the life (Responsibilities):

  • Lead a large Care organization spread across multiple lines of business (LOBs), managing Care Managers directly and Care agents indirectly, to deliver an exceptional experience to live Toast customers.
  • Own technical support operations end to end, including capacity planning, workforce management, SLAs, escalation paths and quality programs, so complex technical issues are resolved efficiently and consistently.
  • Act as the face of the Care business to functional leaders across Toast. Bring customer insights and operational data to those leaders to influence and improve processes and policies.

title: Product Lead, New Ventures
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred


Toast builds technology that helps food and beverage businesses run smoother, serve customers better, and grow with confidence. Our platform brings together the tools teams need to power daily operations—while turning complexity into clear, actionable insights. We're purpose-built for the pace of hospitality, and we're investing in new experiences that make great businesses easier to run at any scale.

About this role (Responsibilities) 

We're looking for a Product Lead to join our New Ventures team and help grow one of Toast's newest products. We've shipped an MVP and have early customers. Now we need to reach product-market fit and then scale. This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll work directly with a small team of engineers and a design engineer.

You spend a lot of time with customers: on calls, in person, and watching how they use the product. You're good at taking complex problems and making them simple. You have a strong sense for the next right thing to build, and you keep scope tight so the team ships what matters most. You think in workflows and systems, not just individual features. You collaborate well with engineers, weighing tradeoffs and making calls together. You know when to keep testing and when it's time to invest in scale. You use AI tools every day to prototype, research, analyze data, and check your own thinking.

In this role, you will:

  • Help shape the product's strategy and roadmap as we move from MVP to product-market fit and scale.
  • Own outcome briefs (our lightweight version of a PRD) end to end. That means framing the problem, working with the team through shipping, and measuring results.
  • Run weekly cycle planning. You'll partner with the engineers, the design engineer, and the team lead to decide what we'll build each week and why.
  • Learn where early customers get value and where they get stuck, and use that to decide what to double down on and what to drop.
  • Define what success looks like, make sure it's measured, and use the data to change course when needed.
  • Keep quality high where it counts, and know where good enough is fine.
  • When the product is ready to scale, invest in what growth needs: onboarding, reliability, self-serve, and integrations.
  • Work with sales, marketing, support, and operations on positioning, pricing, and launches, and bring what they hear back to the team.
  • Share clear updates with engineers, leadership, and partners on what we're learning and what's next.

Do you have the right ingredients? (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including owning a product or major product area and its results.
  • You've taken an early product from MVP to product-market fit and meaningful growth.
  • You can point to product decisions that came directly from time spent with customers.
  • You've made complex workflows simple for the people using them.
  • You understand how software gets built well enough to weigh tradeoffs with engineers, spot risks, and ask the right questions.
  • You've worked directly with engineering teams without a dedicated engineering manager, and you've owned planning and priorities week to week.
  • You're comfortable with metrics. You set goals up front and let the data change your mind.
  • You use AI tools regularly in your work and can explain specifically how.
  • You write and speak clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You're self-directed and low ego, and you keep things moving without perfect clarity.

Special sauce (Nice to Haves)

  • Experience in operationally complex industries.
  • Founder or early-startup experience, or time on an internal incubation or new ventures team.
  • You've built with LLMs or shipped AI-powered product experiences.
  • Experience pricing and packaging a new product.
  • You're comfortable pulling your own data with SQL or similar tools.
  • You've coded, or you prototype in code today.

title: EMEA People Operations Lead (Fixed-Term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
Please note this is a 12-month fixed term contract. 

Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy. Our PeopleHub team is the heartbeat of our People & Places function, responsible for building global scalable tools, systems, processes, and dashboards that support our employees at every stage of their employee journey. We are helping transform the way that the People and Places Team delivers service to employees.

As the EMEA People Operations Lead you will help build and deliver a frictionless employee experience across the employee lifecycle for our teams in EMEA and help shape a global "shared services" model as it scales. You will own front line support for employee inquiries including benefits and leave administration, alongside other operational activities and program delivery. This role carries real ownership: you are the person Toasters in EMEA come to in the moments that matter, and the person who spots what is not working and fixes it. To be successful you will bring a customer-centric and continuous improvement mindset, a proven ability to use technology and process to elevate the employee experience, strong stakeholder management, and experience in a shared services function within a global matrixed organization. 

This role reports to the PeopleHub Manager and will work closely with the PeopleHub Director and across our global centers of excellence (COEs).

This is a hybrid role requiring 2 days a week in our Dublin office.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Deliver front line People Services (Shared Services) support for the EMEA region across the employee lifecycle, including operations, benefits, leave administration, and compensation
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex EMEA cases, resolving them accurately, compliantly, and with a high standard of service
  • Track and report on metrics and service level agreements (SLAs) to measure service quality and provide insights for decision-making
  • Spot what is not working and bring forward ideas to fix it, with the autonomy to test and implement improvements
  • Drive continuous improvements focused on automation, standardization and scalability that improve the Toaster experience, increase efficiency, and ensure compliance with local laws and customs
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the People Team, Legal, Finance, and Business teams to influence change and drive adoption of an evolving service delivery model
  • Be the local subject matter expert who can influence Global COEs on program design that is locally relevant and compliant while aligned to global principles
  • Partner across the People & Places team globally to prioritize and deliver a variety of small to large, complex, integrated People team initiatives

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Professional fluency in English  and French (preferred), both written and spoken, with the ability to support Toasters and partner with stakeholders in both languages
  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience
  • Significant hands-on experience within People Operations or Shared Services functions
  • Experience operating in a matrixed structure, and influencing outcomes without direct authority
  • Experience with new entity creation and creation of complete employee lifecycle processes
  • Experience supporting Global HR Transformation: strategy, design, and transition of People Operations to create value for the organization
  • Working knowledge of labour regulations, GDPR requirements and best practices to help ensure Toast remains compliant
  • Familiarity with SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley), and experience working within SOX-compliant programs and processes

As an SMB Flex Territory Sales Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and expertise to help us build the Toast brand in your geographic territory. 

This is a Flex field sales opportunity based out of a personal home office. You must live local to the San Francisco region, or be willing to relocate to the area. This role requires travel apx 30% of the time.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close 
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

  • 1+ years of experience in a sourcing or closing sales role, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation (will reimburse for mileage)
  • Strong communication, organizational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment
  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible
  • General technical proficiency with software

descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The AI Agent & Experience team is Toast's internal platform team for AI. We build the infrastructure, governance, and developer tooling that makes AI a reliable, scalable force multiplier across the entire product development lifecycle. Our products include the LLM Proxy, AI Key Management, Observability pipelines, the Claude Plugin Marketplace, and autonomous agents that participate directly in the software development lifecycle.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll be hands-on building the systems that other Toast engineers depend on every day: the LLM proxy, agentic workflows, and the plugin marketplace that brings AI-native development practices to teams across the company.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Design, build, and ship features across AI platform infrastructure, including the LLM proxy, AI key management, and observability pipelines
  • Develop and extend autonomous agents that participate in the SDLC, such as the AI Review GitHub App and Developer Platform MCP integrations
  • Build on and contribute to the internal plugin marketplace, developing plugins that encode Toast's architectural standards and quality practices into AI assistant behavior
  • Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) services and service templates that make it faster and easier for teams across Toast to build AI-powered workflows
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate in design and code reviews
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and platform teams to understand developer needs and translate them into reliable platform solutions
  • Contribute to the team's adoption of agentic development practices and tooling
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

  • Bachelor’s Degree with relevant experience of 5+ years in designing and implementing scalable backend services
  • Demonstrated experience building, deploying, or operating LLM-powered agents or AI-assisted developer tooling
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and an interest in extending them through custom plugins, skills, or hooks
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool use patterns, or similar agentic integration frameworks
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering and how LLM behavior responds to context and instructions
  • Strong foundation in Java, Kotlin, or another object-oriented language

  • Strong customer empathy and a drive to make developers' lives better through reliable, well-designed platform solutions

  • Familiarity with A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocols and multi-agent orchestration patterns

title: Associate of R&D Strategic Finance (FP&A)
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast is driven by building a platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. Our Finance team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, guiding critical business decisions through insightful analyses & thought partnership with executive leaders. 

We are seeking an R&D Finance associate to own key aspects of our financial reporting, monthly and quarterly processes, and support critical planning activities within our R&D Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you’ll contribute to the foundation of our finance operations as we advance as a public company, with a focus on enhancing efficiency through process improvements and automation. You’ll work closely with our R&D and Corporate Finance team, and collaborate across functions to deliver essential insights and drive strategic initiatives for our senior R&D leaders.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Support Toast’s monthly and quarterly financial close processes for the R&D function, including reporting and analysis of budget vs. actual results, forecast updates, and preparation of standard financial packages that provide actionable insights for R&D leadership.
  • Own headcount tracking, reporting, and reconciliation activities for R&D, conducting trend analysis and collaborating closely with Finance, R&D leadership, and Talent Acquisition to align resource planning with strategic priorities.
  • Oversee the financial management for the R&D vendor portfolio, including PO and invoice reconciliation, variance analysis, and trend reporting to ensure alignment with budget and financial goals.
  • Leverage Toast’s financial systems, tools, and datasets to build and maintain standard reports and analyses, identifying opportunities to improve insight depth and forecast accuracy, specifically tailored to R&D’s unique needs and objectives.
  • Assess and refine existing financial processes for R&D, implementing automation and standardization initiatives to reduce manual workload and create efficiencies across the finance team.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams, to research, analyze, and advise on financial processes and reporting that directly support R&D’s innovation, operational, and financial goals.
  • Able to work 2 pm - 11 pm IST

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 4+ years of work experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, private equity, business operations or accounting
  • Strong analytical skills including financial modeling, data/trend analysis and manipulation of large datasets, with proven ability to summarize complex data into key takeaways
  • Highly proficient in advanced Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides
  • Experience working with financial systems, such as WorkDay, Adaptive, Greenhouse, NetSuite, or other similar products
  • Positive attitude with high aptitude to learn new things quickly. Team player eager to further develop and grow with us

title: Senior Software Engineer - Toast Connect
descriptionHtml:
Toast is building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: running the businesses they love. We’ve grown into a leading hospitality software company in the U.S., and are now entering our next phase of growth - one defined by scale, complexity, and a new class of enterprise customers.

Toast is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Toast Connect team in Dublin. The Connect team owns how everything outside Toast connects to Toast including the event infrastructure every team at Toast uses to publish data, the frameworks partners and customers use to integrate through our APIs, and a new charter to make Toast the source of truth for all the data about the customers we serve.

You will play a key role in evolving our platform to support ever more complex new features and best-in-class monitoring as we scale to orders of magnitude of our current size!

If you want to help create something tangible that is used every day, help businesses achieve their vision, and take on the challenge of scaling a SaaS product, Toast is the place for you.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain scalable backend microservices and RESTful APIs using Java / Kotlin and AWS infrastructure.
  • Lead complex projects that may span multiple teams & systems.
  • Champion best practices such quality automated testing and phased rollouts to ensure zero-regression releases and high test coverage.
  • Monitor service health for success & failure, analyze logs and metrics (Datadog/CloudWatch), and participate in on-call rotations to maintain platform uptime.
  • Collaborate with peer engineers, provide design feedback, and participate in code reviews.
  • Collaborate with PM & UX on the development of new features & products.
  • Mentor & coach your peer engineers.
  • Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your workflow, not an afterthought

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years professional backend software development in Kotlin, Java, or another object-oriented language, with solid instincts around testing and code quality.
  • Have strong understanding & hands-on experience of building RESTful apis, fault-tolerant, highly-scalable & secure distributed systems.
  • Proficiency with sql/nosql databases, strong understanding of distributed datastores and knowledge of when to use what.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts, asynchronous messaging (Kafka, Pulsar, or AWS SQS/SNS), and cloud platforms (AWS).
  • Strong communication & problem-solving skills, curiosity to learn restaurant domain workflows, and enthusiasm for collaborating in an agile, cross-functional team.
  • Demonstrate humility, empathy and respectfulness.

*This is a hybrid role requiring two days per week in the office*

What will help you stand out:

  • Experience designing platform APIs that other teams depend on - platform thinking, not just feature delivery
  • Comfort with document-based or columnar data stores a plus

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

What we use to make our dish: (Our Tech Stack)

  • Backend services which follow a microservice architecture written using Kotlin, Java and DropWizard
  • Event driven messaging & streaming using Apache Pulsar & RabbitMQ.
  • Apache Camel for implementing Enterprise Integration Pattern.
  • React & ES6 based Frontend SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook.
  • DynamoDb, Postgres & Opensearch as core persistence data-storage layers.
  • Datadog & Sentry for system and application metric and monitoring. 
  • Splunk for log aggregation.
  • FireHydrant for alerting.

You will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your territory. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build Toast across Canada.

Must live local to Calgary or willing to relocate. This is a field sales opportunity with 80% of your time spent in the field and 20% working from home. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Generate a list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus).
  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs. 
  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery.
  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities.
  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 1+ years of experience in a sourcing or closing sales role, restaurant operations, or a related field and industry.
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation (will reimburse for mileage).
  • Strong communication, organizational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels.
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment.
  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible.
  • General technical proficiency with software.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is nice to have.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Bready* to make a change?

Toast is a rapidly growing company that's revolutionizing how the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, team management, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale the platforms that calculate and deliver pay to restaurant employees, from tip pooling and redistribution to wage calculation, earnings retrieval, and payroll delivery. You'll lead highly visible, mission-critical infrastructure that determines what employees take home, and that powers products restaurant teams rely on every day.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Drive the evolution of our tips and earnings platforms, leading complex projects that improve functionality and reliability for our customers.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of systems, contributing to a strong engineering culture focused on correctness, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Lead projects from design and estimation through implementation, testing, and deployment to help shape how we build reliable systems at scale.
  • Ship code that directly impacts product revenue and the accuracy of what restaurant employees are paid.
  • Partner with product and design to influence what we build and how we build it.
  • Contribute to and elevate team standards through thoughtful code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other team members.
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude to accelerate development and pioneer better ways to work.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of back-end experience with one or more object-oriented programming languages (such as Java, Kotlin, or similar).
  • Proficient with modern web standards and technologies (e.g. React, TypeScript, REST, GraphQL).
  • Proficient with traditional databases and alternative data stores.
  • Experience owning and operating production systems.
  • Experience with distributed systems, enterprise messaging systems, and/or microservices.
  • A strong appreciation for precision and correctness, because when the output drives someone's paycheck, getting the calculation right matters.
  • A track record of tackling ambiguous, high-impact challenges and delivering scalable solutions.
  • Excellent cross-team communication skills on complex technical topics.
  • Passionate about technology and learning new things.

descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Over 180,000 restaurant businesses run on Toast.

About the team

OLAP Platform is the analytical data layer that powers real-time reporting for restaurants and agentic data access for AI-driven products across Toast. As Engineering Manager II, you will lead a growing engineering team in Dublin that owns this shared surface.

The team is in a pivotal stretch of work: scaling the platform to support more domains and consumers, keeping performance and cost in balance as it grows, and putting the governance in place to open it up safely to the next wave of AI-driven products. 

This is a role for an engineering leader who combines platform thinking, operational discipline, and strong cross-functional influence. You should be comfortable owning developer experience for internal engineering customers, driving technical strategy and creating clarity in a fast-moving environment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Define and drive the technical direction, strategy and execution as the platform scales to more domains and consumers.
  • Build the partnerships that make a shared platform work - aligning with consumer team leads on roadmaps and onboarding, and representing OLAP's priorities and constraints in cross-team forums
  • Bring an AI-first approach to team workflow, reducing manual effort, accelerating issue resolution and shaping how the platform serves AI-driven consumers safely and at scale.
  • Build outcome-oriented operating mechanisms, including metrics and monitoring, that keep consumer teams unblocked and give the platform team early signals when something is breaking or getting hot.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, helping them grow technically and as leaders.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, iteration, and platform stability must coexist.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 3+ years of experience leading high performing engineering teams, with experience of  platform teams or teams where internal developers were the primary consumer or end user.

  • A process-driven approach to engineering leadership, with experience creating operating mechanisms, metrics, monitoring, and feedback loops that improve outcomes over time.

title: Manager, Managed Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

Toast Marketing Services pairs restaurants with a dedicated Marketing Specialist to build strategy, execute weekly multi‑channel campaigns (Email, SMS, Social, Offers/Promos, Loyalty, Gift Cards, SEO/Presence), and analyze results—ultimately helping restaurants improve their marketing operations, save time, and grow first‑party demand.

As a  Manager, Managed Marketing, you will lead and coach a team of Marketing Specialists for full‑service marketing delivery). You’ll be accountable for day‑to‑day service execution, consistent quality, and outcomes for restaurants—owning capacity planning, SLAs, coaching, and operational excellence. This role is ideal for a people leader with a marketing background (agency or in‑house) who thrives at building repeatable delivery systems, raising the bar on craft, and partnering cross‑functionally to scale. 

You are a systems‑minded operator who can translate strategy into clear playbooks and measurable results. You’ll remove friction for Specialists and customers, strengthen our service model, and collaborate closely with Product, Product Strategy, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance. 

A day in the Life* (Responsibilities):

  • Lead and develop a high‑performing Specialist team: hire/onboard, set goals, run weekly 1:1s, conduct QA reviews of campaign calendars and copy, and create career development paths; establish coaching rhythms and calibration across the team. 
  • Own service delivery excellence: manage book‑of‑business assignments and capacity, track service progress and deadlines, and maintain response and delivery SLAs 
  • Execute against existing playbooks/templates and flag gaps: evolve playbooks, scripts, and templates for kickoff, monthly planning, multi‑channel execution (Email/SMS/Social/Offers/Ads), and monthly reporting; drive consistency across Specialists while allowing for restaurant brand nuance. Measure what matters: monitor dashboards and mechanisms for visibility into pipeline, progress, and outcomes (e.g., plan on‑time rate, SLA adherence, campaign send/approval rates, channel performance, attach/expansion signals, and customer satisfaction). 
  • Handle escalations and quality: serve as the first line for customer escalations; implement QA checklists and review cycles to ensure compliance with Toast Marketing Guidelines and legal/brand standards
  • Partner cross‑functionally to unlock scale: collaborate with Product and the Product Strategy team to pilot features and chart the path to scale
  • Document learnings and case studies: sharing wins within the pod/team 
  • Help build our UK playbook: London is a new market for us, so you'll help create and refine the playbooks, processes and best practices for the region.

What you’ll need to thrive* (Requirements):

  • 6+  years in marketing or marketing services, including 2+ years managing people in a delivery or account‑management context (e.g., agency team lead, or managed services lead). 
  • Demonstrated success running multi‑channel programs across Email, SMS, Social, Offers/Promos, Loyalty, Gift Cards—and partnering on Paid Ads and SEO/Presence. 
  • Process‑oriented leader with a track record of building playbooks, SLAs, and QA mechanisms that scale; comfortable with capacity planning and workload management. 
  • Strong marketing craft (strategy + execution) and coaching ability—able to uplevel content quality, segmentation, and testing, and communicate the “why” behind plans. 
  • Analytical, data‑driven decision maker—comfortable using KPIs/dashboards to guide the team  with defining KPIs, building dashboards, and translating performance into clear next actions for the team. 
  • Exceptional communicator and relationship‑builder across functions :immediate team + adjacent functions (CS, Sales) 
  • Comfort working in evolving environments; bias for systems thinking and continuous improvement.
  • Nice to have: restaurant, SMB, or martech experience; agency background spanning multiple channels

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
department: R & D : Cloud Service Infra : Platform Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer on the Compute & Storage Platform team in Toast, you will design, build, and operate the foundational distributed systems powering the Toast platform as the company expands into further international markets and broadens its product offerings to encompass retail shopping.

You will bridge the gap between core infrastructure and cutting-edge product development—building low-latency state and storage systems, scalable compute clusters, and high-throughput streaming pipelines. Your work will directly enable Toast product delivery across our Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC).

For this role it is a requirement that you have at least 8+ years of industry experience. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Online Databases and Storage: Architect, deploy, and manage low-latency, highly available storage solutions (RDS Postgres and Aurora Postgres; DynamoDB; OpenSearch; S3) to power applications across the Toast product ecosystem.
  • High Availability & Realtime Performance: Ensure sub-second end-user latency, near-zero-downtime reliability, and high throughput across storage engines to support Toast's products across POS, phone, computer, drive-thru, and kiosk interfaces.
  • Infrastructure for AI-Driven PDLC: Automate infrastructure provisioning and compute pipelines.
  • Cost Optimization & Performance Engineering: Right-size compute/storage resources, implement auto-scaling policies, and manage AWS infrastructure costs without compromising platform reliability or latency SLAs.

Required Qualifications

1. Core Infrastructure & Automation

  • Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience building and managing scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).
  • Software Development: Fluency in Python, Go, or a similar language for infrastructure automation, tooling, or backend development.

2. Storage & Compute Operations

  • Databases: Deep experience operating and tuning enterprise databases at scale. This should include at least one variety of relational database (such as Postgres, Oracle, or MySQL) and at least one type of nonrelational database (such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, Opensearch).
  • Containerization: Experience working with containerized environments and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes).

3. Systems Reliability & Observability

  • Solid understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including monitoring, alerting, health checks, and performance troubleshooting in high-traffic environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Observability & Telemetry with Datadog, Prometheus
  • AI/ML Infrastructure support
  • Cloud Cost Optimization

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s commercial products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend microservices, guest- and restaurant-facing web apps, payment systems, event buses, and more. 

The Infrastructure Engineering group manages Toast's infrastructure via the AWS API, using configuration management tools like Terraform, Ansible, and internally developed clients using Python and Go. We rely heavily on Datadog and Splunk for monitoring and observability and on FireHydrant for alerting and incident response.

Infrastructure Engineering provides the products and services to support, deploy, and monitor our product suite, which uses a microservice architecture written using JVM and Node.js apps. AWS products are also in heavy usage, ranging from S3 to RDS, DynamoDB, ECS, Lambda, and many others. We have our own platform for user management, service discovery/elevations, and load balancing. We use Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data synchronization between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ and Apache Pulsar clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the applications' RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

Why Join Us?

You will be at the ground floor of building the data-storage systems that powers our flagship products. You'll solve complex, high-scale infrastructure challenges at the intersection of distributed storage and compute.

title: Senior Manager, CS Data & Analytics
department: Customer Success : Customer Success Operations : Customer Success Data
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Customer Success Data & Analytics (CSDA) team sets the standards for how data is used across Customer Success, building the foundational data and tooling that help CS deliver a better, more efficient customer experience. With a data engineering team rebuilding the CS data model and an Applied AI & Data Science lead embedded on the team, we’re building what analytics looks like in the AI era.

As Senior Manager, Customer Success & Experience Analytics, you’ll be the analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping how the organization understands its performance and its customers, with a focus on customer experience and enablement. Reporting to the Senior Director of CS Data & Analytics, you’ll lead two analysts and bring a holistic customer view by connecting data across Care, Onboarding, Enablement, and Product.

This role is ideal for a player-coach who is energized by ambiguous problems, works iteratively, and isn’t only one kind of data person. Their home base is analytics, with a real interest in data science and analytics engineering. They don’t need to be an expert in either, just passionate about expanding their knowledge, something AI tools now put within reach for anyone.

This role will work hybrid 2 days / week out of our Boston office. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Run the Customer Success Business Review: Own the tools and mechanisms behind the weekly review, driving rigorous but efficient inspection of key business indicators and hosting insightful discussions with business owners about their successes and challenges.
  • Lead Analytics for Customer Experience & Voice of the Customer: Be a major contributor to the CX and VOC programs by owning the analytics behind them: the reporting, insights, and recommendations that help the business improve how customers experience Toast. Go beyond what the numbers say to why they move, making sure we measure and manage the right inputs for the outcomes we care about. Use survey verbatims, contact transcripts, and other unstructured data alongside traditional metrics.
  • Measure Education & Enablement Impact: Own the framework connecting training, self-service content, and in-product guidance to ticket reduction, self-service, and adoption. Design test-and-control measurement, set baselines before programs launch, and drive a data-first culture in customer education.
  • Lead the Team & Shape the Data Foundation: Grow a team of talented analysts and support the ownership they bring to their areas. Run a transparent intake and prioritization process, and expand self-service through AI tooling and well-documented data. Partner with data engineering on the CS data model rebuild, and bring the Applied AI & Data Science lead well-framed problems worth modeling.

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Experience: 8+ years in analytics, BI, or data science, including 2+ years leading analysts, with a track record of owning a recurring executive business review and turning ambiguous questions into scoped, answerable analyses.
  • Hands-on experience extracting insight from unstructured data such as survey verbatims or support transcripts
  • Working comfort with statistics and experimental design. You’ve dabbled in data science, such as running a regression to find what drives NPS or a classification model to find themes in text, and you know control groups, matched cohorts, and pre/post baselining. You use these methods for exploratory work and partner with a data scientist on anything production-grade
  • Strong SQL, fluency with a modern data stack (Snowflake, Hex, dbt, or equivalent), and a clear point of view on data visualization and what makes a dashboard or analytical artifact useful
  • A tinkerer and builder with hands-on experience using AI for analytics, whether to speed up analysis, automate recurring work, or build self-serve tools for stakeholders
  • Direct experience with customer success, customer experience, or support data (NPS/CSAT programs, ticket and contact data, CRM), ideally in SaaS or restaurant technology
  • Ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations for senior leaders, and to push back constructively when a question can’t be answered cleanly

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience measuring training, enablement, or customer adoption programs
  • Experience with text analytics or topic modeling, or a strong point of view on modeling operational inputs to outcomes like NPS
  • Experience using AI to build agents, apps, or other products that enable new and creative uses of data

descriptionHtml:

As Associate Counsel, Product and Marketing, you will be a partner to your business colleagues and advise multiple Toast teams including product, engineering, marketing, compliance, and sales teams. You will learn Toast's products, strategies, and processes, and help the business identify and mitigate legal risk while helping Toast grow and evolve.
