title: Principal TA Systems Architect
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. At Toast, Talent Acquisition runs on its tools. Greenhouse, GoodTime, and BrightHire are where every requisition, interview, and hiring decision actually happens — and no single person owns them end-to-end today. That is this role.

As a Principal TA Systems Architect, you will be the technical owner of the TA tech stack: the person who configures it, integrates it, secures it, measures it, and decides where it goes next. You will partner closely with the TA Operations who live in these systems every day, with the broader People Systems and People Analytics teams who own the HRIS and downstream data, and with IT, Security, Legal, and Procurement on access, privacy, and purchasing. You will own the vendor relationships — roadmap conversations, renewals, escalations — and hold our partners to a standard.

This is an individual contributor role today with a clear path to building and leading a small team as the function scales. If you want to own a domain, be the deepest expert in the building on it, and eventually hire people to extend it, this is that job.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Own the stack: Serve as system owner and top-tier administrator for Greenhouse, GoodTime, and BrightHire — configuration, permissions, workflows, approval chains, compliance settings, and release management.
  • Own the integration layer between TA systems and the rest of the People stack: HRIS, background check, assessments, sourcing, and offer tooling, including API-based integrations and middleware.
  • Run intake-to-resolution on system issues: triage, root-cause, fix, and close the loop with whoever reported it.
  • Hold the change management discipline the stack needs — sandbox testing, documented configuration decisions, release notes, and user communications.
  • Partner across the People organization and drive the roadmap: Work directly with recruiters, sourcers, coordinators, and TA leadership to find where the process actually breaks, and translate that into system solutions instead of more manual workarounds.
  • Partner with People Systems, People Analytics, IT, Security, and Legal so TA systems fit the broader architecture: clean data flows, sane access models, defensible privacy and records practices.
  • Build and own a multi-quarter TA systems roadmap, and make the case for what is worth doing and what is not.
  • Evaluate new tooling — including AI-enabled recruiting tools — with real rigor: pilot design, success criteria, security review, and an honest recommendation.
  • Manage the vendors: Own day-to-day vendor relationships and act as the escalation point for outages, defects, and support issues.
  • Run renewals and new purchases alongside Procurement and Finance: usage data, business case, and negotiation support.
  • Hold vendors accountable to roadmap commitments and service levels; represent us in customer advisory boards and beta programs.
  • Build and automate: Write the scripts, queries, and automations that eliminate manual work — data cleanup, bulk updates, custom reporting, alerting on integration failures.
  • Build and maintain TA reporting and dashboards, and be the person who can definitively answer whether a recruiting number is right.
  • Document the architecture, integrations, configuration decisions, and runbooks so the stack does not live in one person’s head.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in HR or TA systems, People Systems, or a closely adjacent systems role, including hands-on ownership of an ATS at scale. Greenhouse experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience with gathering business requirements, translating into technical solutions, and ultimately bringing solutions to life (project management, UAT, release management, and prod support).
  • Deep, current administrative expertise in at least one core recruiting platform, and a demonstrated ability to get to that depth quickly on new ones.
  • Real technical fluency: comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON; experienced with iPaaS or middleware tooling (Workato, Tray, Merge, Zapier, or similar).
  • Experience integrating an ATS with an HRIS (Workday, UKG, or similar) and a working understanding of where recruiting data goes downstream and why it matters.
  • Proven vendor management experience: renewals, escalations, and holding a partner to their commitments.
  • Excellent partnership skills with non-technical stakeholders. You can sit with a recruiter, watch them work, and see the system problem underneath the complaint.
  • Practical knowledge of the compliance environment around recruiting data: EEOC and OFCCP requirements, GDPR/CCPA, data retention, and interview recording consent.

Bonus Points (Nice-To-Haves)

  • Direct administrative experience with GoodTime and BrightHire.
  • Experience standing up, migrating, or consolidating an ATS.
  • Prior people management, or experience mentoring and leading a systems function.
  • Experience evaluating and deploying AI tooling inside a live recruiting workflow.
  • Familiarity with high-volume and field-based hiring models.

What success looks like in your first year:

  • Recruiters trust the systems and stop building spreadsheets around them.
  • Adoption of existing/newly implemented TA tools (90%)
  • Integration failures are caught by monitoring, not by a recruiter noticing.
  • Every core TA system has a documented owner, configuration record, and roadmap.
  • Renewals are decided on usage and outcome data, not on inertia.

descriptionHtml:
About Toast:Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

Are you bready* for a change?The Product-Led Growth team builds the in-product experiences that help restaurants discover, try, buy, and adopt the Toast products they need. We own the services and surfaces that decide which restaurants see which offers, carry them through purchase and activation inside the product, and tell us whether it worked.

This is measurable, revenue-attached work. Every experience we ship has a conversion metric behind it, and we know within weeks whether it worked. We're a small team with a large surface area, and we're early in turning PLG from a set of hand-built campaigns into a platform: shared targeting, offer delivery, purchase, and measurement services that let us launch a new experiment in days instead of weeks.

You'll ship experiments into production, read the results, and decide what comes next, and you'll build the shared services that make each launch faster than the last. You'll work with product, marketing, sales operations, and data science to turn a hypothesis about customer behavior into a targeted in-product experience, then prove or disprove it with data.

About this roll*

  • Drive end-to-end development of the backend services that power in-product growth experiences: eligibility, targeting, offer delivery, self-serve purchase, activation, and conversion tracking, owning the full lifecycle and iterating on measured outcomes.
  • Build the shared infrastructure that makes the next experiment cheaper than the last: reusable targeting and eligibility services, campaign configuration, and a purchase flow that new offers plug into rather than rebuild.
  • Build and evolve integrations with the systems those services depend on, consuming propensity scores, Toast IQ recommendations, and CMS-driven campaign controls, and connecting to billing, contracting, and provisioning systems so a restaurant can complete a purchase inside the product.
  • Build LLM-powered experiences on Toast IQ, from prompt and tool design through evaluation and production monitoring.
  • Design experimentation and attribution instrumentation so every launch has a clear measurement story, and use production data to kill or scale experiences quickly.
  • Partner with product, design, marketing, sales, and data science to translate business goals like adoption and upsell targets into concrete, testable product changes.
  • Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, and help set engineering standards for a team that is growing.
  • Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.

Do you have the right ingredients*?

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building and maintaining production backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another object-oriented language, with enough full-stack experience to ship web or native front-end changes when needed.
  • Proven ability to own features end-to-end through design, launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Product-minded builder who is comfortable making product calls, launching, and iterating on what customers actually do, working across PM, design, and sales rather than executing tickets.
  • Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or growth engineering, and a working understanding of attribution: you can explain why a metric moved and whether to believe it.
  • Experience building on LLMs or AI platforms, in production or in side projects. Interest in agents and tool use is a bonus.
  • Experience building customer-facing features on top of data products such as scores, segments, or recommendations is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), New York (hybrid), San Francisco (hybrid)

Bready* to make a change?

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people - and increasingly shaped by AI in both what we build and how we build - restaurants can trust that we'll deliver on their needs for today while investing in the experiences that will power their restaurant of the future.

Developer Experience builds the tools and platforms Toast engineers use to write, build, and understand their code. We own local development environments and the inner loop, build tooling and shared libraries, and the internal developer portal and self-service golden paths. We also empower developers across the company by building and maintaining the testing frameworks and core libraries used for developing web services. We contribute to the AI developer workflows that are changing how software gets built at Toast. Our goal is to make every engineer at Toast faster, more independent, and more confident in what they ship.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for how Toast engineers build software. You'll pick the highest-leverage problems in the developer workflow, design solutions that work across hundreds of services and many teams, and stay hands-on while you build them. AI is quickly changing what developer tooling can do, and you'll help define what an AI-native developer experience looks like at Toast.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Set technical direction and long-term architecture across Developer Experience's areas: local development, build tooling, shared libraries, and the developer portal.
  • Oversee the architecture of the testing frameworks and core libraries used for developing web services.
  • Stay hands-on: design, build, and ship the highest leverage and most cross-cutting parts of the platform yourself.
  • Collaborate with Product using data and direct engineer feedback to find the biggest sources of friction in the developer workflow, and help turn them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap.

title: Director, UCC & Tax Lien Compliance
descriptionHtml:
At Toast, we are passionate about creating raving fans and delivering an unparalleled customer experience — and that includes assisting our restaurant customers when their business becomes entangled in a creditor dispute. When a lien, levy, or garnishment is filed against a merchant, our customers need a partner who moves quickly, communicates clearly, and gets it right the first time. As Toast brings the end-to-end management of liens and levies in-house, we need an experienced subject matter expert to build and lead this function from the ground up.

As the Director, UCC & Tax Lien Compliance, you will own the day-to-day operational management of Toast's merchant liens and levies and bankruptcy compliance programs, build the specialized team and processes required to run it well, and lead the insourcing of this function in close partnership with Compliance, Care, Product and Engineering and Legal. This is a hands-on, build-it role: you'll inherit an active, high-visibility function with real customer and compliance stakes, and you'll be the person who turns it into a well-governed, scalable operation.

About this role

Strategic Ownership

  • Build and maintain a state-by-state policy framework.
  • Build the governance backbone for the function: SOPs, decision frameworks, case tracking, and closed-loop quality review, so that policy is applied consistently across the team and holds up to audit and legal scrutiny.
  • Determine the right tools and systems required to manage an effective Liens & Levies compliance process, work with product and impacted stakeholders to minimize losses to Toast.
  • Own the phased liens and levies compliance transition plan with Toast's third-party partner, including data-sharing, visibility, and handoff of withholding and remittance responsibilities.
  • Establish and own the escalation path for complex or high-risk cases (e.g., competing creditor claims, disputed releases, bankruptcy proceedings, fraudulent or ambiguous documentation), partnering with Risk, Legal, and third-party fintech partners (e.g., payment processors) to reach sound, consistent decisions.
  • Define and track operational KPIs (e.g., resolution time, case volume, escalation rates) and report progress and risk to cross-functional and executive stakeholders.

Operational Ownership

  • Own the day-to-day management and execution of Toast's merchant liens and levies compliance program, including customer communications, intake, validation, withholding, escalations, complex/unique scenario handling, remittance, and release, serving as the subject matter expert to bring and operate this function in-house.
  • Drive the operational process work required to insource the liens and levies compliance functions currently managed by a third-party partner, including business requirements, workflow design, and transition sequencing, in partnership with Fintech Product, Engineering, Legal and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Build and lead a dedicated liens & levies oversight team within Fintech Risk, defining roles, workflows, staffing needs, and training as case volume scales.
  • Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on handling liens, levies, garnishments, and similar legal orders — including UCC filings, judgment liens, tax levies, bankruptcy implications, lien priority, and change-of-ownership/change-of-legal-entity scenarios — and translate that expertise into developing, owning, and maintaining clear, defensible policies, procedures and processes. 
  • Represent the team in cross-functional planning with Legal, Fintech, and Engineering as the technical build (case management, funds management, and reporting systems) is scoped and delivered.

Do you have the right ingredients?

  • 7+ years of experience working with UCC and tax liens, levies, bankruptcies, and garnishments and the associated compliance requirements, as well as change and people leadership experience.
  • Experience developing compliance management programs for regulated functions. 
  • Experience managing complex, sensitive escalations directly with customers, creditors, and their attorneys, exercising sound judgment on matters with real legal and financial consequences.
  • Deep subject matter expertise in the mechanics, legal/regulatory distinctions, and compliance requirements applicable to different types of liens, levies, and garnishments — including UCC-1 filings, judgment liens, tax levies, and lien priority–and how each is impacted by different events impacting merchants, such as bankruptcy, business organizational changes (e.g., change of ownership and mergers/acquisitions), and know your customers (KYC)/know your business (KYB) requirements and events.
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape surrounding merchant funds handling, such as state-by-state garnishment and levy requirements, and money transmission/payment facilitator obligations, and strong knowledge of UCC Article 9 concepts as they apply to secured creditor claims.
  • Demonstrated ability to build an operating model, team, and governance structure where none previously existed, with comfort operating in ambiguity while a function transitions between partners and systems.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership skills — able to align Legal, Risk & Compliance, Engineering, Finance, and Customer Care around a shared process and drive decisions to closure without direct authority over every stakeholder.
  • Experience managing a vendor or partner transition (e.g., insourcing a previously outsourced function), including defining business requirements and partnering with technical teams on system design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal/operational nuance into clear guidance for frontline teams and concise updates for executive stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; a background in banking operations, legal/paralegal work, or compliance is a plus but not required.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Android
descriptionHtml:
Ability to work EST hours required!

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

At Toast, we are committed to empowering our customers by providing the technology, resources, and community they need to thrive. While our roots are in food service, we are rapidly expanding into adjacent markets and international territories. Our mission is to build a world-class Device Management platform that supports the diverse needs of all Toast customers, regardless of their industry or location.

As a member of the Android Systems team, you will bridge the gap between hardware and software to build the foundational platform for Toast POS devices. Whether it’s an international team looking to deploy a new on-device application, a customer needing a critical firmware update, an Enterprise group needing multi-location device tooling - our systems empower customers to set up, secure, and manage their devices from wherever they are.

Why this team?

  • Expanding the Vision: We are expanding our Mobile Device Management ecosystem—unifying firmware, on-device apps, and security controls into one cohesive platform.
  • Frictionless Device Management: We are transforming the customer’s device lifecycle experience from out-of-the-box setup to continuous remote management, leveraging AI to dramatically reduce operator’s time spent troubleshooting and configuring devices.

About this roll* (Responsibilities):

  • Own the design and delivery of features across Toast's Android system applications in Kotlin and Java, including device policy enforcement, out-of-box device setup, and firmware and app updates.
  • Write technical designs for features that span on-device apps, cloud services, and Toast hardware, and lead effort estimation and planning for your projects.
  • Build reliable background services that run on devices with little to no user interaction, and deploy them safely to the Toast fleet using feature flags, staged rollouts, and monitoring for success.
  • Lead Android application upgrades in support of new Toast Hardware and Android OS upgrades for our system apps, working closely with Hardware and Firmware partners.
  • Raise the quality bar by expanding our end-to-end automated testing on real Toast hardware with Robot Framework, reducing manual regression testing.
  • Lead the investigation of complex production issues across the fleet, and partner with Customer Care and pilot customers during device rollouts.
  • Mentor engineers on the team through code review, design feedback, and pairing.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Hardware, QA, and other Software teams to build scalable systems, making solid technical decisions with quality, security, and maintainability in mind.
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building, contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements):

  • 6+ years of Android application development experience.
  • Proficient in a modern object-oriented programming language such as Kotlin or Java.
  • Deep experience with standard Android architecture patterns & libraries such as Hilt, AndroidX libraries, and Kotlin Coroutines.
  • Solid understanding of Android application and service lifecycles, background work, and inter-process communication.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional project with multiple engineers, product, QA, & design teams on a project from initial ideation through launch and supporting it in production.
  • Proven ability to debug complex issues across the app, framework, and OS layers using tools such as adb, logcat, and bug reports.
  • Experience using AI tools throughout the development lifecycle, from design and coding to testing and debugging.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including writing technical designs.
  • Strong customer empathy and a drive to build reliable tools that make restaurant operators' lives easier.

Bonus ingredients*:

  • Experience developing Android software for devices domain accounting for offline mode, battery impact, background services, etc.
  • Experience with the Android framework, AOSP, system services, or system apps written in Kotlin or Java.
  • Experience with Android Device Owner / Device Policy Controller APIs.
  • Understanding of mobile device management (MDM) concepts and enterprise device management platforms.
  • Experience shipping software to a large fleet of devices (e.g., OTA updates, staged rollouts).
  • Experience writing automated tests using Robot, UIAutomator or other testing frameworks.

What we use to make our dish* (Our Tech Stack):

  • Android system apps written in Kotlin with modern Android libraries, running with device-owner privileges on Toast hardware.
  • Kotlin backend services built on AWS that manage device policies, firmware updates, and device configuration.
  • React and TypeScript web apps built on Toast's in-house design system.
  • End-to-end automated testing on real Toast devices with Robot Framework, alongside unit and integration test suites.
  • Feature flags, staged rollouts, and production monitoring to ship safely to a large device fleet.

descriptionHtml:
Now, more than ever, the Toast team is committed to our customers. We’re taking steps to help restaurants navigate these unprecedented times with technology, resources, and community. Our focus is on building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we’ll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant in the future. 

Are you ready for a change?

We are looking for an experienced software engineer to play a critical role in further scaling and developing Toast’s cloud platform and infrastructure. Toast’s platform processes billions of requests per day from hundreds of internal services and hundreds of thousands of mobile devices; these numbers grow exponentially year over year as we add new restaurants and capabilities to the platform. Our team is responsible for developing secure, observable, highly available, large-scale shared services and infrastructure.

  • Architect, design, and deliver ultra-reliable, high-performance services and infrastructure used by millions
  • Uncover and resolve performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, databases, and APIs
  • Define and enable adherence to engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines
  • Collaborate closely with the Product team to influence features, technical direction, and long-term product vision

Do you have the right ingredients?

  • Hands-on experience building and operating complex, mission-critical, large-scale distributed systems in the Cloud
  • Expertise in asynchronous messaging, event-driven architecture, APIs, and integration patterns
  • Track record of delivering clean, maintainable, and resilient code that stands the test of time
  • Proficiency in Java or Kotlin preferred (experience in other modern programming languages also valued)
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams
  • A demonstrated record of mentoring junior team members and enhancing the team's effectiveness

Tech Stack

Our team builds and operates on a modern, cloud-native stack with heavy use of AWS, developing services and shared libraries in Kotlin and Go backed by PostgreSQL and DynamoDB. Infrastructure is provisioned and managed with Terraform. We oversee Toast’s sharded PostgreSQL databases, own and drive the organization’s use of Apache Pulsar to enable event-driven architecture at scale, and provide developers with tools and services to easily schedule recurring jobs. Our systems also power customer engagement, integrating with SMS and email providers to reliably deliver millions of messages per day.

title: Principal Product Manager,  Kitchen Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
*EST OR CST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Kitchen Operations team owns one of Toast's most operationally critical and strategically exciting products: the Kitchen Display System (KDS). Deployed across tens of thousands of restaurants, Toast KDS is the connective tissue between front-of-house and back-of-house, routing tickets to the right prep stations, managing order sequencing, and helping kitchens run fast and accurately under pressure. KDS has strong growth across SMB, enterprise, and international segments.

Our vision is KDS in the vast majority of Toast kitchens within the next few years. Getting there means three things: supporting the most sophisticated enterprise kitchen workflows in the market, differentiating through kitchen data and AI-powered operational insights, and growing adoption among the restaurants that still run on paper tickets.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role at the intersection of restaurant operations, hardware-software product, and applied AI. You'll shape how hundreds of thousands of kitchen workers run their stations every day — and you'll be the one building the data and agent layer that lets kitchens run smarter, not just faster.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Own and drive the KDS product strategy — enterprise workflow depth, data differentiation, SMB attach growth, and the agentic AI roadmap — connecting investments to Toast's kitchen adoption vision and near-term business outcomes including ARR growth, support ticket reduction, and enterprise retention.
  • Define where agentic AI creates real value in the kitchen: proactive prep time adjustments based on real-time order load, automatic kitchen configuration changes tied to labor schedules or ordering channel mix, intelligent ticket routing and load balancing — and build the investment case to pursue the highest-leverage bets.
  • Own KDS delivery end-to-end, working directly with large restaurant groups to translate complex, high-stakes workflow requirements into scalable product decisions that serve the whole market.
  • Lead the KDS kitchen data strategy: define what kitchen efficiency insights should look like for operators at every scale, from API-first analytics for enterprise operators to actionable reporting for SMBs, and sequence the investments to unlock it.
  • Shape and validate the business case for the next-generation KDS strategy — the long-horizon bets that drive future growth.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Qualifications)

  • Proven experience defining and owning product strategy for a complex, operationally critical product — bonus points if it spans hardware and software and/or have experience in food & beverage.
  • Creative and strategic: you don't just optimize existing products — you identify the next meaningful bet, make the case for it, and drive it from zero to conviction.
  • Curiosity and a point of view on AI and agentic product opportunities in operational environments — you don't need to have shipped an agent, but you should have a clear perspective on where autonomous action creates real value vs. real risk.
  • Track record of working directly with enterprise customers, translating nuanced, high-stakes workflow requirements into product decisions that scale well beyond a single logo.
  • Strong instincts for the SMB operator: you understand what it means to run a restaurant kitchen without a data analyst, an IT team, or a change management budget — and you can build for that reality.
  • Executive presence to drive alignment without authority across engineering, design, enterprise customer success, sales, and product leadership in a high-stakes, cross-functional environment.

title: Manager, Embedded Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Beyond point-of-sale and digital ordering, Toast offers financial solutions, including Toast Capital, that help restaurants access the funding they need to grow. We are building a new Embedded Finance Operations footprint in Bengaluru, and we're looking for the leader who will build it. This role is an extended arm of Toast's US Embedded Finance Operations team (40+ people) and is critical as we expand our footprint and international strategy. The role sits within the Embedded Finance Operations organization and partners closely with the US-based underwriting team and its leaders. As Manager of Embedded Finance, you will set up and lead a high-performing underwriting function from the ground up, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Risk partners in Bengaluru and with your leadership in the US.

This is a player-coach role. You'll understand the lending business deeply enough to make and review credit decisions yourself, while building the team, processes, and tooling that let the function scale. 

The scope is big. This team sits at the center of how Toast uses automation, data, and AI to change how lending operations work. If you're a lending operations leader who loves building something new, brings an automation and analytics mindset, and can lead people through change, read on!

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Build the underwriting function from the ground up. Stand up Toast's Embedded Finance Operations presence in Bengaluru: define the operating model, workflows, quality standards, SLAs, and controls for a high-performing underwriting team.
  • Lead as a player-coach. Manage a team of underwriters directly and few team members on a dotted line. Stay hands-on with underwriting decisions, case reviews, and escalations while coaching the team to consistent, high-quality outcomes.
  • Hire and grow the team. Partner on annual planning to shape headcount and capacity needs, then recruit, onboard, and develop talent as the team expands.
  • Drive automation and AI transformation. Find opportunities to automate manual underwriting and operations work, and partner with Product and Engineering to build and roll out AI-enabled tools, decisioning workflows, and self-serve processes.
  • Make operations data-driven. Define the metrics that matter (throughput, turnaround time, decision quality, accuracy) and build the BI dashboards and analytics that track performance, surface risk, and guide decisions.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships. Act as the operations voice to Product, Engineering, and Risk stakeholders in Bengaluru. Translate operational insight into product requirements and policy feedback.
  • Work as part of a global team. Partner closely with the US-based underwriting team and leaders, and with global Embedded Finance counterparts, to align on priorities, policies, and standards across time zones.
  • Lead through change. Guide the team through new processes, tools, and ways of working with clear communication, empathy, and a steady focus on outcomes.
  • Maintain strong risk and compliance discipline. Make sure underwriting practices follow credit policy, regulatory expectations, and internal controls, and support audits and reviews as needed.
  • Use AI tools in your own workflow and help set how the team uses them well, including how to critically evaluate what they produce.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 10+ years of experience in lending, credit, or financial services operations, with a strong understanding of the lending business and the underwriting lifecycle.
  • Hands-on underwriting or credit decisioning experience (small business, merchant, or commercial lending preferred), with the judgment to make and review complex credit calls.
  • Proven people leadership experience: you have managed and grown teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and building team culture.
  • Experience building or scaling an operations function, ideally in a new market or a new team.
  • A strong background in process automation, BI, and data analytics. You can work with data directly (e.g., SQL, Excel, Looker, Tableau or similar) and use it to drive decisions.
  • A track record of leading teams through change, including adopting new tools, processes, or operating models.
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and Risk partners without direct authority.
  • Experience working in global teams and collaborating across time zones, including regular overlap with US-based leadership.
  • Strategic thinking combined with an execution-focused, roll-up-your-sleeves approach.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain complex operational and credit topics simply to a range of audiences.
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to improve productivity and decision-making, with the judgment to validate what they produce.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience in fintech, embedded finance, or merchant cash advance / small business lending.
  • Experience implementing AI or machine-learning-assisted decisioning or workflow automation in an operations setting.
  • Experience setting up a new center of excellence or global capability center in India.
  • Familiarity with credit risk frameworks, fraud prevention, or KYC/KYB processes.

You’ll also help drive AI adoption and fluency across the broader marketing org. You’ll be a part of the Marketing Operations AI Team, with a dotted line to Web & eCommerce, and work with Web Platform, CRO, PMM, SEO, Legal and Brand.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) In your first 6 months: you’ll measurably cut web production cycle time and lift visit-to-opportunity conversion through AI-powered site experiences.

Web production responsibilities 

  • Map the page and copy the production process, including the SEO, PMM, Legal and Brand checkpoints, and build AI workflows that cut cycle time and rework.
  • Standardize requirements intake with templates, intake agents and automated briefs.
  • Build efficiencies in Contentful, its plug-ins and connected tools with Web Platform engineering.

Website experience responsibilities

  • Assist in building AI-powered experiences that improve visit-to-opportunity conversion.

  • Configure and improve third-party tools: on-site chat, data enrichment, voice AI and personalization.

Scale responsibilities

title: Manager, Marketing Operations - Ad Tech Lead
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We create technology to help businesses grow and succeed. Our Marketing Operations team is looking for a technically sharp, operationally minded Manager to own the infrastructure behind our paid media program — from pixel to pipeline, feed to finance. This role is the engine behind our buying team, ensuring every campaign we run is accurately tracked and our media buyers can focus on performance rather than data.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Own the full signal path for Paid: serve as the single technical owner across Tracking/Pixels, Program/Campaign, Audience/Conversions API, and Control Tower - partnering with Paid on requirements once and carrying them across every team, rather than Paid routing to individuals separately
  • Tag & pixel infrastructure: own event tracking, conversion signals, and audience data flows across ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Bing, ChatGPT, etc.) via offline conversion tracking and server-side tagging
  • Marketing automation: manage and optimize Marketo paid program setup, scoring, audience segmentation, and integration with ad platforms
  • Data operations: manage CRM audience syncs and data pipelines between source systems and ad platforms using ETL systems
  • UTM & tracking governance: define and enforce naming conventions, UTM taxonomy, QA checklists, and bulk build processes to ensure every campaign launched is trackable and consistent
  • Platform integrations & API management: manage connections between marketing tech systems (Marketo, Salesforce, ad platforms) and troubleshoot data discrepancies across the stack
  • Launch playbooks & QA framework: build and maintain the launch playbook for new vendors, channels, and tests; own time-to-launch as a core metric and continuously shrink it
  • Control Tower & monitoring: own Paid's coverage within our Control Tower alerting suite, publish and follow a QA cadence (daily monitors, monthly tests, quarterly audits), and drive down time-to-detect on data issues
  • Reporting & analytics infrastructure: maintain and QA the data pipelines that feed performance dashboards, ensuring campaign, lead, and conversion data is accurate and available for stakeholder reporting
  • Audience operations: build, maintain, and refresh CRM-based audience lists for suppression, retargeting, and lookalike seeding across ad platforms

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in marketing operations, ad tech, or marketing analytics
  • Experience managing infrastructure for paid spend at $10M+ a year across 3+ ad platforms
  • Hands-on experience with offline conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or equivalent), including sending CRM-stage conversions back to platforms
  • Experience with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Experience with CRM systems and lead routing logic (Salesforce or equivalent)
  • Experience managing data pipelines and integrations via Hightouch or similar ETL tools
  • Strong UTM governance and tracking QA across multi-channel paid campaigns
  • Track record operating as an embedded technical partner to a Paid/growth team — driving requirements proactively rather than waiting on tickets
  • Ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and communicate findings to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong attention to detail and a bias toward process and documentation
  • A sense of humor

Special Sauce* (nice to haves)

  • Owned a cost efficiency metric as part of your function
  • Part of the team or led the move to value-based bidding with measurable CAC or pipeline impact
  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Proficiency with Marketo, including program setup, lead scoring, and ad platform integrations
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including lead routing, campaign attribution, and data hygiene
  • Experience with a CDP or data warehouse tool (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery)
  • Familiarity with SQL for data QA and ad-hoc reporting
  • Experience with TikTok or other emerging ad platform integrations beyond Meta and Google
  • Prior experience in an embedded ops role supporting a paid media team

title: Product Manager, Toast Ticketing
descriptionHtml:
Locations: US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred


Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast Tables is Toast's reservations and waitlist product. Thousands of restaurants run their dining room on it: reservations, waitlist, and payments, built into the Toast point of sale. Toast Ticketing is the newest part of it. It lets a restaurant or venue sell tickets to its own events (a wine dinner, a comedy night, a holiday pre-order) on its public booking page, take payment, and check guests in at the door.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own Toast Ticketing end to end. Ticketing is in open beta: any restaurant on Tables Plus (the paid tier of Toast Tables) can turn it on themselves, guests buy tickets on the restaurant's public booking page, and the host scans them in at the door. The next job is product-market fit, a commercial motion with sales and onboarding, and general availability. This is a senior individual contributor role. You report to the Toast Tables product lead and work day to day with the engineers who build ticketing, a design partner, and go-to-market (GTM) partners in sales, onboarding, and marketing.

You spend a lot of time with customers: on calls, on site, and watching real events get published, sell, and run. The restaurants running events on it talk to us every week, and what they tell us sets the backlog. You have a strong sense for the next right thing to build, and you keep scope tight so the team ships what matters most. You use AI tools every day to prototype, research, analyze data, and check your own thinking.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the ticketing roadmap and strategy from open beta to general availability to scale, including where ticketing fits in Toast's guest platform and how it reaches venues beyond today's restaurants.
  • Run the weekly build loop with engineering: framing problems, deciding what ships each week and why, and measuring results.
  • Learn where early customers get value and where they get stuck, and use that to decide what to double down on and what to drop.
  • Carry commercialization with GTM and leadership: pricing and packaging recommendations, rep enablement, and the funnel from enabled to first event to repeat seller.
  • Keep live customers healthy: enablement, tax configuration edge cases, and payment issues, owning escalations directly until a support motion exists.
  • Own the numbers the business runs on: restaurants selling tickets, ticket sales, and fee revenue. Set the goals, measure them, and let the data change course.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including owning a product or major product area and its results.
  • You've taken an early product from first customers to product-market fit and meaningful growth.
  • You can point to product decisions that came directly from time spent with customers.
  • You've owned a revenue product end to end: pricing conversations, GTM partnership, and executive communication, not just a backlog.
  • You pull your own numbers, set goals up front, and let the data change your mind.
  • You use AI tools regularly in your work and can explain specifically how.
  • You write and speak clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.

Special Sauce (Nice to have)

  • Experience with payments, commerce, ticketing, or marketplace products.
  • Restaurant or hospitality tech experience, or another operationally complex industry.
  • Experience taking a zero-to-one product to market inside a larger company.
  • Experience pricing and packaging a new product.
  • You pull your own data with SQL or similar tools, or you prototype in code today.

title: Staff Engineer, Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Product & Platform Security team at Toast protects the cloud infrastructure and services that restaurants depend on every day. We are looking for a Staff Engineer, Cloud Security to expand the scope and coverage of our cloud security capabilities. You will join an existing cloud security team and take a role in setting direction for how Toast secures its cloud environments. This is a hands-on role with technical leadership responsibilities: you will build and operate security tooling and controls yourself, while also shaping strategy, mentoring teammates, and influencing the roadmaps of engineering teams across R&D.

Our footprint is primarily AWS. You will work closely with Platform and Infrastructure teams in R&D, and with Defense & Response and other Security Engineering teams within Trust & Security.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own and operate our Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), including tuning, coverage, integrations, and turning findings into prioritized, actionable work for engineering teams.
  • Lead cloud security posture management (CSPM) across our AWS organization and accounts, defining standards and measuring adherence over time.
  • Drive identity and access management improvements, including least privilege, role and permission design, and reducing standing access.
  • Secure our container environments, from image and workload security to cluster configuration and runtime protection.
  • Build guardrails and secure defaults into infrastructure as code and deployment pipelines, so that teams get secure configurations by default rather than through review.
  • Perform secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for new and existing cloud services and platform capabilities.
  • Partner with our SOC on cloud detection coverage, logging, and investigation readiness.
  • Run and improve cloud vulnerability and misconfiguration remediation programs, working with engineering owners to drive risk down.
  • Participate in security incident response, including on-call coverage, and lead the cloud side of investigations and follow-up work.
  • Set the multi-year direction for cloud security at Toast, and mentor and uplevel other engineers on the team.
  • Build trusted relationships with Platform, Infrastructure, and product engineering leaders, and influence their priorities through data and clear risk communication.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 8+ years of experience in security engineering, infrastructure, or software engineering, with significant time focused on cloud security.
  • Deep, hands-on experience securing AWS environments at scale, including IAM, Organizations, networking, logging, and core security services.
  • Experience deploying and operating cloud security tooling, such as CNAPP or CSPM platforms (for example Orca, Wiz, or Upwind).
  • Experience with container and Kubernetes security (for example EKS).
  • Experience performing threat modeling and security architecture reviews for cloud services and platform capabilities.
  • Experience responding to security incidents in cloud environments.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and in at least one programming language used for automation (for example Python or Go).
  • A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives and influencing engineering teams without direct authority.
  • History of setting technical direction for a security domain, including a multi-year roadmap and the decisions behind it
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining risk and tradeoffs to engineers and leaders.

What will help you stand out (Nonessentials/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience with GCP, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience with cloud detection engineering or incident response in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to payments and SaaS, such as PCI DSS or SOC 2.
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified Security Specialty or CCSP.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or growing a security function.

Traffic and the number of services at Toast are growing rapidly, so the team is scaling the infrastructure that connects them while keeping it dependable. title: Senior Product Designer – Toast Retail
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 

Toast is making it faster and easier for retailers to get started on Toast: the path from a store's existing product data to a correctly configured, actively selling location. We are seeking a highly skilled, AI-native Senior Product Designer to lead that experience: someone with a strong portfolio, a track record of leading design for complex product areas, a focus on exceptional UI design, and the hands-on ability to build working prototypes with AI tools like Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude. This role involves designing for the unique needs of a diverse retail customer base, including convenience stores, bottle shops, grocery stores, hybrid models, and beyond.

You will lead design for Toast Retail's Experience Platform team, working day to day with product and engineering partners in our Dublin office and the U.S., and reporting to Toast Retail's design leadership in the U.S. Together you will turn product strategy into the setup and onboarding experiences that make retailers feel Toast is built for them.

Why This Role Matters

A retailer's first 90 days on Toast decide whether they stay. Before a store can sell, thousands of items need clean names, categories, brands, pack sizes, taxes, deposits, age restrictions, and images, and most of that data arrives messy, from another system or a spreadsheet. The experiences you design will decide how quickly a new store goes live, how much of that work Toast can do for them, and whether the people setting up the store, often owners juggling a business that is already open, feel in control or buried in it.

You will be Toast Retail's design presence in our Dublin office: the on-site design partner for its product and engineering teams, and part of Toast's wider design community. As a senior designer working across regions and time zones, you will set design direction for your area with a high degree of autonomy: keeping local teams unblocked, making well-informed design and scope tradeoffs within the broader product vision, shaping the roadmap alongside your product and engineering partners, and bringing US-based design, product, and business stakeholders in when direction, customer impact, or strategic choices need broader alignment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Lead design for your product area: Take your area from early discovery through shipped UI, set its design direction and quality bar, and connect each workflow to the broader Toast Retail vision. Help shape what the team builds, not only how it looks.
  • Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools such as Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude to build working, interactive prototypes with realistic data, so ideas can be tested with customers and engineers before the team commits to them. Use AI across the rest of your practice too, from synthesizing research to exploring concepts, validating outputs carefully and modeling responsible, secure use of AI for the team.
  • Design AI-first workflows: Identify where AI can materially reduce customer effort, such as importing and cleaning up a store's existing item data, enriching items with brands, images, and attributes, and guiding new retailers through setup. Design just as carefully for when it is unsure: how customers review low-confidence results, correct mistakes, and come to trust the system.
  • Engage directly with customers: Research with retailers, and with the onboarding and support teams who help them go live, to understand where setup breaks down, and translate those insights into design direction and testable ideas.
  • Make complex data feel simple: Turn large catalogs, imports, bulk edits, and errors into experiences that are clear, forgiving, and fast, on desktop and in the hand.
  • Collaborate early and often: Partner closely with product managers and engineers in Dublin and the U.S., sharing work early, communicating design rationale clearly, and helping the team make good decisions quickly.
  • Raise the bar for the team: Deliver pixel-perfect UI, apply and extend the Toast design system with good judgment, mentor other designers, and contribute to the quality and practices of the wider Retail design team.

You will be a central collaborator within a cross-functional team of designers, product managers, and engineers, designing sophisticated, retail-native capabilities such as:

  • Onboarding for new retailers, from first data import to a store that is ready to sell
  • AI-assisted setup, including agents that import, clean up, and enrich a store's item data
  • Bulk item creation, editing, and correction at the scale of tens of thousands of products
  • Retail item details such as brand, pack and unit, tax, deposit and age rules, images, and category-specific attributes, like a wine's vintage and region
  • Tools that help Toast's onboarding teams set up and support retailers
  • Reusable setup and interaction patterns that make Toast feel built for retail across products

Team and Impact

You will join a passionate team dedicated to driving the consistency, integrity, strategy, and vision of Toast's next-generation product experience. The team is co-located in Dublin and the U.S. While the role sits in the Retail line of business, the patterns you establish will be reused across Toast Retail's products and help scale Toast's retail offering as Toast expands into new markets.

A key part of this work involves building on Toast's investments in AI-assisted onboarding. You will partner closely with the Dublin engineering team that is already building and shipping AI tools that help Toast's onboarding teams set up retail customers.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Experience & Leadership (5+ years): Demonstrated ability to lead design for a complex product area end to end, craft compelling visual experiences, and connect this work to a broader product vision. You have shipped work that measurably changed customer or business outcomes, and you have influenced product direction, not only executed it.
  • AI-Native Practice: AI is part of how you work every day, not an occasional experiment. You use tools like Claude, Replit, or Magic Patterns to research, explore, and prototype, and you can build working prototypes to test ideas with customers and engineers. Crucially, you can tell valuable AI integration from mere hype, in your own process and in the product.
  • Core UX/UI Expertise: Solid understanding of UX principles and best practices for both web and native mobile applications, along with a strong grasp of platform-specific UX and UI patterns.
  • Autonomy & Initiative: Ability to navigate ambiguous, undefined problem spaces, frame the right problem, and initiate work by efficiently gathering the information needed to begin, and to keep moving when key partners are in another time zone.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong communication skills, a proactive mindset for sharing work early and often, the ability to present work and rationale persuasively to senior leaders, and the ability to build trusting relationships across functions and regions.
  • Design Tool Proficiency: Proficient in design software (preferably Figma), including maintaining clean files and delivering pixel-perfect final UI designs for handoff when needed (to a developer or an AI prototyping tool).
  • Feedback & Mentorship: Able to take feedback constructively and pivot quickly when necessary, and to give clear, generous feedback that helps other designers grow.
  • User Empathy: A strong ability to understand and empathize with users, designing digital experiences that delight and create a sense of accomplishment, especially within stressful or monotonous workflows.
  • Design Systems: Familiarity with corporate design systems, knowing how to apply them appropriately, and the judgment to push beyond them when innovation requires it.
  • Customer Engagement: Willingness to engage directly with customers to gather feedback and generate ideas for advancing product features.

What will help you stand out (Nice to Have)

  • Experience designing data-heavy operational or B2B software, such as onboarding, data import, product information management, or point-of-sale tools.
  • Experience designing AI or machine-learning features that include human review, confidence, or correction.
  • Design system experience (including creation and maintenance).
  • Experience contributing directly to a production codebase alongside engineers, for example opening pull requests for UI/UX changes.
  • Prior experience in a startup environment or on zero-to-one projects.

About You

You are a dynamic team player with proven impact in previous roles who is ready and willing to take on new challenges! You're excited to join the Toast Retail team, distributed across Dublin and the U.S., made up of highly motivated and experienced engineers, product leads, and designers. You embody the tenets that drive Toast's Design practice:

  1. You have a founder's mentality: and exhibit ownership of outcomes over outputs. You own the quality and outcomes associated with your work, as well as additional areas your work touches.
  2. You lift others up: and recognize you don't have to be a manager to engage and exhibit true leadership. You offer help and guidance across all the different collaborators you work with.

title: Brand Experience Designer, Consumer
descriptionHtml:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred


Toast is expanding into the B2C market and is looking for a Brand Experience Designer to define and build the consumer-facing brand that millions of diners will come to know. This role is critical for turning a fledgling brand into one that feels distinct, trusted, and alive at every touchpoint, across product and marketing. The Brand Experience Designer will shape how the Consumer brand looks, sounds, and behaves end to end, setting the standard for how Toast shows up to guests and giving the product and growth teams a shared identity to build on.

Toast is investing in becoming a consumer innovator. We’re using our restaurant and guest data to make dining feel personal and frictionless, and with AI in the mix, we want discovery, booking, and dining to feel genuinely memorable. Our Toast Local app is only one surface. We’re adding social features, exclusive deals, and new ways to reserve and pay. A brand that guests recognize and love is how that experience becomes more than a set of features.

About the team

You’d join a small, ambitious Consumer Design team that feels and operates like a startup within a larger company. We have autonomy and the runway to reimagine dining, and we all love to roll our sleeves up and jam together. You’ll report to the Consumer Product Design leader and work shoulder to shoulder with product designers, product managers, engineers, and our marketing and growth partners.

The competition is fierce. We’re up against established brands consumers already recognize. We’re building so that consumers and restaurants thrive and form deep relationships that keep dining a core, sustainable business in our communities. With a brand still finding its shape and a nimble, driven team raring to go, this role is where the brand gets its voice.

The Consumer brand is a sibling to the Toast Core brand, not a sub-brand of it. We honor what makes Toast trusted by restaurants, and we give guests something that feels made for them. What’s shared and what’s distinct is still being decided, and this role helps decide it. If you want a brief with every answer already in it, this isn’t that role. If you want to shape the answers, it is.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

We’re looking for a Brand Experience Designer with a proven track record of building consumer brands that people recognize, remember, and feel something about. You’ll be at the heart of our consumer push, defining how Toast shows up to millions of diners and making sure every touchpoint, from a push notification to a receipt, feels like it came from the same place. You’re the type of designer who loves to lead the way but feels there’s nothing too small to dive into.

Brand Vision and Identity: You’ll evolve our Consumer brand into a complete, living identity system: visual language, voice and tone, motion, illustration, photography, and the principles that hold them together.

Brand in the Product: You’ll partner with product designers to bring the brand into the experience itself: onboarding, empty states, celebrations, loyalty moments, transitions, sound and haptics, the emotionally resonant layer on top of the functional one. The brand system is yours. The product design system is shared, and you’ll own its expressive layer (type, color, motion, illustration) so brand and UX read as one thing.

Brand in the World: You’ll set the creative direction for how the brand appears across marketing and growth: launch campaigns, paid and social, lifecycle email and push, app store, and partner moments. You’ll work with marketing, growth, and content partners to make sure the story guests hear is the one the product tells, and build the templates and toolkits that let those teams move fast.

Brand in the Restaurant: This is the surface no competitor has. Toast is already in the restaurant: on the POS, the handheld, the kiosk, the receipt, the host stand. You’ll define how the Consumer brand shows up in those physical and in-service moments, so a guest who found a restaurant in the app feels the same brand when they walk in, pay, and come back.

Craft and Execution: You lead and you make. You’ll raise the quality of the team’s work through crit, pairing, and your own output, in close partnership with other designers, writers, product teams, and engineers. You can bring a brand to life in Figma, in motion tools, or in code, and take a concept from a sketch to shipped, pixel-perfect execution.

Why join Toast’s Consumer Design team?

Transformative Purpose: This is a rare opportunity to define a consumer brand from the ground up inside a company that’s all-in on the consumer journey. You’ll work in an environment that values experimentation, collaboration, and growth, and your work will be visible, influential, and lasting as it becomes the face of how diners connect with restaurants in an entirely new way.

Unique Data Advantage: Toast knows the restaurants and the guests, and where both are. You’ll use that to make a brand that can be local, not just national: one that flexes by neighborhood, by restaurant, and by occasion without losing itself.

A Brand with Somewhere to Go: The Consumer brand is young. You’ll have the room to make decisions about what it stands for and how it shows up, with a leadership team that wants it to be bold.

How you use AI

We use these tools constantly, and we’re specific about why. We want brand work that’s better because of how you use AI: more directions explored, more variations tested, more of the unglamorous surfaces (lifecycle email, empty states, partner co-marketing) actually designed. You know where it helps and where it produces confident mush.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 8+ years in brand design for consumer products, with a portfolio that shows a brand you built or meaningfully evolved, applied across product and marketing, and the reasoning behind it. We’ll spend most of the interview in your work.
  • You can take a brand strategy to an identity system and an identity system to shipped work, and you’ve done it inside a product design team: you understand design systems, component thinking, and how a brand lives alongside (not on top of) a great UX.
  • You’ve worked inside a product design team before and understand design systems, component thinking, and how brand lives alongside (not on top of) a great UX.
  • You’re expert in Figma (variables, components, and tokens), fluent in a motion tool like After Effects or Rive, and comfortable enough in code to prototype brand moments and talk tokens, transitions, and haptics with engineers.
  • You love to share, learn, and lead by example as much as you love to dive into the details alongside your design, product, marketing, and engineering teammates.
  • You can explain the why behind brand decisions to people who aren’t designers, and you welcome the constraints of a sibling relationship to an established company brand.
  • You’re a tinkerer at heart: you make things nobody asked for just to see if they’d work.

We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. title: Staff Software Engineer, Care Experience
department: R & D : Engineering : Customer Experience Platform
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Care Experience team builds the systems and tools Toast’s care agents rely on to support restaurants every day—the foundation behind every phone call, chat conversation, and support case.

This work directly determines how quickly restaurants get back up and running. When agents have fast, reliable tools with the right context, they resolve issues in minutes. When they don’t, resolution slows—and every delay in fixing a payment issue, menu problem, or device failure costs restaurants real revenue.

We’re rebuilding this experience from the ground up: migrating to a new omnichannel contact center platform and creating a true “single pane of glass” for agents. That means bringing together customer data, account context, device state, case history, and operational tools into one unified system—so agents can focus on solving problems, not piecing together information.

As an engineer on this team, you’ll help define and build that foundation for how hundreds of care agents support tens of thousands of restaurants. You’ll drive the migration while also shaping what comes next—integrating backend systems, designing workflows, and continuously improving the experience based on how agents actually work.

This work requires strong empathy for internal customers and a willingness to operate within real constraints. You’ll navigate complex integrations, vendor platform limitations, and real-time system dependencies—all while ensuring the system is reliable enough to support a high-throughput, always-on support organization.

As a Staff Software Engineer Tech Lead, you’ll own projects end-to-end: building agent-facing features, improving system performance and reliability, and iterating based on real operational feedback. You’ll partner closely with product, care operations, and engineering teams to turn day-to-day support challenges into tools that measurably improve how support is delivered.

  • Lead the design and development of next-generation Toast software services and applications that connect the contact center platform with backend systems, giving support teams real-time access to customer, account, device, and case information to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Own the reliability and performance of business-critical agent tools, ensuring they remain fast and available in a high-throughput, always-on support environment.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Care, QA and other Software teams on the product roadmap and requirements to build a long term vision for Toast and  translate operational needs into solutions that improve resolution speed and efficiency.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance vendor platform capabilities, integration complexity, system reliability, and delivery speed—operating effectively within real-world constraints.
  • Lead technical design and architecture decisions, helping shape the foundation of Toast’s care tooling as the platform evolves and scales.

About this roll*: 

  • Educate, manage, train, coach and mentor a team of 10-12 Care Tax Experts 
  • Regularly evaluate employee performance and ensure accountability  while monitoring customer outcomes and agent key performance indicators such as productivity, adherence, and CSATs 
  • Provide coaching and feedback to all agents through the Quality Assurance process or through One on One sessions to improve their effectiveness for supporting customers through the tax prep, filing and recovery process with Toast Payroll 
  • Train and develop members of the team on process, technical troubleshooting, and new product knowledge, monitor and audit workflow efficiency to identify trends and process improvement opportunities
  • Maintain open communication with agents regarding their concerns and ideas, relaying to others as appropriate
  • Communicate and influence new ideas for improvement with a solutions oriented mindset
  • Assist agents with challenging customer contacts and facilitate Supervisor Calls through escalations
  • Ensure Service Level Agreements (SLA) for tax related cases are met
  • Provide subject matter expertise related to payroll and tax filing.

  • Responsible for keeping abreast of Federal, State and Local regulatory changes and develops internal and external communications relative to these changes

  • Experience working with Escalated Customers
  • Proficient with filing original & amended payroll tax returns
  • Experience working with tax authorities and understanding the tax notice/resolution process end-to-end
  • Solution-oriented with proven ability to drive results

title: Senior Manager, Talent Operations
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy. Our Talent Operations team is the heartbeat of our People and Places function, responsible for building global scalable tools, systems, processes, and dashboards that support our employees at every stage of their employee journey. We are helping transform the way that the People and Places Team delivers service to employees.

As the Senior Manager of Talent Operations (NA) you will help build and deliver a frictionless employee experience spanning across the employee lifecycle for our teams in North America. You will have a critical role on the operations leadership team and will play a part in building out a global “shared services” model. In this role, you will be accountable for the team of people providing front line support for all employee inquiries including benefits and leave administration as well as other operational activities and program delivery. To be successful in this role, you must have a customer-centric and continuous improvement mindset, a proven ability to leverage technology and processes to elevate the employee experience, strong stakeholder management as well as experience building and managing a shared services team in a global matrixed organization.

This role reports to the Director, Talent Operations and will work closely across our global centers of excellence (COEs). This is a Boston-based hybrid role.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Lead People Services (Shared Services) delivery for the North America region.
  • Coach, manage and develop a team of people operations professionals, with a focus on high-quality service delivery across the employee lifecycle including operations, benefits, compensation, and more.
  • Define and monitor metrics and SLAs to measure success of the team and provide insights for decision-making.

title: Senior Director of Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. At Toast, we are passionate about innovation, excellence, and building a community of customers and employees who love what they do.

The Senior Director of Enablement is a senior leader responsible for driving product activation, adoption and self-service for Toast's customers. They are also accountable for time-to-proficiency and role mastery for the Toasters who serve them, so that every customer has a great experience with Toast. In order to accomplish these goals, this leader owns the vision, operating model and execution of Enablement across its functions: Learning Design, Knowledge Content Management, Customer Training and Certification, and Internal Enablement (New Hire Enablement and Continuous Enablement) for our Customer Success and Support teams.

A big part of this role is leading Enablement's transformation for the AI era, evolving and innovating on how each function produces, delivers and measures its work. This leader will also co-own Toast's AI self-service strategy in close collaboration with Product and Customer Care, since the knowledge Enablement creates is the “brain” of our AI self-service experiences.

This is a highly visible role that works closely with senior leaders across the organization, and is accountable for Enablement's impact on both customer outcomes (activation, adoption, self-service rate, support contact rate) and Toaster outcomes (time to proficiency, role mastery, and Support and Customer Success performance).

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Enablement vision, strategy and operating model across Learning Design, Knowledge Content Management, Customer Training and Certification, and Internal Enablement functions. Report Enablement's impact to Toast senior leadership using metrics tied to quantified business outcomes.
  • Lead Enablement's transformation for the AI era by redefining how each function produces, delivers and measures its work. Decide where AI does the work and where people add judgment and validation, and build the team's AI fluency to drive continuous improvement.
  • Run and refine a transparent, data-driven intake and prioritization process for enablement requests. Diagnose root causes and route non-enablement issues (process, product, policy, tooling) to the correct owners.
  • Co-own Toast's AI self-service strategy with Product and Customer Care. Set the standards for AI-ready knowledge (coverage, structure, accuracy, freshness), establish the governance to maintain them as the product changes, and run the feedback loop that turns AI performance data into content improvements.
  • Drive product activation and adoption by optimizing how customers discover, learn and apply new knowledge.
  • Enable Toast to maintain a high rate of innovation by leading the enablement workstream for product launches and enterprise-wide education initiatives so customers, agents and CSMs are ready at release.
  • Enable customer self-service by owning the strategy and quality of Toast's knowledge content and self-help experiences, measured by Self-Service Rate, content gaps and support contact rate.
  • Shorten time to proficiency for new Care agents and Customer Success Managers by building the foundational knowledge, skills, tools and process proficiency every new hire needs.
  • Advance role mastery for tenured Toasters through continuous enablement across role skills, product knowledge, and process and tool adoption, to improve Support outcomes (Customer Satisfaction, Time to Resolve, First Contact Resolution) and Customer Success outcomes (Product Adoption and Retention).

Requirements:

  • 10+ years in education or enablement, with at least 5 years leading leaders across multiple functions.
  • Extensive experience with learning strategy, instructional design and training delivery across modalities (e-learning, instructor-led, video, in-product).
  • Experience leading a knowledge management or content operation at scale, including for AI-powered self-service.
  • Understanding of how frontline Support agents and Customer Success Managers operate day to day, and how customers learn and adopt software.
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in enablement or support work, with a clear view of where they perform well and where they do not.
  • Track record of leading a team through a significant change in its operating model.
  • Comfortable working with data: defining metrics, interpreting results, and connecting enablement inputs to customer and business outcomes.
  • Able to establish credibility and trust with executives, cross-functional partners, and frontline managers and employees.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
