title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. 

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is looking for a Staff Software engineer to join our Payments team in Bangalore. This team  will be responsible for building end to end 3rd party processors responsible for managing millions of transactions for our customers.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features
  • Lead complex projects that improve functionality and reliability for our customers and partners
  • Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 
  • Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
  • Roll* features out to customers and partners, including monitoring for success
  • Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features
  • Mentor and coach other engineers

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • A minimum of three year undergraduate degree in any related discipline
  • 9-13 years experience building backend services and APIs
  • Extensive experience working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin, with a deep understanding of testing, quality, and best practices
  • Experience shipping production services and balancing getting things done with platform stability and reliability
  • Experience building backend services and APIs and scaling distributed systems
  • Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
  • Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
  • Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base
  • Excellent cross-team communication skills on complex technical topics 

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end.

title: Staff Electrical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Are you bready* for a change?

We are not your traditional tech company and we do not aim to be. Going against the grain is in our DNA. Building a revolutionary product begins with revolutionary thinking. That is why we value diversity background and lived experience. Together, we empower restaurants of all sizes to build great teams, increase revenue, improve operations, and delight their guests. We pair our deep understanding of the restaurant industry with powerful cloud-based software and restaurant-grade hardware to deliver an intuitive all-in-one platform. Join us on our mission to empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

About the Role*: 

Toast’s Hardware team designs and develops world-class hardware devices in conjunction with our JDM & ODM partners. We are a very lean team that focuses on the key elements of Android devices and accessories, and architect our devices to offer the best hardware solutions for our customers. From our close relationships with our customers, we have learned the important design features that make our devices truly restaurant-grade. We focus on the long-term reliability of our devices to ensure our customers do not have to be concerned with their Toast hardware always being ready for another busy day.

A day in the life (Responsibilities):

  • As a Staff  Electrical Engineer on the Hardware Team, you will be laying the groundwork for our future products.
  • Will work closely with Product Management, Product Design Architecture, Industrial Design, and the executive leadership team on new product definitions.
  • Responsible for efficiently integrating electrical systems throughout the device to enable target use cases and hit other product metrics such as thickness, weight, and cost.
  • You have the technical experience to discuss engineering tradeoffs across multiple disciplines including antennas, cameras, sensors, displays, and batteries.
  • You will partner with our global Product Engineering teams as they bring these future products to market, offering ongoing support and bringing lessons learned back into the definition process of next-generation devices.
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • BS degree/ ME or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of equivalent working experience in design, implement, debug, and characterize Electrical Engineering systems for use in current and future product architectures. Design prototype devices in conjunction with Product Design Architecture to validate new form factors, features, or other concepts.
  • Partner closely with Product Design Architecture on optimizing the integration of electrical systems to benefit one or more key metrics like size, performance, and cost.
  • Plan and lead validation of your designs. Lead complete functional verification, RF testing, signal characterization, power modeling/test, and system coexistence testing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Mechanical Engineering, Layout Engineering, Thermal Engineering, and Signal Integrity.
  • Advocate for new technology and component development that offer clear benefits to future product layouts.

Highly Preferred Skills

  • PCB layout & Schematic using Cadence and Allegro
  • WLAN & Bluetooth connectivity experience
  • Understanding of LTE connectivity
  • Payment certification knowledge
  • Solder skills – assembly and rework

title: Senior Product Manager, Team Management
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Outside the US, we currently operate in Canada, UK, Ireland, and Australia and are actively growing our product platform in these markets. We are seeking a senior product manager to own this strategy and enable our customers to attract and retain employees in their restaurants.   • Align Engineering, Security, Data, Research, Design, Care/Onboarding, and GTM partners to de-risk delivery and adoption of new features in the employee management space.
  • Define and track key metrics and KPIs to measure ROI of roadmap initiatives and prioritize projects across markets.
  • Define pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy with Product Marketing, Sales, and Operations; identify commercial models that fit restaurants of different sizes.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Intelligence Platform
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join Toast Reporting Experience (TREX) in Dublin. TREX is building the Intelligence Platform: a governed data layer that brings Toast's restaurant intelligence to prospects, operators, Toast IQ and AI agents.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be the technical lead for the Intelligence Platform. You will establish its architecture on Toast's data lake and make the key design calls across data processing, privacy, publishing and serving. You will work closely with Data Platform, Marketing, Product, Legal and Data Science, do deep hands-on work, and grow the engineers on your team. You will take the platform from its first version, a regular publication of aggregated benchmark data, to fresher data, self-serve access for Marketing, and eventually real-time access for AI agents. Success looks like new data products shipping on the platform quickly and safely.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Own the technical vision and end-to-end architecture of the Intelligence Platform, from early design through production rollout
  • Work hands-on with Kotlin/Java, Spark and Iceberg on Toast's data lake, writing the code that sets the pattern for others
  • Move fast from idea to proof of concept: ship early versions, get feedback from Marketing and other partners, and iterate
  • Build privacy and compliance into the platform from the start: work with Legal, Investor Relations, Privacy and Data Science to define the data-access rules and minimum group sizes, and enforce them in code so every published number is aggregated, anonymized and auditable
  • Create reusable building blocks so every data product on the platform meets the same bar for quality and safety
  • Design the flows that let tools and AI agents access the data efficiently, safely and at scale
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Legal, Investor Relations and Data Science to turn business goals into a technical roadmap
  • Set the bar for reliability and quality, and mentor other engineers through design reviews, code reviews and the example you set
  • Use AI tooling as a genuine force multiplier in your day-to-day work and help the team do the same

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in software engineering, building data-intensive or distributed systems, including technical leadership of projects involving multiple teams
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex data domains at scale, and to turn them into reliable data products
  • Proficiency in Java, Kotlin or another object-oriented language
  • Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills on large datasets
  • Experience building data products or platforms that other teams depend on
  • Experience handling sensitive data responsibly, such as aggregation, anonymization or access controls
  • Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-engineering partners
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake or Databricks is a bonus

**This is a hybrid role requiring two days per week in our Dublin office.**

Our tech stack

The Intelligence Platform will source data from multiple sources: OpenSearch, Data Lake, Snowflake.

Toast's data lake is built on AWS: Apache Iceberg tables on S3 and Apache Spark for data processing. TREX's backend services are primarily Kotlin and Java, use Apache Pulsar for messaging, and serve data to other teams through APIs, including federated GraphQL.

title: QA Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Toast Overview: 

Toast is a rapidly growing SAAS product company building the first all-in-one restaurant management software platform. Toast’s Android tablet based system helps restaurants operate more efficiently and connect with their customer base in new and innovative ways. We’re growing fast and have a customer base comprised of cafes, restaurants, bars and nightclubs across the country. We work hard and care about our customers’ success and we have a lot of fun doing it. As a company, we move fast and have a lot of opportunities for career growth, so if you’re passionate about your work and want to be in a fun and growing industry, join us! You will be helping Toast to grow our business internationally.

Bready to make a change?

We’re not your traditional tech company and we don’t aim to be. Going against the grain is in our DNA. Building a revolutionary product begins with revolutionary thinking. That’s why we value diversity of thought, background and lived experience. Together, we empower restaurants of all sizes to build great teams, increase revenue, improve operations, and delight their guests. We pair our deep understanding of the restaurant industry with powerful cloud based software and restaurant-grade hardware to deliver an intuitive all-in-one platform. Join us on our mission to empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive. 

We are Toasters

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success.At Toast our employees are our secret ingredient. When they are powered to succeed, Toast succeeds.

The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse industries. We embrace and are excited by this diversity, believing that only through authenticity, inclusivity, high standards of respect and trust, and leading with humility will we be able to achieve our goals.

Baking inclusive principles into our company and diversity into our design provides equitable opportunities for all and enhances our ability to be first in class in all aspects of our industry. Toast is named as One of the Best Places to Work in 2024 by Glassdoor.

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is scaling rapidly and with that growth comes an exciting new opportunity to join one of our earliest and impactful lines of business in Bangalore. Toast is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join its team focused on building impactful capabilities that empower restaurants to drive Guest engagement, retention and growth. The team will help shape the future of how restaurants use technology to connect with their guests - increasingly through AI-powered tools and experiences that drive automation, personalization and smarter decision-making. You will be a key part of a high-impact, high-ownership engineering team solving complex challenges in a fast-moving product space. 

You will enable restaurants by playing a critical role in testing features in this domain.The Toast platform processes tens of millions of requests per day, and this number grows constantly as we add new locations , integrations , partners to our ecosystem and expand to new geographies. You will be one of the impactful technologists , accountable for business growth in the Guest integration team. This is a mission-critical system on which our restaurants rely for their livelihood, so Quality , Reliability and Scalability are paramount.

About this roll*:

As a QA-II on our team, you will be:

  • Collaborating with Product , Design(UI) and Development stakeholders to understand the requirements.
  • Creating and implementing comprehensive test plans.
  • Conducting and participating in test plan and test strategy reviews.
  • Testing new features and regressions across our suite of hardware and software products. 
  • Create defects for requirement deviations, assign priority and severity and escalate if needed. 
  • Collaborating and assisting the project teams to triage and reproduction of defects, debugging of customer issues,validate fixes and attending sprint ceremonies.
  • Work with other QA engineers and developers to adapt a test automation strategy.
  • Increase Automation test case coverage by developing reusable scripts, brining test efficiency by using automation for release testing. 
  • Actively contribute towards product design and roadmap discussions by pitching ideas from a quality perspective.
  • Keeping current with tools such as Jira, Confluence, TestRail, automation products etc.

Do you have the right ingredients*?

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance.
  • Ability to learn and understand complex business logic and find creative ways to test it.
  • Design and deliver test plans for a significant component, set of features, mid-size application, or service. 
  • Have a solid understanding of the test strategies and methodologies used in your technology domain (and how to best apply them). Example API testing using postman, Web Application testing (Desktop, Toast Hardware and Mobile Apps), Automated testing using Selenium , Playwright etc.
  • Possess an appetite for automation and are aware of automation frameworks, methodologies & tools
  • Your test plan, scripts and test case reviews tend to be rapid and uneventful. You provide useful feedback for changes submitted by others. 
  • Your automation test scripts are maintainable and reusable, identify bugs and do not produce false positives. 
  • You make improvements to your team’s testing processes and question the defined set of tests. 
  • You have established good working relationships with team members and peers working on related software. 
  • Commitment to quality, user experience, and using your “get unblocked” attitude for continuous learning and problem solving.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Special Sauce* (Extra Ingredients)

  • Strong familiarity with Test Automation frameworks for backend and frontend tech stacks.
  • Understanding and hands on experience with testing of Fintech,Payments Products and services.

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from Guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps(Single Page Applications). Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard. Many of our services use REST and GraphQL architectures. We use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. title: Software Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Toast has grown to be a leading hospitality software company in the US and is now setting its sights on our next stages of growth.  As the business continues to grow, there is increased demand to enhance the enterprise level of support in the product. Toast customers who managed several restaurants a few years ago are now expanding their business and adding new locations. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is looking for a Software engineer to join our enterprise Away team. You will get to work across the entire Toast platform, including the partner ecosystem. As a member of the enterprise team, you will help ensure that the product is being built to meet the new and expanding needs of these customers.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Design, build, and deliver features in Toast’s enterprise management products
  • Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
  • Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success
  • Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features  
  • Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 
  • Work with experienced engineers to deliver design and code review 

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, or front ends
  • Comfortable working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin
  • Experience building complex web applications with React is a plus
  • Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
  • Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
  • Experience delivering high quality, reliable services to production
  • Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end

title: Tax Manager - International Taxes
department: G & A : Finance Tax & Accounting Executive
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Toast, we’re building the future of the restaurant industry—and our Global Tax team is building the foundation that makes it all possible. 

The International Tax Manager is a highly visible, hands-on role responsible for supporting Toast's non-U.S. tax matters across our growing international footprint. The role will have a primary focus on foreign corporate income tax compliance and reporting, while also providing support across local statutory matters, tax audits, and other international tax requirements.

Working closely with the U.S.-based Corporate Tax team, local-based business partners and external advisors, this role will help coordinate international tax compliance, support quarterly and annual tax reporting, monitor evolving local tax requirements, and provide tax support for business expansion and other cross-border initiatives.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

International Income Tax & Compliance

  • Coordinate and review corporate income tax compliance for Toast's non-U.S. entities, working with accounting teams and external advisors.
  • Support the international components of the quarterly and annual income tax provision, including current and deferred tax calculations and related reporting.
  • Monitor international income tax developments and assess potential impacts to Toast's foreign operations.
  • Support local tax audits, inquiries, assessments, and statutory tax requirements across international jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate with the Corporate Tax team on transfer pricing, intercompany transactions, and other cross-border tax matters.
  • Lead international R&D tax credit and incentive activities in partnership with the Corporate Tax team, business stakeholders, and external advisors.
  • Oversee ongoing compliance with IDA grant commitments, including review of the required tracking, reporting, and coordination with relevant business stakeholders.

International Business Support 

  • Support tax analysis related to new-country entry, changes to Toast's international operating model, and other business expansion initiatives.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Accounting, and other stakeholders to identify tax requirements associated with new business activities and cross-border transactions.
  • Coordinate with external advisors to obtain jurisdiction-specific technical guidance where appropriate.

Process Improvement & Governance

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize international indirect tax processes and documentation.
  • Help improve the consistency and quality of tax data, workpapers, documentation, and control across non-U.S. entities 
  • Participate in automation, tax technology, and process improvement initiatives across the Global Indirect Tax function.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • 6+ years of progressive corporate tax experience or international tax experience, ideally with a combination of public accounting and in-house experience 
  • Chartered Accountant, CPA, CTA, or other equivalent professional qualification
  • Strong knowledge of corporate income tax compliance and reporting, with experience supporting multinational companies
  •  Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and the interaction between accounting and tax reporting
  • Experience coordinating with external tax advisors and managing multiple jurisdictional compliance requirements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across functions, cultures, and geographies
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment, manage multiple priorities, and drive work to completion
  • Willingness to work flexible hours with global business 
  • Must be able to multitask, work efficiently under tight deadlines and proactively track and report progress
  • Self-motivated to apply learned experiences and leverage best practices

Preferred

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, fintech, or other high-growth multinational environment preferred
  • Experience with Ireland and/or EMEA corporate income and supporting ASC 740 tax provision processes for foreign entities
  • Exposure to transfer pricing compliance and intercompany arrangements
  • Experience with R&D tax credits, government incentives, or other local tax incentive programs
  • Experience driving process improvement, automation, data transformation, or AI-enabled initiatives within a tax, finance, or accounting function

title: Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) role is the foundational entry point into our high-performing sales organization, designed specifically to develop the next generation of versatile sales professionals at Toast. This is not a static job—it is a dynamic, multi-disciplinary position and a structured path for those who thrive on adaptability and professional growth.

In this role, you serve as the agile core of our sales team. We invest in BDRs with the clear expectation that you will master both inbound and outbound strategies, moving fluidly between inbound and outbound functions as the business evolves. This unique flexibility ensures you gain a comprehensive 360-degree view of the top of Toast’s sales funnel, while being deployed where your impact will be greatest.

The role will be based in Sydney, Australia. This is a Hybrid role with days in our Sydney office.

What you'll do (Responsibilities):

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you serve as the versatile engine of our sales pipeline, responsible for prospecting and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth. This is a dynamic role designed for agility; you will act as a multi-functional specialist, pivoting seamlessly between inbound and outbound strategies to meet the needs of the business. By mastering both disciplines, you ensure the sales organization remains responsive and that Account Executives consistently receive high-quality engagements, regardless of where they originate in the funnel.

  • Execute High-Volume Outreach: Prospect businesses that are strong fits for the Toast POS product, and complete at least 80 high-quality activities daily, including warm/cold calls, emails, and social touchpoints—adapting your approach based on Inbound or Outbound priorities.
  • Conduct Discovery & Qualification: Host qualification calls to develop a deep understanding of prospect needs, determining how they can benefit from our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Drive Pipeline Velocity: Schedule meetings for qualified prospects and manage a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive, maintaining high conversion standards across all lead sources.
  • Master the All-Bound Model: Fluidly transition between inbound lead response and outbound prospecting as business needs evolve, building a comprehensive skill set that serves as the foundation for your advancement into an Account Executive role.
  • Strategic Alignment: Partner closely with sales leadership to deploy your efforts where they have the highest impact, ensuring our pipeline remains robust and well-balanced.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements):

  • Career Ambition: Must be driven by a long-term goal of becoming a full-cycle Account Executive (AE) and working in a commissioned closing role.
  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.

department: R & D : BTT : Finance, Orders & Subscriptions Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

As an Engineering Manager focused on GTM, you will be accountable for the delivery of solutions supporting business goals, releasing features that drive value for our internal teams and Toast customers. Leading a highly skilled and fast-paced team of Engineers, you will be responsible for validating technical decisions and guiding the team in building scalable technology. You will seek engagement with business stakeholders, demoing solutions to gather feedback as often as possible as part of our agile delivery framework.  When the time comes to test our solutions for quality, you are managing the engagement of our development teams with their QA counterparts, ensuring testing is robust enough to provide confidence in release. When issues are found, including in our production environments, you provide oversight and guidance to the teams root-causing and developing the fixes. This role will have a wide area of ownership supported by key engineers for the core workflows of our Quoting, in addition to the Catalog Management ecosystem. You will be a critical leader for the team and deliver high impact with great opportunity for future growth.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Champion the use of AI tools and practices to accelerate development, improve team velocity, and pioneer new ways of building - setting the bar for what it means to be an AI-first engineering organization.
  • Manage the daily activities of Engineers who are delivering new features and enhancements critical to Toast's business growth.  
  • Oversee technical delivery operations for Quoting and Catalog Management systems, including Salesforce CPQ, Product Catalog, and other fit-for-purpose GTM solutions, and provide leadership, activity planning, and direction to complete team tasks, produce the required deliverables, track/resolve issues, meet delivery milestones, and mentor team members by identifying/developing opportunities for individual growth and setting a positive example for working in a team environment.
  • Review deliverables for the team and contribute hands-on to complex delivery efforts. Specifically, provide Code Review expertise by actively reviewing solutions from the engineering team across platforms and tools within your ownership area, and facilitate release and capacity planning for the team’s initiatives.
  • Lead collaborative discovery and execution ceremonies for engineering, research, design, and quality assurance peers.
  • Communicate clearly, knowledgeably, and transparently with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels (including and especially Sales, Product, and RevOps leaders and team members) to build trusted relationships that allow our engineers the freedom to experiment. This will require you to: Partner with Stakeholders in evaluating new technologies, ensuring they fit into our stack and meet the needs identified within the Discovery process; confidently leverage preeminent domain expertise in service of team decision-making, sharing trade-offs with stakeholders where it helps to drive shared understanding, and continually evolve domain knowledge through ongoing customer, competitor, and market research, sharing the takeaways with your team and our business partners.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Experience delivering high-impact Quoting, Catalog Management, and GTM initiatives as part of/leading a technical team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Well-versed in Quoting and Catalog Management systems (Salesforce CPQ, Product Catalog, Pricing Rules, etc.) and technologies (REST, SOAP, ETL, etc.).
  • Implementation expertise and practical experience working on systems projects with large transactional volume involving complex system design across disparate systems.
  • Experience in collaborating with product owners representing Sales, RevOps, Product Management, and Data Analytics.
  • Experience in developing and retaining a highly talented team.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves):

  • Hands-on experience developing and solutioning in Salesforce and other tools, including leading solution architecture reviews.
  • Experience with CI/CD best practices and GIT.
  • Experience working with 3rd party development teams.
  • Leadership in product selection (e.g., RFP creation and response evaluation) and vendor management.

title: Senior NAM Payroll Specialist
department: G & A : Total Rewards and Operations
descriptionHtml:
Senior Payroll Specialist (North America).

Work Schedule: Aligned to US Eastern business hours on an ongoing basis (approximately 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST, adjusted for US daylight saving time).

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Payroll Specialist (North America). to join our in-house North America (NAM) payroll team. This is a high-impact, hybrid role that owns the most complex payroll processing, escalations, and systems and compliance initiatives, while overseeing and reviewing the day-to-day transactional work delivered by the Payroll Specialist team. As part of Toast’s internal payroll organization—not a third-party payroll bureau or outsourced provider—you will act as a subject-matter expert across payroll operations, compliance, and systems; mentor Payroll Specialists and help prepare them for advancement; and serve as a key backup to the Payroll Team Lead. Based in India, this position supports payroll for employees in the NAM region; it does not involve India payroll processing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Payroll Operations & Volume: Oversee accurate and timely processing of bi-weekly multi-state payrolls for more than 5,700 employees across the US, Canada, and Mexico, with day-to-day transaction processing primarily executed by the Payroll Specialist team. Personally owns and processes the most complex, escalated, and Mexico payroll cycles.
  • Complex Transactions & Global Mobility: Own complex and escalated payroll transactions that fall outside standard Specialist-level processing, including benefits-in-kind processing and overpayment calculations and repayments. Coordinate with third-party consultants and Global Mobility to input transferred employees’ payroll information accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Employee Ticketing & Tier 2 Support: Support internal and external customers with payroll inquiries. Manage and respond to ServiceNow tickets accurately on the first instance. Proactively ensure errors and issues are resolved in line with the Service Level Agreement (SLA).
  • System & Data Management: Ensure Workday is maintained as the primary source of data integrity. Responsible for Workday EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder) mass data uploads, global mobility transactions, and serving as lead tester for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and semi-annual Workday system releases.
  • Reporting & General Ledger: Review and analyze payroll and data analysis reports, including those generated by the Payroll Specialist team, to ensure audits are completed accurately and on time. Maintain and reconcile General Ledger accounts, ensuring accounts are balanced. Create content for dashboards and metrics as needed.
  • Compliance, SOX & Audits: Work with the Payroll Team Lead on quarterly reviews of the SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) payroll process and support Internal Audit requirements. Manage audits for 401K (US retirement savings plans), ESPP, Workers’ Compensation, and review/approve monthly, quarterly, and annual equity audits. Review annual tax statements (W-2s, T4s) for all expatriate personnel to ensure accuracy.
  • Vendor Management & Tax Filings: Coordinate with ADP SmartCompliance and CloudPay on tax filings, notice resolutions, and reconciliations. Own ADP tax-registration administration, including applying for new SIT, SUI, and local tax IDs and maintaining accurate payroll tax records. Process Prior Quarter/Prior Year Tax adjustments as needed. Manage responses to all tax agency inquiries through ADP Tax Service and CloudPay.
  • Process Improvement & Troubleshooting: Audit current processes to reduce payroll-related errors. Determine root causes of payroll errors by collecting and analyzing information under strict deadlines. Assist with development and final review of payroll policies, workflows, knowledge bases, and contingency plans. Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documentation, which is under the care of the Specialist.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Accounting to assist with complex variance queries and balance sheet reconciliations, using supporting data and documentation prepared by the Payroll Specialist team. Partner with Total Rewards to ensure smooth integration of payroll with other HR functions.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Assist the Payroll Team Lead with training and mentoring the payroll team, including onboarding, upskilling, and preparing Payroll Specialists for advancement into the Senior Payroll Specialist role. Serve as a primary backup for Payroll Specialists.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical payroll experience preferred. US payroll certifications such as FPC (Fundamental Payroll Certification) or CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) are a plus.
  • Experience: 8+ years of hands-on payroll processing experience, including 4+ years working directly in Workday, and ownership of complex, high-volume payroll cycles across multiple jurisdictions.
  • US Workday Payroll & Absence Proficiency (Hard Requirement): Demonstrated hands-on experience processing US payroll and absence management in Workday is required. This must include executing EIB data loads, release and regression testing, and troubleshooting configuration or calculation issues. Report-viewing access alone does not meet this requirement.
  • Regional Expertise: In-depth working knowledge of NAM payrolls (US, Canada, and Mexico), including multi-jurisdiction statutory and year-end requirements.
  • In-House / Corporate Payroll Environment: Demonstrated experience operating within an in-house or corporate payroll function, as opposed to a third-party payroll bureau or BPO, including direct partnership with internal stakeholders (HR, Total Rewards, Accounting) and end-to-end ownership of the payroll process.
  • Work Environment & Soft Skills: Ability to work independently as part of a team in a fast-paced environment and deliver results against deadlines, including performing effectively under sustained pressure.
  • Shift Commitment: Willingness and ability to work aligned to US Eastern business hours on an ongoing basis, including adapting to US daylight saving time transitions.
  • Leadership: Experience mentoring, training, or providing technical guidance to junior payroll staff.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Escalation Ownership: Experience acting as the primary point of escalation for complex payroll issues within an in-house or corporate payroll team.
  • Advanced Tools: Experience leveraging AI-powered reconciliation, analytics, or reporting tools (e.g., automated exception management, intelligent transaction matching, AI-assisted dashboards) to strengthen audit readiness.
  • Software Familiarity: Familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance, CloudPay, ServiceNow, or similar global payroll and tax software.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Toast has grown to be a leading hospitality software company in the US and is now setting its sights on our next stages of growth.  As the business continues to grow, there is increased demand to enhance the enterprise level of support in the product. Toast customers who managed several restaurants a few years ago are now expanding their business and adding new locations. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is looking for a Senior Software engineer to join our enterprise Away team. You will get to work across the entire Toast platform, including the partner ecosystem. As a member of the enterprise team, you will help ensure that the product is being built to meet the new and expanding needs of these customers.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features across Toast’s enterprise management products
  • Lead complex projects that improve functionality and reliability for our customers 
  • Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 
  • Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
  • Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success
  • Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features  
  • Mentor and coach other engineers

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 5+ years experience building backend services and APIs
  • Extensive experience working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin, with a deep understanding of testing, quality, and best practices
  • Experience shipping production services and balancing getting things done with platform stability and reliability
  • Experience building backend services and APIs and scaling distributed systems
  • Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
  • Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
  • Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base
  • Excellent cross-team communication skills on complex technical topics 

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end.

*Bread puns encouraged but not required

title: Principal Fraud Analyst (Data Science), Digital Payments Fraud Strategy US
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy.

We are seeking a Principal Analyst to join our Fraud Analytics team to own the analytical strategy for assessing and mitigating fraud risk for digital transactions.

This role will report to the Senior Manager of Fraud Analytics. This senior individual contributor role will be central to driving actionable insights & defining the risk strategy across Toast’s Fintech ecosystem.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Lead the definition and evolution of risk frameworks across the digital payments landscape, with a focus on guest fraud.
  • Design, develop, and own core fraud and risk metrics that inform decision-making, performance measurement, and strategy.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Risk Operations) to translate analytical insights into scalable solutions.
  • Evaluate, integrate, and manage external data sources to enhance risk detection and decisioning capabilities.
  • Define data requirements and partner with engineering to build and maintain reliable, production-grade data pipelines.
  • Act as a thought leader in fraud analytics, setting best practices for measurement & risk modelling.

Do you have the right ingredients? (Qualifications)

  • 6–8 years of experience in data analytics, payments risk & fraud; fintech experience is a plus.
  • Very strong SQL & Python skills and proficiency with analytical tools. 
  • Proven ability to analyze large, complex datasets to extract actionable insights.
  • Demonstrated experience owning ambiguous problem spaces and translating them into clear analytical frameworks and measurable outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional stakeholders and executive leaders.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Orders
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

On the Orders POS Team, our mission is to provide a state of the art platform for processing and synchronizing changes to orders that enables Toast to build complex and customizable workflows for our customers.

As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you’ll play a key role in designing and implementing new features, evolving our architecture and tooling to ensure efficient high-quality delivery, and working with many other Toast R&D teams to bring high-visibility product experiences to life, ensuring that over 1 billion order changes per week across over 200,000 customers are processed quickly and accurately.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Lead the design and delivery of significant capabilities on Toast's Orders platform that span multiple teams, from the cloud to the point of sale
  • Join a collaborative team of Design, Product, QA, and other engineering members in developing robust and scalable software within Toast’s POS applications
  • Drive architectural decisions for correctness, performance, and scale; author and review technical designs within and beyond the team
  • Provide design feedback and participate in code reviews to ensure implementations meet requirements
  • Align the technical vision and roadmap for the Orders platform with Toast's strategy
  • Be a domain expert for order processing and synchronization, and the go-to partner for teams whose products build on orders
  • Advocate for best coding practices to raise the bar for you, your team, and the company
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other team members and raise the engineering bar across the team and the broader Orders organization.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 8+ years of experience with Object Oriented Languages like Java or Kotlin
  • Track record of delivering significant platform capabilities across multiple teams in large engineering organizations
  • A mix of mobile and backend development expertise, focused on distributed systems problems at high scale in large codebases
  • Deep understanding of automated testing, quality, and SDLC best practices, with a history of shipping reliable apps, microservices, and libraries to production
  • Experience delivering high-quality, reliable apps or libraries to production
  • Expertise with modern API technologies (e.g. REST, GraphQL), including schema design, evolution, and versioning across many consumers
  • Experience owning business-critical services in production: leading incident response and driving long-term reliability improvements
  • Excellent cross-team communication skills on complex technical topics
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, MCP servers)
  • Passionate about technology and learning new things.
  • Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team.

title: Territory Account Executive, Retail - San Francisco
descriptionHtml:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding its offerings into other food and beverage concepts such as convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. This role will require a founder’s mindset as we grow Toast’s presence in this new vertical with a new offering: the Toast Retail platform. 

As a Retail Account Executive, you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new accounts. title: Program Manager, Inclusion & Impact (APAC)
department: G & A : Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Our Inclusion & Impact team is a center of excellence within our People & Places function, responsible for fostering a globally connected culture fueled by fairness, belonging, community, and corporate responsibility. We do so through our three workstreams of Global Inclusion, Social Impact, & Sustainability.We seek proactive team members who excel when navigating fast-paced settings and are eager to drive meaningful outcomes daily.

This role reports to the Global Head of Inclusion & Impact and will work closely with the Head of HR, International and the SVP, India Country Lead. 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

As the Program Manager, Inclusion & Impact-APAC, you will help deploy the global Inclusion & Impact strategy locally, building and delivering programming tailored to the region’s needs. This is a new position - So, we’re looking for a motivated self-starter who thrives in dynamic environments and wants to make an impact every single day by fostering an inclusive environment where all Toasters can thrive and driving local corporate social responsibility efforts.

You will:

1. Global Inclusion: Cultural Awareness, Targeted Interventions, & Employee Networks

  • Drive regional  inclusive workplaces initiatives with a primary focus on gender diversity, accessibility, representation and equitable experiences
  • Liaise with key external talent partners (ex. PeriFerry, Enable India, Grace Hopper) to support TA in strengthening diverse talent pipelines
  • Work with senior leaders on targeted interventions to widen opportunities for all Toaster to thrive when it comes to development, career progression, and retention
  • Facilitate or employ external partners (ex. Avtar) to deliver inclusive leadership, sensitisation, awareness, and belonging programs
  • Support people team systems and drive fairness in people decisions — including POSH-linked practices
  • Coach and support local Employee Resource Group & Community chapters, and enable the site leads who run them

2. Social Impact: Employee Giving & Community Outreach

  • Own local expression of global toast.org social impact strategy, including amplifying “signature giving moments”, to increase regional employee volunteering and engagement.
  • Own regional engagement strategy, educating Toasters on giving opportunities and tools and delivering impact and storytelling supporting the business’ purpose-driven mission.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to toast.org local committee chairs, including recruiting, onboarding, developing, and recognizing leads.
  • Localize global giving playbook based on regional needs, identifying synergies across sites, optimizing community outreach calendars, and ensuring access to volunteering opportunities exist for all Toasters .  
  • Act as primary point of contact for regional ngo’s and internal stakeholder.

3. Sustainability: CSR Project Planning, Implementation, & Compliance

  • Lead the development of annual CSR plans, budget allocation & monitoring, and selection & implementation processes and governance touchpoints with the CSR committee
  • Lead the identification of community needs, development priorities, and potential CSR opportunities aligned with statutory requirements and Toast.org’s (the company’s social impact arm) objectives
  • Coordinate with CSR agencies, NGOS, project partners, and internal stakeholders for effective project execution.
  • Own post-project communications, impact reporting, and ongoing community outreach activities
  • Partner with Finance on proper disclosure documentation, statutory records, and materials
  • Support annual global corporate responsibility & impact report content development

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
  • 5 to 7 years of professional experience, with relevant experience in diversity, equity & inclusion, CSR, employee engagement, or program management in India, including regional delivery across more than one site
  • Strong experience in strategic planning, content development, and designing, facilitating & implementing immersive cultural and community engagement programs
  • Working knowledge of India's statutory environment for this work — POSH, Companies Act Section 135 CSR, and the Labour Codes — and experience coordinating a compliance calendar with Legal and Finance partners
  • Strong analytical skills and understanding of impact reporting, diversity metrics, and inclusive workplace interventions
  • Experience standing something up from scratch, not just running something already established
  • Experience with employee resource groups or employee-led communities, ideally at an early stage
  • Grants or CSR program management experience, including NGO onboarding, monitoring, and reporting
  • Ability to work with and influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, across country leadership and global functions 
  • Top-notch verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Project management skills with attention to detail and consistent follow-through

What will help you standout (Nice to Have)

  • Experience across both Bangalore and Chennai, or comparable multi-site delivery in India
  • Existing relationships in the India inclusion and CSR partner ecosystem
  • Experience in a global technology company with a US-based headquarters

title: Hardware Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast team is committed to our customers. We’re taking steps to help restaurants navigate these unprecedented times with technology, resources, and community. Our focus is on building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we’ll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant of the future.

Toast’s Hardware team designs and develops world-class hardware devices in conjunction with our JDM/ODM/CM partners in Asia. We are looking for a Hardware Program Manager to join our HW PMO team in Taiwan, to handle new product development, sustaining and cost-down programs for Toast devices already in production.

In this role, you will keep shipping products healthy and competitive: driving engineering changes, component replacements, and cost-reduction initiatives from idea through validation to mass production. You will work cross-functionally with Hardware Engineering, NPI, HW Ops, Sourcing, Quality, and manufacturing partners to manage schedule, scope, cost, and risk across multiple programs in a fast-moving environment. This is a great opportunity for an early-career program manager to grow within a global hardware organization.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Lead new Hardware product development program from concept to mass production.
  • Creates and executes project plans and revises to meet changing needs.
  • Deliver project objectives, including product performance, schedule, cost, and other KPIs.
  • Understand Toast's strategic priorities and drive alignment with the cross-functionally to deliver clear project plans. Keep the team focused and ensure commitment and objectives are met.
  • Hold teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work. Leverage organizational resources to improve capacity for project work.
  • Ensure teams are adhering to Toast standards and best practices
  • Manage sustaining engineering activities for in-production hardware products, including ECN/ECO execution, component EOL/last-time-buy responses, alternate part qualification, and field issue follow-up.
  • Coordinate validation builds, test plans, and change approvals to ensure changes reach production on time without impacting quality.
  • Drive cost-reduction programs with Engineering, Sourcing, and manufacturing partners, from idea collection and feasibility review to validation and production cut-in.
  • Identify risks to schedule, quality, or savings, and manage mitigation plans in the project risk register.
  • Serve as a key point of contact between JDM/ODM/CM partners and global cross-functional teams (Hardware Engineering, NPI, HW Ops, Quality, Product).
  • Run program meetings, publish status reports, and keep program documentation current in Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, and PLM.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Project Management  - As a key member in the Hardware team who thinks strategically, you’ll apply your project management knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques for leading a team to bring projects to completion 
    • Lead new hardware product development programs through production launch.
    • Creates and executes project work plans and revises to meet changing needs.
    • Lead project team to deliver project objectives.
    • Manage the project risk register and associated mitigation plan.
    • Manage suppliers to maintain schedule, and execute all deliverables.
  • Leadership - Understand Toast’s strategic priorities and align with the cross functional team with a clear project plan. Keep the team focus and ensure commitment to be met.
    • Serve as the primary conduit for projects/programs, between multiple suppliers and global cross-functional teams.
    • Hold teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work. Leverage organizational resources to improve capacity for project work.
    • Ensure teams are adhering to Toast standards and best practices
  • Communication
    • Ability to convey information clearly and accurately through various delivery methods, such as email, phone, Slack etc.
    • Strong English communication verbal and written.
  • Process Improvement
    • Help establish and iterate on Hardware and Operation team processes.
    • Continuously improve team processes and tools in the spirit of Agile Project Management and lean operations.


What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 6+ years of technical program management experience in consumer electronic products or hardware products.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Knowledge of Hardware engineering development and manufacturing processes.
  • Hands-on experience with program management tools such as MS Project, PLM systems, Jira, and Confluence.
  • Strong English written and verbal communication
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).
  • Ability to drive tangible results promptly even when the work involves a high level of ambiguity.
  • Detail-oriented, well organized, and proactive in following up to closure.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills.
  • Team player and creative thinker with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to support domestic and international travel as needed.
  • Understanding Product Development Phase Gate processes, Hardware development processes, ECN/ECO processes.

Bonus Skills

  • PMP certification
  • Experience working on mobile tablets, Payment/POS devices development.
  • Experience in collaborating with cross functional teams in US based companies.

title: Field Implementation Technician I
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life

Toast is looking for self-motivated individuals who want to be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. You will be involved in working with Toast’s restaurant customers to set up the Toast system, train restaurant staff, build a relationship with our customers, and ensure they are successful. We are looking for candidates that like mobile technology, have experience in the restaurant industry, can communicate effectively, and are creative problem solvers. At Toast, we move fast and have a lot of opportunities for career growth, so if you’re passionate about your work and want to be in a fun and growing industry join us! You will be helping Toast to grow our business internationally.

What you'll do (Responsibilities)

  • Learn the Toast POS system and become a product expert. 
  • Install & configure Toast hardware and networking devices including terminals, handhelds, printers, and other peripherals.
  • Collaborate with internal Toast teams to find diverse business solutions that will make a restaurant THRIVE.
  • Conduct restaurant operation consultation and training sessions with all restaurant stakeholders to optimise Toast POS for their positions and operations.
  • Maintain and document implementation plans and network diagrams.
  • Test / troubleshoot unknown networking problems.
  • Terminate Ethernet cables if needed.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 

  • The ideal candidate will have flexibility with hours and the ability to work early mornings and nights.
  • While rare, weekend hours could also be required on an ad-hoc basis depending on customer needs.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to present in front of customers.
  • Demonstrates attention to detail and strong organization skills.
  • Ability to problem solve/troubleshoot in a timely manner.
  • Ability to think creatively and provide service-oriented solution recommendations that exceed customer expectations. Adaptability, strong work ethic, and professionalism during challenging situations.
  • This role will require travel within your local area and could include up to 100% travel.


Breakdown:

  • Implementation (75%) - The primary function of the Field Implementation Technicians is to be the on-site (or remote) point of contact for our customers. This may include working with our Account Executives and conducting Site Surveys to ensure customers understand the physical and network requirements before installation; Completing the installation of our hardware and networking equipment. Training owners, managers, FOH & BOH teams on leveraging Toast to accomplish their specific needs of the Toast platform; Conduct on-site or remote support on or after their Activation dates.
  • Internal best practices documentation and enablement (10%) - As Toast scales its international presence, the Field Implementation Technicians (FITs) are responsible for documenting country-specific best practices and nuances, in particular calling out where the process deviates from the US customer base (for eg. all menus in Ireland are tax- inclusive, and tax is called VAT). They will also be responsible for training and ramping up new FITs and regional contracting partners.
  • Post Live Relationship Management (15%) - As the client is transitioned over into the post-onboarding phase of the customer journey, the FIT is expected to ensure this transition goes smoothly and therefore is available for remote Go-live support to assist and guide the customer during their first several days of usage by providing post-live remote guidance, troubleshoot problems or follow-up training. Given that we are in the early days of international onboarding, this role will spend more time on post-live support than US counterparts, including site visits with the product team where necessary. This also may require some after-hours support for equipment break-fix in the field.

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Networking knowledge is a plus!
  • 1-3 years of restaurant industry experience is highly desired
  • Bilingual in French is strongly preferred, but not required
  • Located within the Greater Toronto Area

title: Principal Technical Product Manager
department: R & D : Cloud Service Infra : Infrastructure Services
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast's Technical Operations (TechOps) team makes R&D measurable and its spend accountable. We connect engineering tools and resource usage, engineering metrics and customer outcomes into one trusted view, and we provide the reliability, cost, adoption and effectiveness data that leaders use to decide what to build, standardize or retire. As AI speeds up how Toast builds software, it also changes what we spend and how we need to track it.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager to bring product discipline to this work. Our work starts from a business need, and you will dig into it with the people who have it and shape it into requirements and products they rely on. Your areas include Comprehensive Operational Reporting and FinOps tools for COGS management and software capitalization. You will report to the head of Technical Operations, who owns how we build and makes the final call on priorities. You own the what and the why: customer insight, value definition, product strategy and roadmap recommendations. We expect you to bring an independent point of view and challenge assumptions. You will also support Toast's SRE tooling team with product management for the internal tools engineers use to run production.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Get close to internal customers. Run user research with R&D leaders, engineering managers and Finance to understand the decisions they make, their jobs to be done, and where today's reports fall short.
  • Shape the product strategy. Develop and drive the strategy for TechOps products, in line with the team's overall direction and Toast's goals. 
  • Turn business needs into well-scoped requirements. Write PRDs with measurable success criteria.
  • Recommend what to build first. Each quarter, develop roadmap recommendations with engineering input. Surface the tradeoffs, bring a recommendation with your reasoning, and raise cross-team dependencies in the monthly portfolio review.
  • Build tight feedback loops. Ship in small increments to pilot users, hold regular reviews with Finance and engineering leaders, and use usage data and feedback to decide what changes next.
  • Manage adoption and lifecycle. Define target customers, adoption goals and measures of customer value. Track whether each capability solves the problem it was built for, and recommend whether to invest further, standardize, make it self-service, consolidate or retire it.
  • Support SRE tooling. Bring the same research and requirements practice to the SRE tooling team, helping define problems and success measures for tools used by on-call engineers.

**This is a hybrid role requiring two days in the office per week**

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 7+ years of technical product management experience, including data, analytics, reporting or internal platform products.
  • A track record of user research and discovery: interviews, jobs-to-be-done, usability testing, and turning qualitative and quantitative evidence into requirements.
  • Experience taking ambiguous, compliance driven,  lightly documented problems and producing crisp PRDs, success metrics and phased plans.
  • Comfort with data. You write SQL, understand how data pipelines source and transform data, read data models, challenge metric definitions, and work out why two numbers disagree.
  • Experience building for internal customers such as Finance, People teams or engineering, and aligning senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Concise, structured written and verbal communication.
  • Daily use of AI tools in your own work, from research to analysis to writing.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with FinOps, cloud or AI cost management,
  • Expereince with COGS or software capitalisation, 
  • Experience with engineering productivity metrics, or SRE and incident tooling.

descriptionHtml:

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. 

We’re not your traditional tech company and we don’t aim to be. Going against the grain is in our DNA. Building a revolutionary product begins with revolutionary thinking. That’s why we value diversity of background and lived experience. Together, we empower restaurants of all sizes to build great teams, increase revenue, improve operations, and delight their guests. Bready* to make a change?

Fintech at Toast operates one of the most critical portions of the Toast infrastructure: processing payments on behalf of our restaurants and ensuring that restaurants are paid in a timely manner. Payment processing is a key source of Toast’s revenue and also the lifeblood of our customers; we process millions of dollars in transactions per day. 

We are seeking a Software Engineer II to join our Payments team. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of our unified payment processing solution. This platform offers a single, integrated service for payment acceptance across various channels and supports a configurable enterprise approach. It is designed to allow a build-once, available-to-all strategy for both existing and emerging payment methods.

  • Design, build, and deliver features for Toast’s payments products 
  • Develop and implement automated test suite to ensure the code shipped to our customers meets the highest quality standards
  • Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success

  • Demonstrated experience with microservices architecture and containerization technologies for enhanced scalability and maintainability.

department: R & D : Engineering : Customer Experience Platform
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Engineer, Onboarding
Location: Remote, US

About Toast

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

Are you bready* for a change?

A restaurant owner switching to Toast shows up with a pile of paperwork from their old POS, a bank account to verify, and an opening date that isn't moving. Getting them to running service on Toast is the job of the Onboarding & Activation team, and increasingly of the agents we build to do that work for them.

We've shipped our first agent, and it's the start of many. Onboarding is a broad set of deep problems (menus, payments, hardware, payroll, staff), each a candidate for an agent that acts across Toast's systems instead of answering questions about them. It's a company priority: lower cost to onboard, less support volume, higher NPS, and far better visibility into how each restaurant is set up. You'll define how these agents get built: what they're allowed to do, how they recover when something goes wrong, and when they hand off to a person.

Success means more than going live. It's how well the restaurant was set up, how ready they were for day one, and how much help they needed afterward. Those signals are real but delayed and noisy, and building evaluations that tell us an agent did the right thing, not just a plausible thing, before the restaurant opens is one of the harder problems here.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Design and build AI agents that complete onboarding work for restaurants, from tool design and permissions through evaluation, guardrails, and production monitoring.
  • Turn the Toast systems onboarding touches, including payments, payroll, hardware, menus, and appointments, into reliable tools agents can use to read state and take action.
  • Own the onboarding backend and reshape it for agent-driven flows that aren't known in advance.
  • Build evaluation and measurement so every launch is tied to real outcomes: setup quality, readiness to go live, and how much help restaurants need after launch.
  • Ship full-stack changes in the restaurant-facing setup experience when the work calls for it.
  • Partner with product, design, onboarding operations, and data science to turn onboarding problems into agents and product changes we can test and measure.
  • Contribute to technical design and architecture, and help set engineering standards for AI-powered systems across the teams that contribute to onboarding.
  • Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and by sharing how you build with AI.

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another object-oriented language.
  • Experience building on LLMs where the model takes real actions through tools, in production or in serious side projects, with a practical grasp of nondeterminism, evaluation, and cost.
  • Proven ability to own outcomes end to end: design, launch, rollout monitoring, measurement, and iteration.
  • A product-minded builder who forms a point of view on what to build, not just how, and works across PM, design, and operations rather than executing tickets.
  • You use AI coding tools like Claude Code as a core part of how you work, and you've helped others get better with them.

Special sauce* (Nice to haves)

  • Experience with customer onboarding, activation, growth, or workflow/task orchestration systems.
  • Experience with experimentation or funnel analysis, and a working sense of when to believe a metric.
  • Enough full-stack experience (React and TypeScript preferred) to ship front-end changes when needed.

You will execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses with the strategic goal of determining mutual fit for our all-in-one digital platform, ensuring Account Executives receive high-quality engagements ready for closing.

  • Host qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our all-in-one digital platform.
  • Schedule meetings for qualified prospects, ensuring a seamless handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.

  • Proven Drive and Refusal to Fail: Possesses the self-discipline and sustained effort necessary to achieve ambitious daily activity goals and recover quickly from rejection.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively seeks and immediately applies feedback, while proactively self-assessing performance to identify and vocalize specific areas for growth and development.
  • High Self-Accountability: Driven by measurable results and takes full ownership of daily performance metrics and pipeline contribution.

  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
  • Strong Organizational Skills: Meticulous attention to detail and ability to manage time effectively to balance 100+ daily outreach activities.

  • Exceptional Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and persuasive communicator across high-volume calls and written outreach (email/social).
