title: Director, Managed Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

About the Managed Marketing Team:

ToastIQ Grow pairs restaurants with a dedicated Marketing Success Manager to build strategy, execute weekly multi‑channel campaigns (Email, SMS, Social, Offers/Promos, Loyalty, Gift Cards, SEO/Presence), and analyze results—ultimately helping restaurants improve their marketing operations, save time, and grow first‑party demand. 

As Director, Marketing Services, you will own Toast’s managed marketing program from end to end. You’ll set the strategy, service model and operating standards for the business, and lead a team of Managers who each run a team of Marketing Success Managers. You’ll be accountable for program outcomes: customer results, service quality, retention and expansion, unit economics, and the team’s ability to scale.

You are a systems‑minded operator who can translate strategy into clear playbooks and measurable results. You’ll remove friction for Specialists and customers, strengthen our service model, and collaborate closely with Product, Product Strategy, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance. You’ll set the multi-year vision for how Toast delivers marketing outcomes to restaurants, including the balance between human-led service, automation and product.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Set program vision and strategy. Own the multi-year roadmap for Managed Marketing, including service tiers, packaging, delivery model, and how human expertise, automation and AI fit together. Turn this into annual goals, OKRs and investment cases for senior leadership.
  • Build and lead a leadership team. Hire, develop and retain a strong bench of Managers. Set clear expectations, coach them as leaders, run talent calibration and succession planning. Create a culture of high craft, accountability and customer obsession.
  • Own program performance and economics. Be accountable for program KPIs such as customer outcomes, retention, expansion and attach, CSAT/NPS, delivery SLAs and cost to serve. Work with Finance on capacity models, headcount plans, pricing inputs and margin improvement.
  • Design an operating model that scales. Build the structure, workflows and governance needed to grow the program. This covers segmentation and book-of-business design, capacity and staffing models, QA frameworks, tooling, and playbooks for kickoff, planning, multi-channel execution and reporting. Find where standardization, specialization or automation can raise both quality and efficiency.
  • Build mechanisms for insight and accountability. Define the program’s metrics framework, dashboards and business review rituals (weekly, monthly and quarterly) so leaders and partners can see pipeline, delivery health, customer outcomes and team performance. Use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement.
  • Own quality, risk and escalations. Set the quality bar and compliance framework (Toast Marketing Guidelines, legal and brand standards), and act as the executive escalation point for high-stakes customer issues.
  • Champion the customer and the story. Turn program learnings, customer insights and success stories into inputs for product roadmap, go-to-market and executive communications. Represent Managed Marketing internally and, where appropriate, externally.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 7–10 years in marketing or marketing services, including 3+ years managing people in a delivery or account‑management context (e.g., agency team lead, or managed services lead).
  • Demonstrated success running multi‑channel programs across Email, SMS, Social, Offers/Promos, Loyalty, Gift Cards - and partnering on Paid Ads and SEO/Presence.
  • Process‑oriented leader with a track record of building playbooks, SLAs, and QA mechanisms that scale; comfortable with capacity planning and workload management.
  • Strong marketing craft (strategy + execution) and coaching ability—able to up-level content quality, segmentation, and testing, and communicate the “why” behind plans.
  • Analytical, data‑driven decision maker—experienced with defining KPIs, building dashboards, and translating performance into clear next actions for the team. 
  • Exceptional communicator and relationship‑builder across functions (Product, Product Strategy, Sales, CS, Legal, Finance); influence without authority.

title: Solutions Lead, International Upmarket
descriptionHtml:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast International is building its upmarket business across the UK & Ireland, Canada, and Australia, focused on restaurant groups with 16 to 500 locations. We're hiring a solutions lead to own the technical side of every International deal over 15 locations. Your demos and labs are where our deals are won or lost.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Run demos that win the room. Build every demo from discovery. Show a 40-site group their own menu, their own workflows and the systems they already run, in their market's version of the product. Tailor it to each person in the buying group, from the head of ops to the IT lead to finance. Leave each of them with a reason to champion Toast.
  • Run labs that end in a decision. Agree success criteria with the customer before the lab starts. Build and maintain the lab environment, track every issue, drive escalations and root cause analysis, and close the lab with a clear yes or no. No lab ends without an agreed next step.
  • Own the technical outcome through go-live. The deal isn't won until the customer is live and it matches what we sold. Stay involved through procurement and handoff.
  • Architect the solution. Design how Toast fits into a multi-location group's existing stack:

All of it within what's actually available, and what payments rules allow, in each market.

  • Lead security, IT and compliance reviews. Own vendor security questionnaires, PCI scoping conversations and the technical sections of RFPs.
  • Speak product's language. Write business requirement documentation that product and engineering can act on: the problem, the customer's own words, workarounds tried, what's at stake across the segment (not just one account), and options with tradeoffs. Turn one customer's ask into a case for the platform.
  • Present the roadmap with credibility. Walk executive and IT audiences through what exists, what's coming and what isn't, without overpromising. Keep their trust when the answer is "not yet."
  • Sell outcomes, not features. Partner with sales to build the business case. Translate technical fit into the outcomes the economic buyer cares about, such as labor, speed of service and revenue. When a buyer is weighing a feature gap, help them see it against the full value of the platform, and make sure their IT team feels heard along the way.
  • Engineer workarounds, and know when to hold the line. Design and document solutions to complex gaps, and judge when a workaround creates debt we'll pay for at go-live.
  • Build real relationships outside the sales thread. Become the trusted counterpart to the customer's IT lead, head of operations and systems owners, relationships that hold up on their own merit.
  • Hand off cleanly. Give onboarding and implementation a clear record of what was promised, what was configured and why, so delivery matches the sale.
  • Help build the function. Set the engagement model for when and how AEs bring you in, qualify technical fit early and disqualify fast, and build reusable assets: demo environments for each market, reference architectures, an RFP library and BRD standards.
  • Partner across Solutions. Work closely with the International SMB Solutions team on clear lanes, shared tools and cross-coverage.
  • Grow the team. Help define, hire and develop the International upmarket solutions team as the business scales.
  • Own your own leverage. Continuously find the repetitive parts of the role (RFP answers, security questionnaires, discovery notes, demo resets) and systematically get them off your plate.
  • Close the loop on what's broken. Feed product gaps, lost-deal reasons and market differences back to product and sales leadership, so the next deal is easier than the last.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • An elite demo and lab track record. You've run tailored demos for multi-stakeholder buying committees and taken complex labs or pilots to a signed decision. In the interview, you'll run a demo for us and walk us through a lab you ran end to end.
  • You build and maintain your own environments. Demo data, lab configurations and resets are your job, done fast and adapted for each market.
  • 7+ years in solutions architecture, solutions engineering or technical consulting, with at least 4 supporting mid-market or enterprise deals with 6 to 12+ month cycles and buying committees.
  • Experience in hospitality, retail or payments technology serving multi-location operators.
  • You've taken complex deals through lab or pilot to go-live. You can walk us through one end to end, including what went wrong and what you changed.
  • Integration fluency: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and data flows. You can read API docs and sketch an architecture on a whiteboard. Coding isn't required, but you can test your own assumptions.
  • Security and compliance fluency: PCI DSS scope, and privacy regimes such as UK GDPR, PIPEDA and the Australian Privacy Act. You're comfortable owning a security review.
  • Writing that product teams act on. Bring a sanitized requirements doc, solution design or BRD to the interview.
  • Executive presence with C-suite and IT leaders, including delivering "no" and keeping the relationship.
  • International experience across more than one market or regulatory regime. Willing to travel across the UK & Ireland, Canada and Australia (30%+).
  • Comfort working in build mode, where territory definition, process and tooling are actively being shaped and you're expected to have an opinion on them.

Special Skills (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise POS or hospitality platforms in these markets
  • ERP, HR or workforce management integration experience
  • MEDDPICC

What success looks like in year one

  • Every 16+ location deal gets a tailored demo, and every lab has agreed success criteria and ends in a decision.
  • Deals we win go live on the timeline we agreed. No stalls, no churn, no post-sale surprises.
  • AEs know exactly when and how to bring you in, and technical fit is settled early in the cycle, not in week ten.
  • Product changes a decision because of a BRD you wrote.
  • A clear plan for the next upmarket solutions hire.

This role isn't for you if

You want a defined playbook, a large existing team, or a role that ends at the demo.

title: Engineering Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy. Toast helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best : building the businesses they love. Toast connects employees, operations, and guests on a reliable, easy-to-use platform so restaurateurs can stay one step ahead of a rapidly evolving hospitality market.

Are you bready* for a change?

We are hiring for the ‘Enterprise Payments’ team, which sits at the centre of Toast's global Enterprise growth strategy. We design, build, and scale the Fintech infrastructure that powers seamless commerce for Enterprise customers across the globe.

Toast is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Enterprise Payments team. You will manage and develop a high-performing engineering team focused on delivering strategic capabilities for our enterprise customers and driving meaningful business impact. Leading with a global-first mindset, you will oversee the design and delivery of resilient, scalable payment systems that power enterprise growth across international markets.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

  • Roadmap Execution : Partner with stakeholders to define, prioritise, and execute the Enterprise Payments team's roadmap and operational objectives, translating business priorities into measurable outcomes.
  • Team Leadership: Support the professional and technical development of team members through coaching, mentorship, and career guidance, helping engineers grow as both technical contributors and leaders.
  • Delivery: Establish accountability for execution and outcomes, ensuring the team delivers value with speed, quality, and reliability.
  • Culture : Serve as a steward of an exceptional culture, encompassing both technical excellence and people‑centric values.
  • Scale : Guide teams to build systems that will scale to the next order of magnitude of growth.
  • Collaboration : Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization - including PMs, SEs, CS, QA, and UX - to help your teams get stuff done and deliver solutions that maximize value.
  • Operational Excellence : Build and scale a customer-first operational support model that delivers timely issue triage, effective problem resolution, and exceptional service reliability for enterprise customers, while driving continuous improvements in operational efficiency and customer outcomes.
  • Hiring : Hire and develop new team members, building a diverse team that wins together.

Do you have the right ingredients? (Experience)

  • Strong technologist with 12+ years of experience defining, architecting, and delivering highly scalable engineering solutions.
  • 4+ years of experience managing, coaching, and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Deep experience in the Fintech/Payments domains.
  • A passion for building diverse, high-performing teams that collaborate effectively, win together, and place customer success at the centre of every decision.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering (Android) - POS Payments Experience
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

The Toast POS app is the central pillar of Toast's restaurant products. Every day, hundreds of thousands of servers, hosts, bartenders, and chefs use it to serve millions of guests. Android is the foundation of our POS stack. Toast even designs and sells its own specialized Android tablets, so we can build the best integrated hardware and software products.

Our POS Payments Experience team powers some of the restaurant's most critical workflows (checking out and taking payments) across a coordinated network of tablets and peripherals that are typically used 10-12 hours a day. The POS needs to work as fast as possible, and if the network has problems, it needs to keep running. Meeting these requirements means pushing our technology stack to the limits. The impact is tangible and direct: small changes in the tightest loops pay off many thousands of times over, improving staff job satisfaction, the guest experience, and the restaurant's bottom line.

We are seeking a seasoned Engineering Manager to lead the POS Payments Experience team. You will lead a high-performing team of engineers who work hand-in-hand with PM and UX, and partner across POS and Fintech teams. Engineers on the team also contribute to our web-based POS payments configuration experience.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Drive delivery of business outcomes for POS payments, including planning, schedule, and execution
  • Drive cross-team and cross-organization efforts, especially across POS and Fintech, with predictable results and excellent collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with PM and UX to fill the team's backlog with actionable, valuable work
  • Ensure end-to-end quality and delivery of software, including ownership of monitoring and production issues
  • Partner with technical leaders to set technical direction and continuously improve architecture, codebase, and engineering practice
  • Hire and develop new team members
  • Coach individuals in professional and technical development
  • Champion the use of AI tools and practices to accelerate development, improve team velocity, and pioneer new ways of building, setting the bar for what it means to be an AI-first engineering organization

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Experience leading and mentoring successful teams to drive predictable business results
  • Experience delivering mobile products (Android preferred) to a large customer base, and working in mobile codebases with a large number of developers
  • Strong technical background in Java, Kotlin, and Android that you use to guide your team's decisions and plans
  • Experience managing a mix of core contributions and cross-team engagements
  • Experience communicating technical designs and contributing to the design process
  • Not afraid to get hands-on or go deep to help the team reach its goals, and you encourage high agency and exploring creative outlets
  • A collaborative, solution-oriented approach with business and product leaders
  • A desire to build diverse teams that win together and prioritize customer success

title: Territory Account Executive, Retail
descriptionHtml:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding its offerings into other food and beverage concepts such as convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. This role will require a founder’s mindset as we grow Toast’s presence in this new vertical with a new offering: the Toast Retail platform. 

As a Retail Account Executive, you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new accounts. We need your passion, sales expertise, and entrepreneurial spirit to help us build the Toast brand in an assigned geographic territory.

title: Onboarding Consultant, Menu
descriptionHtml:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

A day in the life

The Menu Onboarding Consultant works closely with the POS Onboarding Consultants and is dedicated to building, reviewing, and configuring customer menus to ensure our customers are ready for go-live and for ongoing success.  As an Onboarding Consultant, Toast’s way of saying an “Implementation Specialist”,  you serve as the customer’s menu relationship manager & point of contact from the time that the account purchases Toast, through the onboarding phase of the customer journey. You are expected to work autonomously under an Onboarding Manager to achieve monthly activation goals, prioritize work based on customer needs and Toast requirements, and deliver high-quality customer interactions. To thrive as a Menu Onboarding Consultant at Toast, you are flexible, motivated by aggressive growth goals, and excel in ambiguous environments!  

The role will be remote. Candidates can be based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane.

What you'll do (Responsibilities)

  • Leverage your Toast product knowledge and project management skills to partner with restaurant owners during the Go-Live phase and build out onboarding plans that will produce a high-quality implementation experience within the timeline and budget.
  • Create best practices for managing daily restaurant operations by enabling restaurant owners and staff to utilize Toast, including management of labor and food costs, table turnover time, and guest relationships.
  • Responsible for consulting with clients to determine configuration needs prior to go-live and communicating any unique needs to the project resources.
  • Perform onboarding configurations remotely while documenting the go-live process, observing Toast best practices, as well as document any deviations from best practices that were identified during the design phase of the project. 
  • Create & lead an onboarding training plan to the entire restaurant staff on how to leverage the Toast product configured to their business and workflow with a focus on operational efficiencies that positively impact the guest and staff experience.
  • Manage several onboarding engagements simultaneously, including large books of onboarding business (80+ restaurants) in your region.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 1 + years of experience in a role responsible for customer satisfaction and business operations, including management of long-term customer relationships (4-6 weeks or more)
  • Success operating independently and navigating competing priorities in a constantly changing environment
  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and influencing skills

  • 1+ years of experience using a POS (Point of Sale) software, ideally in the service industry
